items.title: 国連、「破壊的」エルニーニョによるリスク警鐘　太平洋海水温が過去最高へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ジュネーブ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ジュネーブ ２１日 ロイター] - 国連の世界気象機関（ＷＭＯ）は２１日、エルニーニョ現象の影響で太平洋の海水温が記録的な水準まで上昇する可能性があるとの見通しを示した。洪水や干ばつなどの異常気象を世界各地にもたらす「破壊球（レッキングボール）」になり得ると警告し、各国に早急な備えを呼びかけている。

ＷＭＯが公表した季節予報によると、今回のエルニーニョ現象は極めて強い規模に発達する見込みで、１１月から来年１月にかけて中部太平洋の海面水温は平年を摂氏約３．８度上回り、１２月ごろにピークを迎えるとされる。

ＷＭＯのサウロ事務局長は記者会見で「観測記録の中で３．８度という数値は見たことがない。過去の極めて強いエルニーニョでも約３度程度だったが、それでも世界に甚大な影響を与えた」と語った。

エルニーニョ現象は世界的な気温上昇を招くほか、降雨パターンを変化させ、一部地域では干ばつ、別の地域では豪雨を引き起こす傾向がある。この現象そのものは気候変動によるものではないが、地球温暖化によって現象がより強まる恐れがあるという。

ＷＭＯはエルニーニョに伴う異常気象が住宅、水資源、衛生、医療サービスへの負担を一段と高めかねないと指摘。南部アフリカでは１１月以降に洪水リスクが高まると注意を促した。

また東南アジアでは高温と少雨により農業や水供給への影響が懸念される一方、中南米では降雨量が増加する可能性があるとしている。

ＷＭＯと、国連事務次長で人道問題調整事務所（ＯＣＨＡ）緊急援助調整官を務めるトム・フレッチャー氏は、各国に対し早急な対策を講じるよう要請した。

フレッチャー氏は「今回のエルニーニョは巨大な“怪物”で、破壊球のようなものだ。中南米、東・南部アフリカ、アジア、太平洋地域に極端な高温、干ばつ、洪水をもたらすだろう」と述べ、大規模な人道危機につながる恐れがあると訴えた。

同氏によると、この影響により最大で５０００万人前後が深刻な食料不足に直面してもおかしくないという。

items.title: 体操＝世界選手権で日本女子団体が銅、60年ぶり快挙　ロス五輪切符
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 体操の世界選手権は２１日、オランダのロッテルダムで女子団体総合決勝を行い、日本が銅メダルを獲得した。同大会でのメダル獲得は６０年ぶり。

杉原愛子、西山実沙、岸里奈、岡村真、中村遥香で臨んだ日本は、４種目合計１６４．０６３点をマーク。１９６６年ドルトムント大会（ドイツ）以来のメダル獲得となった。

中国が１６５．７６４点で２０年ぶりの金メダル。７連覇中の米国は中国と０．２３３点差で銀メダルとなった。上位３チームは２８年ロサンゼルス五輪の出場権を獲得した。

日本は前日の２０日にも男子が団体総合決勝で金メダルを獲得し、２連覇でロス五輪出場権を獲得していた。

items.title: サッカー＝鈴木フル出場のアストンビラ、3連勝で2位浮上　欧州ＣＬ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マドリード　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マドリード　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）は２１日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラ（イングランド）はホームでバイキング（ノルウェー）に３─１で勝利した。

アストンビラは前半に２得点を挙げて試合を折り返すと、後半にも加点。終盤に１点を返されたがそのまま逃げ切り、３連勝で２位に浮上した。

上田綺世が所属するリール（フランス）はホームでガラタサライ（トルコ）に２─４で敗れ、３連敗となった。負傷中の上田はメンバー外だった。

伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘン（ドイツ）はホームでアーセナル（イングランド）に２─２で引き分けた。伊藤はベンチ入りしたものの出場機会はなかった。

渡辺剛が所属するフェイエノールト（オランダ）は敵地でベティス（スペイン）に０─１で敗戦。渡辺は後半３４分から途中出場した。

レアル・マドリード（スペイン）はホームでライプチヒ（ドイツ）に４─１で快勝し、３連勝。マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（イングランド）は敵地でコモ（イタリア）に１─４で敗れた。

items.title: China, Djibouti say all countries should enjoy freedom of navigation in Red Sea
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: All countries should enjoy freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, China and Djibouti said in a joint statement following a meeting of their foreign ministers in Beijing, expressing concern about the deteriorating security situation.
items.body:
All countries should enjoy freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, China and Djibouti said in a joint statement following a meeting of their foreign ministers in Beijing, expressing concern about the deteriorating security situation.
Djibouti sits on the other side of the Bab ed-Mandeb Strait from Yemen, where Iran-backed Houthis have been battling Saudi-backed government forces and seeking to control the whole Yemeni Red Sea coast, disrupting some shipping.
In 2017, China formally opened its first overseas military base in Djibouti. The barren former French colony, which is about the size of Wales, is sandwiched between Ethiopia, Eritrea and Somalia and also hosts US, Japanese and French bases.
The joint statement, released early on Thursday, said both China and Djibouti stressed the importance of maintaining freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the strait, and "emphasised that the right of merchant ships of all countries to exercise navigation rights in accordance with international law should be respected".
"Both sides believe that in governing and securing the Red Sea, the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and wishes of the Red Sea littoral states should be genuinely respected, avoiding any increase in the overall security risks of the region."
China supports the littoral states of the Red Sea in "constructively maintaining" the safety and smooth flow of international shipping lanes, said the statement, carried by China's official Xinhua news agency.
Neither country wants regional tensions to spill further into the Red Sea, and "major powers outside the region" should respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of regional countries, and avoid resorting to force and unilateral sanctions, it added.
The statement came as the [USN:L6N46718Z TEXT:"US State Department ordered"] some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia following the escalation of the fighting in Yemen, which has opened another front in the regional conflict triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran .

items.title: イスラエル中銀、政策金利を3.25％に据え置き　総選挙控え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［エルサレム　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［エルサレム　２１日　ロイター］ - イスラエル中央銀行は２１日の金融政策委員会で、政策金利を３．２５％に据え置くことを決定した。来週に総選挙を控え、地政学的な緊張も続く中、様子見を選択した。

中銀は２０２５年１１月と２６年１月に利下げを実施した後、イランとの紛争や供給面に起因するインフレの急加速への懸念から利下げを一時停止。その後、５月に利下げを再開し、７月、９月にも追加利下げを実施していた。

ロイターがエコノミスト１５人を対象に実施した調査では、全員が今回の据え置きを予想していた。

中銀エコノミストは、今後１年以内に追加利下げが１回実施され、政策金利が３．０％になるとの見通しを維持した。一方、ヤロン総裁は記者会見で、労働市場の逼迫などに触れ、今後の金融緩和について明言を避けた。

ヤロン氏は、２７日の総選挙を控えて利下げを見送ったとの見方を否定。決定はあくまで経済的要因に基づいて行われたと説明した。「金利を据え置くという判断は正しい。３回連続の利下げを行ったこと、また国内外のさまざまなリスクを踏まえれば、責任ある選択だと言えるだろう」と述べた。

Costa Rica have appointed former captain Bryan Ruiz as head coach to lead the national team's campaign to qualify for the 2030 World Cup, the Costa Rican Football Federation (FCRF) said on Wednesday.
Ruiz, 41, takes the job after two wins as interim coach, with Costa Rica beating Nicaragua 3-0 and Haiti 2-0 in the CONCACAF Nations League earlier this month

items.title: Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA confirma primeira detecção da mosca-da-bicheira do Novo Mundo em animal silvestre no país
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos informou nesta quarta-feira que confirmou a primeira detecção da mosca-da-bicheira do Novo Mundo, parasita que se alimenta de tecido vivo, em um animal silvestre nos EUA: um alce no condado de Pecos, no Texas.
items.body:
O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos informou nesta quarta-feira que confirmou a primeira detecção da mosca-da-bicheira do Novo Mundo, parasita que se alimenta de tecido vivo, em um animal silvestre nos EUA: um alce no condado de Pecos, no Texas.
O alce foi encontrado em uma fazenda de caça e foi relatado após ter sido abatido por um caçador, informou o USDA em um comunicado.
A Comissão de Saúde Animal do Texas modificará uma zona infestada previamente estabelecida, e o USDA e o Departamento de Parques e Vida Selvagem do Texas estão realizando vigilância adicional da vida selvagem na área, informou o USDA.
Erradicada dos EUA há décadas, a praga avançou para o norte a partir da América Central, passando pelo México, o que levou Washington a impor uma proibição de mais de um ano às importações de gado mexicano.
Os EUA suspenderam as importações de gado do México no ano passado para impedir a entrada da mosca-da-bicheira, mas retomaram o comércio em agosto em um porto do Arizona como parte de um plano de reabertura gradual.
A suspensão contribuiu para reduzir a oferta de gado nos EUA e elevar os preços da carne bovina a níveis recordes para os consumidores norte-americanos.

items.title: Missiles strike Ukraine's Kyiv, Reuters witness says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Missiles struck Kyiv in the early hours of Thursday, a Reuters witness said, in another attack on Ukraine's capital after a Russian evening air strike which injured six people and damaged homes, a petrol station and transport equipment.
items.body:
Missiles struck Kyiv in the early hours of Thursday, a Reuters witness said, in another attack on Ukraine's capital [USN:L1N46711S TEXT:"after"] a Russian evening air strike which injured six people and damaged homes, a petrol station and transport equipment.
In Russia, in the city of Lipetsk — home to a major steel plant some 400 km (250 miles) south of Moscow — a man was injured as drones hit apartment buildings and a medical facility, Governor Igor Artamonov said on the Telegram messaging app.
The strikes come as US presidential envoy Steve Witkoff [USN:L1N4670ZQ TEXT:"held"] talks this week with Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and Russia's President Vladimir Putin to mediate an end a conflict which began with Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: In order to better compete for global investments, Australia must pay close attention to tax incentives and business-friendly measures offered in countries such as Canada, BHP Chair Ross McEwan said on Thursday.
items.body:
In order to better compete for global investments, Australia must pay close attention to tax incentives and business-friendly measures offered in countries such as Canada, BHP (BHP.AX) Chair Ross McEwan said on Thursday.
Speaking at the miner's annual general meeting, McEwan said, "Make no mistake, Australia must compete for capital if it wants to win – nationally, and in every state."
He said Canada had recently announced a "Productivity Mega Deduction", allowing businesses to immediately deduct the full cost of eligible capital investments.
Canada also allows miners to fully deduct mine development costs in the year they are incurred, he added.
Such measures lower the tax burden on new investments, improve returns and give companies more confidence to commit capital, McEwan said, describing Canada's approach as a practical example of how government policy could help boost productivity and attract investments. That in turn creates jobs, incomes and tax revenue, he added.
He said similar examples could be found in other countries where BHP invests, including Argentina and Chile.
"Australia should pay close attention to that."

items.title: Irmã de líder da Coreia do Norte adverte Coreia do Sul e diz que alto-falantes na fronteira estarão prontos em poucos dias
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Coreia do Norte colocará alto-falantes de propaganda contra a Coreia do Sul em prontidão ao longo de toda a fronteira nos próximos dias e colocou novas contramedidas em alerta, disse nesta quinta-feira Kim Yo Jong, a poderosa irmã do líder norte-coreano, alertando Seul para “a situação mais horrível e angustiante” caso continue o que Pyongyang chama de interferência.
items.body:
A Coreia do Norte colocará alto-falantes de propaganda contra a Coreia do Sul em prontidão ao longo de toda a fronteira nos próximos dias e colocou novas contramedidas em alerta, disse nesta quinta-feira Kim Yo Jong, a poderosa irmã do líder norte-coreano, alertando Seul para “a situação mais horrível e angustiante” caso continue o que Pyongyang chama de interferência.
As ameaças de reativar os alto-falantes de propaganda, anunciadas na segunda declaração de Kim em questão de horas, correm o risco de reverter os avanços emblemáticos do presidente sul-coreano, Lee Jae Myung, na redução das tensões intercoreanas e de elevar as tensões ao longo da fronteira fortemente fortificada ao seu nível mais alto desde que ele assumiu o cargo.
Em uma declaração divulgada pela agência de notícias estatal KCNA, Kim disse que estava respondendo a um assessor especial de Lee para a política de defesa, que acusou a Coreia do Norte de plantar minas que feriram soldados sul-coreanos e pediu que o país não intensificasse as tensões com transmissões por alto-falantes.
“Nossas novas medidas de resposta entrarão em estado de alerta em toda a linha de fronteira sul, e os alto-falantes voltados para a Coreia do Sul ficarão em estado de prontidão em questão de dias”, disse ela.
Ela afirmou que a Coreia do Norte continuará fortificando sua fronteira sul.
Kim afirmou na noite desta quarta-feira que a Coreia do Norte ativaria os alto-falantes contra a Coreia do Sul ao longo da fronteira até o final de outubro, após visitar locais de fortificação com altos oficiais militares.
A Coreia do Sul afirma que minas norte-coreanas causaram uma explosão na fronteira no mês passado, que feriu gravemente dois soldados. A Coreia do Norte nega responsabilidade, chamando o incidente de invenção sul-coreana.
Lim Eul-chul, professor da Universidade Kyungnam, em Seul, disse que as advertências de Kim não significam necessariamente que os alto-falantes serão ativados.
Mas elas representam um “enorme dilema” para o governo de Lee, disse ele, já que este se depara com a escolha entre prosseguir com sua política de engajamento pacífico e conter as atividades militares agressivas da Coreia do Norte ao longo da fronteira.

items.title: Estimación cosecha trigo de Argentina sube a 23,8 mln tons: Bolsa Rosario
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La cosecha de trigo de Argentina del ciclo 2026/27 sería de 23,8 millones de toneladas, desde los 21 millones estimados el mes pasado, debido a expectativas de rendimientos superiores a los previstos, dijo el miércoles la Bolsa de Comercio de Rosario (BCR).
items.body:
La cosecha de trigo de Argentina del ciclo 2026/27 sería de 23,8 millones de toneladas, desde los 21 millones estimados el mes pasado, debido a expectativas de rendimientos superiores a los previstos, dijo el miércoles la Bolsa de Comercio de Rosario (BCR).
Según la Bolsa, de alcanzarse la cifra estimada, sería la segunda mayor cosecha de trigo registrada en Argentina, un exportador mundial clave de alimentos.
La provincia de Santa Fe "espera un gran año productivo con un rinde provincial que no le falta demasiado para alcanzar los 40 quintales (4 toneladas) por hectárea, incluso supera por una mínima diferencia a Buenos Aires", la tradicional región triguera de Argentina, dijo la BCR en su reporte mensual.
Según la entidad, temperaturas inferiores a las normales para el comienzo de la primavera austral están beneficiando el desarrollo del cultivo, aunque también existen preocupaciones por los pocos días soleados registrados y su impacto en las plantas, señaló el informe.
La cosecha del trigo comienza en noviembre en Argentina.
Con respecto a la soja y el maíz, la Bolsa mantuvo estables sus previsiones para ambos cultivos en el ciclo 2026/27, en 47,8 millones y 67,5 millones de toneladas, respectivamente.

items.title: Driver at Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant killed in drone attacks, managers say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Management at the Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant in southeastern Ukraine said a driver at the station had been killed on Wednesday after two days of Ukrainian drone attacks.
items.body:
Management at the Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant in southeastern Ukraine said a driver at the station had been killed on Wednesday after two days of Ukrainian drone attacks.
Russian forces seized the station, Europe's largest with six reactors, in the first weeks of the February 2022 invasion. Each side has since repeatedly accused the other of military activity liable to jeopardise nuclear safety.
The plant's managers in a post on Telegram said buses carrying staff to and from the plant had come under attack for two days in a row.
"The second straight day of attacks on the station's transport shows that these strikes are deliberate," the statement said.
It said the attacks "pose a direct threat" to staff who ensured operations at the plant.
Russia has in recent months accused Ukraine of attacking sites and services associated with the plant, including transport.
Rosatom, Russia's state nuclear corporation, said a Ukrainian drone attack on a service car in July [USN:L1N43H12E TEXT:"killed"] the plant's chief engineer and the vehicle's driver.
The city of Enerhodar, where most of the nuclear station's staff live, has also been a frequent target.
Rosatom last week said a [USN:S8N45E0AO TEXT:"truce agreement"], mediated by the UN's nuclear watchdog, the International Atomic Energy Agency, was in place to allow repairs at a thermal power station supplying power to the nuclear plant.

items.title: ＵＡＥ外交官ヌセイベ氏、次期国連事務総長選に出馬
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maha El Dahan

[ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maha El Dahan

[ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] - アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の外交官ラナ・ヌセイベ氏が２１日、次期国連事務総長選に出馬した。安全保障理事会の常任理事国が一致して支持できる候補の選定が難航する中、中東の有力候補が加わった。

１０年以上にわたりＵＡＥの国連大使を務めたヌセイベ氏はロイターに対し、世界各地で危機が深刻化する中、外交を通じて問題を解決する国連の役割を取り戻したいと述べた。

出馬を公表する直前のインタビューで「今必要なのは、多国間主義の未来と、世界の危機の傍観者ではなく問題の解決者としての国連の未来に、改めて力を尽くせる事務総長であることは明らかだ」と語った。

ヌセイベ氏は遅れて選挙戦に参入した。関係筋によると、安保理の非公式投票ではコスタリカのグリンスパン元副大統領が僅差で首位に立っていた。

グリンスパン氏は非公式の予備投票でリードしてきたが、先週の投票では同氏を含む全候補に対し、最終的な決定権を握る常任理事国５カ国の英国、中国、フランス、ロシア、米国のうち２カ国以上が反対票を投じた。

安保理理事国は次回の投票を２３日に行うか、それ以降にするかを協議している。

ヌセイベ氏は、直近の国連総会の際に複数の国から出馬を打診されたと明らかにした。同氏は以前、ＵＡＥの安保理理事国入りに向けた活動を率い、当選に導いた。ニューヨークの外交官らによると、組織運営の手腕を評価されている。

items.body:
Comcast Corp (CMCSA.O) is planning a significant number of job cuts as part of a restructuring of its cable-TV, broadband and wireless businesses, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the plan.
The cuts, aimed at creating a nimble workforce and freeing up cash for investments, could start being announced in a matter of weeks, the report said, without revealing how many jobs were at stake
Comcast did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours
The report comes months after Comcast said it will [USN:L4N4310Q4 TEXT:"split"] into two publicly traded companies through a spinoff of NBCUniversal and Sky, under pressure from streaming rivals and industry consolidation
The company had about 179,000 employees as of December 31, 2025

items.title: Ohio State University disputes DOJ finding that medical school discriminates in admissions
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: Ohio State University said on Wednesday it disagreed with the US Department of Justice's findings that alleged its medical school favored Black and Hispanic applicants in admissions and discriminated against white and Asian applicants.
items.body:
Ohio State University said on Wednesday it disagreed with the US Department of Justice's findings that alleged its medical school favored Black and Hispanic applicants in admissions and discriminated against white and Asian applicants.
The DOJ said findings from a federal probe showed Ohio State College of Medicine discriminated against white and Asian students in granting admission to its 2023, 2024 and 2025 incoming classes.
In a letter to the institution, the DOJ alleged the school's admission practices aimed "to benefit preferred race classes of Black and Hispanic."
It alleged the school's diversity commitments showed discriminatory intent, marking the latest targeting of diversity programs at universities by President Donald Trump's administration.
The DOJ said it seeks a voluntary resolution agreement and will file suit if those efforts fail.
"Ohio State strongly disagrees with the findings," the university said in a statement. It said it is in full compliance with the Supreme Court's ruling and all federal and state laws regarding admissions.
The medical school does not consider race, ethnicity or any protected class during admissions, it said, adding it will "contest these findings."
The Supreme Court [USN:S0N31105H TEXT:"rejected affirmative action"] at colleges in 2023 when it struck down race-conscious admissions programs at Harvard and the University of North Carolina.
Trump, who casts [USN:L3N3OP05M TEXT:"diversity goals"] as anti-merit and discriminatory against white people and men, has signed orders to dismantle them.
Rights advocates say such practices address historic inequities for marginalized groups including ethnic minorities and LGBT communities.
Trump has targeted universities with probes and funding-suspension threats over [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"pro-Palestinian protests"] against US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's attacks on Gaza"], [USN:L4N43O2J4 TEXT:"admissions practices"], diversity initiatives, [USN:L4N3R61MM TEXT:"transgender policies"] and climate programs, leading to free speech, due process and academic freedom concerns.

items.title: ＦＲＢ、銀行向け流動性供給見直しで資産の大幅縮小可能＝シンクタンク提言
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michael S. Derby

[２１日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が保有資産を大幅に縮小するためには、銀行に対する流動性供給の枠組みを見直し、必要に応じて資金を供給する新たな制度を導入するとともに、銀行の手元資金保有に関する規制を緩和することだ－－。米シンクタンクのブルッキングス研究所が新たな論文でこうした見解を示した。

論文を執筆したブルッキングス研究所ハッチンス財政・金融政策センターのクリス・ヒューズ非常勤フェローは、一連の改革によってＦＲＢの総資産は現在の約６兆８０００億ドルから約４兆５００億ドルまで縮小が可能になると指摘。金融システム内の準備預金残高も現在の約３兆ドルから約１兆ドル程度まで減少すると算定した。

ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長がバランスシートの縮小を重視し、その実現策を検討する作業部会を設置したことから、今こそ大胆な制度改革を検討すべき時期だと論文は主張する。

ヒューズ氏は「ＦＲＢの運営システムを見直す機会はそう多くない。この機会を無駄にすべきではない」と力説した。

さらに改革が実現すれば「ＦＲＢの資産規模の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比は２００８年以降で最も小さくなり、銀行に支払う利息も約３分の１程度まで減る」と説明した。ＦＲＢは近年、保有資産に対する利払い負担の増加により前例のない赤字状態に陥っている。

提案の柱となるのは、現在の「潤沢な準備預金」制度からの転換だ。この制度では、ＦＲＢが金融システムに大量の資金を供給し、複雑な政策手段と定期的な資産購入を通じて短期金利を誘導している。

ヒューズ氏はこれに代えて、市場の資金需要に応じて流動性を機動的に供給する「弾力的準備預金」という新制度を打ち出した。

潤沢な準備預金制度は約２０年前の世界金融危機後に構築され、ＦＲＢはゼロ近辺まで引き下げた政策金利を補完するため大規模な債券購入を実施し、景気刺激と市場安定化を図った。新型コロナウイルス禍でも大規模な資産購入を行い、保有資産は１兆ドル未満から２２年には９兆ドルまで拡大。その後は保有債券の縮小を進めている。

一方、現在のＦＲＢ当局者の多くは、資産規模は大きいものの潤沢な準備預金制度は実際の市場環境で有効に機能していると考えている。また多額の現金を保有する銀行の方が金融不安時への耐性が高いとの見方も少なくない。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は９月２２日の講演で「現在の制度は金利コントロールと主要金融市場の円滑な機能維持に極めて効果的であることが証明されている」と発言した。

ただ大規模な資産保有に批判的な立場のウォーシュ氏らの見解では、ＦＲＢによる国債や住宅ローン担保証券（ＭＢＳ）の大量保有が金融市場をゆがめるほか、長期金利形成への関与を強め過ぎているとされる。もっともウォーシュ氏自身も、現在の制度は長年かけて構築されたものであり、短期間では変更できないと認めている。

ヒューズ氏は論文で「金融政策の有効な運営に大規模で固定的な準備預金残高は必要ではない。より小規模な恒常的準備預金を、柔軟な融資制度で補完することで十分対応できる」と訴えた。

そのためＦＲＢが市場への資金供給を減らす場合には、適格金融機関へ迅速に資金を供給する常設レポ制度について利用上限を撤廃し、準備預金への付利金利を上回る金利を設定すべきだと提言した。また幅広い担保を対象に４カ月物資金を入札方式で供給する新たな「期間流動性ファシリティー」を創設する案も示した。

さらに緊急融資手段である窓口貸出の維持や、ＦＲＢ保有資産を長期債中心から短期国債中心へ移行させる必要性に言及し、政策運営の目標金利についてはフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利ではなく、担保付翌日物調達金利（ＳＯＦＲ）を採用するよう求めた。

ヒューズ氏はこうした新たな流動性供給制度の導入と並行して、銀行規制の見直しや財務省によるＦＲＢ当座預金口座の運用変更などを通じ、金融機関の準備預金需要そのものを引き下げる必要性も強調。「新たな流動性供給制度と準備預金需要を抑制する政策は相互補完的な関係にあり、どちらか一方だけでは恒久的なバランスシート縮小は実現できない」と付け加えた。

ＦＲＢの作業部会に対しては、単なる選択肢の列挙ではなく、資産縮小に向けた具体的な工程表を示すよう促し「運営システムの刷新には複数の政策手段と権限が関わるため、議長の強いリーダーシップが不可欠だ」と述べ、必要なら議会による法制化も選択肢になるとの考えを示した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[２１日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が保有資産を大幅に縮小するために...
items.body:
ＦＲＢ、銀行向け流動性供給見直しで資産の大幅縮小可能＝シンクタンク提言
8:21 配信

ワシントンの米連邦準備理事会。２025年9月撮影。 REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Michael S. Derby

[２１日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が保有資産を大幅に縮小するためには、銀行に対する流動性供給の枠組みを見直し、必要に応じて資金を供給する新たな制度を導入するとともに、銀行の手元資金保有に関する規制を緩和することだ－－。米シンクタンクのブルッキングス研究所が新たな論文でこうした見解を示した。

論文を執筆したブルッキングス研究所ハッチンス財政・金融政策センターのクリス・ヒューズ非常勤フェローは、一連の改革によってＦＲＢの総資産は現在の約６兆８０００億ドルから約４兆５００億ドルまで縮小が可能になると指摘。金融システム内の準備預金残高も現在の約３兆ドルから約１兆ドル程度まで減少すると算定した。

ＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長がバランスシートの縮小を重視し、その実現策を検討する作業部会を設置したことから、今こそ大胆な制度改革を検討すべき時期だと論文は主張する。

ヒューズ氏は「ＦＲＢの運営システムを見直す機会はそう多くない。この機会を無駄にすべきではない」と力説した。

さらに改革が実現すれば「ＦＲＢの資産規模の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比は２００８年以降で最も小さくなり、銀行に支払う利息も約３分の１程度まで減る」と説明した。ＦＲＢは近年、保有資産に対する利払い負担の増加により前例のない赤字状態に陥っている。

提案の柱となるのは、現在の「潤沢な準備預金」制度からの転換だ。この制度では、ＦＲＢが金融システムに大量の資金を供給し、複雑な政策手段と定期的な資産購入を通じて短期金利を誘導している。

ヒューズ氏はこれに代えて、市場の資金需要に応じて流動性を機動的に供給する「弾力的準備預金」という新制度を打ち出した。

潤沢な準備預金制度は約２０年前の世界金融危機後に構築され、ＦＲＢはゼロ近辺まで引き下げた政策金利を補完するため大規模な債券購入を実施し、景気刺激と市場安定化を図った。新型コロナウイルス禍でも大規模な資産購入を行い、保有資産は１兆ドル未満から２２年には９兆ドルまで拡大。その後は保有債券の縮小を進めている。

一方、現在のＦＲＢ当局者の多くは、資産規模は大きいものの潤沢な準備預金制度は実際の市場環境で有効に機能していると考えている。また多額の現金を保有する銀行の方が金融不安時への耐性が高いとの見方も少なくない。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は９月２２日の講演で「現在の制度は金利コントロールと主要金融市場の円滑な機能維持に極めて効果的であることが証明されている」と発言した。

ただ大規模な資産保有に批判的な立場のウォーシュ氏らの見解では、ＦＲＢによる国債や住宅ローン担保証券（ＭＢＳ）の大量保有が金融市場をゆがめるほか、長期金利形成への関与を強め過ぎているとされる。もっともウォーシュ氏自身も、現在の制度は長年かけて構築されたものであり、短期間では変更できないと認めている。

ヒューズ氏は論文で「金融政策の有効な運営に大規模で固定的な準備預金残高は必要ではない。より小規模な恒常的準備預金を、柔軟な融資制度で補完することで十分対応できる」と訴えた。

そのためＦＲＢが市場への資金供給を減らす場合には、適格金融機関へ迅速に資金を供給する常設レポ制度について利用上限を撤廃し、準備預金への付利金利を上回る金利を設定すべきだと提言した。また幅広い担保を対象に４カ月物資金を入札方式で供給する新たな「期間流動性ファシリティー」を創設する案も示した。

さらに緊急融資手段である窓口貸出の維持や、ＦＲＢ保有資産を長期債中心から短期国債中心へ移行させる必要性に言及し、政策運営の目標金利についてはフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利ではなく、担保付翌日物調達金利（ＳＯＦＲ）を採用するよう求めた。

ヒューズ氏はこうした新たな流動性供給制度の導入と並行して、銀行規制の見直しや財務省によるＦＲＢ当座預金口座の運用変更などを通じ、金融機関の準備預金需要そのものを引き下げる必要性も強調。「新たな流動性供給制度と準備預金需要を抑制する政策は相互補完的な関係にあり、どちらか一方だけでは恒久的なバランスシート縮小は実現できない」と付け加えた。

ＦＲＢの作業部会に対しては、単なる選択肢の列挙ではなく、資産縮小に向けた具体的な工程表を示すよう促し「運営システムの刷新には複数の政策手段と権限が関わるため、議長の強いリーダーシップが不可欠だ」と述べ、必要なら議会による法制化も選択肢になるとの考えを示した。

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro coloca condições para abrir sigilos e Lula aceita
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), respondeu nesta quarta-feira a um desafio de seu adversário na disputa eleitoral, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), para que abrisse seu sigilo, apresentando uma série de condições para disponibilizar os dados, termos aceitos pelo petista pouco depois.
items.body:
O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), respondeu nesta quarta-feira a um desafio de seu adversário na disputa eleitoral, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), para que abrisse seu sigilo, apresentando uma série de condições para disponibilizar os dados, termos aceitos pelo petista pouco depois.
As exigências de Flávio foram apresentadas nesta quarta ao ministro André Mendonça no âmbito do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), em resposta a desafio feito por Lula no debate da TV Band, no último domingo, para que os dois abrissem seus sigilos.
Na terça-feira, Lula já havia entregado à Justiça Eleitoral documento autorizando a quebra de sigilo dele, da esposa Janja e de seus cinco filhos, além de uma empresa, a L.I.L.S. Palestras, Eventos e Publicações Ltda, caso Flávio também autorizasse a quebra de seus sigilos.
Na petição encaminhada por sua equipe jurídica, Flávio pede, entre outros pontos, que Lula levante os sigilos telefônicos e telemáticos de assessores, auxiliares e seguranças, incluindo seu ex-chefe de gabinete, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, conhecido como Marcola.
O coordenador político da campanha petista, Camilo Santana, disse que o presidente vai acatar as exigências.
"De todos os condicionantes que ele (Flávio) colocou, o presidente (Lula) não se opõe a absolutamente nada. Contanto que ele cumpra que o presidente colocou no TSE", disse Camilo a jornalistas.
"Amanhã, 11 da manhã, estaremos no TSE para protocolar a resposta do presidente e é o prazo que ele (Flávio) vai ter também para estar lá pra abrir também todo o sigilo dele. Porque também não dá para deixar para depois da eleição", acrescentou Santana.
OUTRAS DEMANDAS A petição de Flávio diz que o senador "não tem absolutamente nada a esconder e autoriza o levantamento de seus sigilos bancário, fiscal e telefônico relativos aos últimos 20 (vinte) anos, bem como dos familiares citados pelo candidato adversário e de todas as pessoas jurídicas das quais é sócio ou administrador".
Dentre as demandas apresentadas por Flávio para abrir seus dados, também está a exigência de que as contas das empresas dos filhos de Lula, assim como do Instituto Lula, sejam abertas, incluindo "pessoas próximas que receberam recursos do Instituto Lula e da L.I.L.S. Palestras, Eventos e Publicações Ltda." desde 2003, o que inclui a esposa de Fábio Luís Lula da Silva.
A lista de condições também pede que Lula levante os sigilos do governo relacionados a gastos com cartão corporativo da Presidência da República, a agenda da primeira-dama, o uso de helicópteros da FAB e gastos do Palácio da Alvorada, residência do presidente da República.

items.title: AstraZeneca says FDA approves drug for rare kidney disease in adults
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: AstraZeneca said on Wednesday the US Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval for its treatment for adults with immunoglobulin A nephropathy, a rare kidney disease that can lead to renal failure.
items.body:
AstraZeneca (AZN.L) said on Wednesday the US Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval for its treatment for adults with immunoglobulin A nephropathy, a rare kidney disease that can lead to renal failure.
Here are more details:
AstraZeneca said the treatment Ultomiris reduced proteinuria — excess protein in the urine — by 43.4% compared with placebo after 34 weeks in an interim analysis of the late-stage trial
The drugmaker said the FDA granted the approval under its accelerated pathway, and that the ongoing trial will continue through 106 weeks to determine whether Ultomiris slows loss of kidney function to support traditional approval
The company also said the drug was the first and only approved C5 inhibitor for the disease, targeting an immune-system pathway linked to kidney inflammation
AstraZeneca said more than 200,000 people in the United States have the condition, and about half of those with elevated urine protein levels or reduced kidney function are at high risk of kidney failure within 10 years
The company said no new safety concerns were identified in the study and applications are also under review in Japan and other countries

items.title: Britain's MI5 spied on NHS founder Bevan, secret documents show
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British spies monitored Nye Bevan, the much lauded architect of the National Health Service, for three decades because of his links to the Communist Party and criticism of Britain's government in World War Two, newly released papers show.
items.body:
British spies monitored Nye Bevan, the much lauded architect of the National Health Service, for three decades because of his links to the Communist Party and criticism of Britain's government in World War Two, newly released papers show.
Declassified secret documents from MI5 made public by the National Archives on Thursday reveal that Bevan's activities in parliament, and his movements and meetings outside, were closely watched by MI5 from 1933 until his death in 1960.
MI5 had suspected that Bevan, a committed socialist and one of the most prominent parliamentary critics of Winston Churchill and his wartime coalition, was a communist sympathiser.
However, the agency's investigations seem to have determined that there was nothing to worry about.
"What information we have on Bevan's relations with the Communist Party since 1943 show that from time to time both the Communist Party and the Trotskyists have made attempts to get him to work with them without success," a 1955 note said.
Bevan, who died in 1960, became health minister after the war and is credited with founding the state-funded NHS in 1948.
While the one-time Welsh coal miner was heralded for his oratory skills, he was also seen as a highly divisive figure, not just within the Labour Party but the country as whole.
Two years after his death, a review of his MI5 case file stated: "Considering what a controversial character Nye Bevan was, the file is remarkably tame."
The other newly material released also included MI5 files about Wolfgang zu Putlitz, a German diplomat who leaked information about Hitler's plans to Britain, and Soviet agents and suspected operatives such as Frank Bossard who was jailed for 21 years for passing defence material to Russian spies.

items.title: From groceries to home loans, high oil prices permeate daily life
items.author: Seher Dareen, Anushree Mukherjee
items.creator: Seher Dareen, Anushree Mukherjee
items.summary: The shock of oil prices at a five-month high of $110 a barrel and gas prices in Asia and Europe hitting their highest levels since December 2022 is making its mark on household budgets.
items.body:
The shock of oil prices at a five-month high of $110 a barrel and gas prices in [USN:L8N4650OY TEXT:"Asia"] and [USN:L1N4660F0 TEXT:"Europe"] hitting their highest levels since December 2022 is making its mark on household budgets.
As well as raising the costs of transport and heating, it adds to pressure on food, clothing and packaging prices and contributes to elevated levels of inflation and borrowing costs.
The following graphics illustrate some of the ways in which the rally is having an impact on daily life around the world.
The Iran war has already pushed global diesel prices to record highs. Average [USN:L8N45O0OV TEXT:"British"] diesel pump prices hit £2.00 ($2.64) per litre for the first time this month and US prices hit a record of $6.53 a gallon in September.
In response, US President Donald Trump has allowed [USN:L1N45R0NK TEXT:"red-dyed diesel"], which is used in equipment and vehicles that are not usually operated on public roadways and is exempt from highway taxes, to be accessed by anyone until the end of the year.
The impact extends to mortgage rates as energy prices contribute to rising inflation, which major central banks are attempting to rein in by raising interest rates.
[USN:L8N46708O TEXT:"British inflation"] and borrowing rose more than expected last month. The increase in August, which the Office for National Statistics said was due to higher petrol and diesel costs, took inflation to its highest since October 2025.
The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate to a 15-year high last month, leading the country's mostly variable housing loan rates to rise in tandem, weighing on [USN:L1N45M19O TEXT:"home prices"].
When buying a house with an average loan of A$731,000 ($513,966) on a 30-year mortgage, a rise in interest rates from 5.5% in 2025 to 6.2% now raises annual repayments by around A$3,900 ($2,742).
Meanwhile in the United States, mortgage purchase activity has weakened as 30-year mortgage rates climbed from around 6.1% to about 7.5%, increasing borrowing costs for prospective homebuyers. Most people opt for fixed rates.
Other parts of household budgets also suffer, particularly those relying on heating oil for winter.
In the state of New York, heating bills will likely rise by 47% from last year, National Energy Assistance Directors Association data shows.
In Britain, where gas is the main fuel used for heating, households could see a 10% year-on-year rise in bills this quarter, EnergyUK estimates.
Since most plastics are made from oil or natural gas and then converted into polymers for making everything from bottles to sneakers, as well as polyester fabric for clothing, the increase in crude prices is having a wider effect.
For common grocery items, packaging of any type, whether plastic, paper or glass, typically represents 5% to 15% of a product's manufacturing cost, according to consultancy MAT .
US plastic prices rose 7% in August versus October 2025. In the US, [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer prices"] accelerated in September, with a surge in gasoline prices accounting for more than half of the rise.
Global [USN:L4N45Z033 TEXT:"food inflation"] is poised to accelerate further and persist well into 2027 on shipping disruptions and higher costs for fertiliser, which is also made from natural gas, data from the United Nations' Food and Agriculture Organization showed.
($1 = 1.4223 Australian dollars)
items.raw_description: The shock of oil prices at a five-month high of $110 a barrel and gas prices in Asia and Europe hitting their highest levels since December 2022 is making its mark on household budgets.

items.title: Hall of Fame coach Bob Huggins battling progressive cognitive condition
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hall of Fame basketball coach Bob Huggins is living with a progressive cognitive condition that is affecting his memory and other areas of his daily life, his family announced Wednesday.
items.body:
Hall of Fame basketball coach Bob Huggins is living with a progressive cognitive condition that is affecting his memory and other areas of his daily life, his family announced Wednesday.
The revelation comes two days before Huggins is set to be inducted into the University of Cincinnati's James P. Kelly Athletics Hall of Fame.
Huggins, 73, coached the Bearcats from 1989-2005 and made 14 consecutive NCAA Tournament appearances. Cincinnati made the Final Four in 1992.
"Bob is living with a progressive cognitive condition that has begun to affect his memory, and aspects of his daily life," the Huggins family said in a statement. While the family has chosen to keep this matter private over the past several months, they believe this is an appropriate time to share the news with the many people who have supported Bob throughout his remarkable career, particularly as he prepares to be honored with induction into the University of Cincinnati's James P. Kelly Athletics Hall of Fame."
Huggins was inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 2022. He won 935 games over 41 seasons and also spent 16 seasons at West Virginia (2007-23), one at Kansas State (2006-07), five at Akron (1984-89) and three at Walsh University (1980-83) in Ohio.
Huggins also made the 2010 Final Four at West Virginia during one of 11 NCAA Tournament appearances at that school.
Still, Huggins is most associated with his stay at Cincinnati. He holds the Bearcats' record of 399 coaching victories and the team reached No. 1 under Huggins in both the 1996-97 and 1999-2000 seasons. The 1999-2000 team was No. 1 in the country for 12 weeks.
He was forced out at Cincinnati prior to the 2005-06 season after being arrested for a DUI in 2004.
"Bob is deeply grateful for the tremendous honor being bestowed upon him by the University of Cincinnati," a joint statement from the family and Cincinnati said. "His years leading the Bearcats represent an unforgettable chapter in his life, filled with cherished relationships, remarkable accomplishments, and memories that will always hold a special place in his heart. He's looking forward to returning to Cincinnati this weekend, celebrating with former players and friends, and sharing in a moment that recognizes not only his accomplishments, but also the enduring bonds formed along the way."
The university also offered support for the family as it deals with the situation and upcoming challenges.
"Cincinnati Athletics is excited to welcome Coach Bob Huggins and his family back to campus this weekend for his induction into the James P. Kelly Athletics Hall of Fame," the statement said. "Coach Huggins is undoubtedly one of the greatest coaches in college basketball history. He restored Cincinnati basketball to national prominence, ignited a passion for the Bearcats throughout our city and left an indelible mark on generations of student-athletes. We extend our heartfelt support to Coach Huggins and his family as they navigate this next chapter together."
In June 2023, Huggins was arrested on another DUI charge and subsequently resigned from West Virginia and announced his retirement.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ＮＺ第3四半期ＣＰＩ、前年比＋3.7％　来週の利上げ観測残る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lucy Craymer

[ウェリントン ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lucy Craymer

[ウェリントン ２２日 ロイター] - ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）統計局が２２日発表した第３・四半期の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率は前年同期比３．７％に鈍化し、市場予想を下回った。ただ、ＮＺ準備銀行（中央銀行）の目標レンジ上限を引き続き上回り、来週の利上げ観測が強まった。 

前期比では０．７％上昇した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は、前年同期比３．８％上昇、前期比０．８％上昇だった。

ＮＺ中銀は、中期的な年間インフレ率の目標を１─３％としている。

ＣＰＩが予想を下回ったことを受け、ＮＺドルは０．５６９２米ドルに下落した。

統計局によると、インフレへの寄与が最も大きかったのはガソリン価格だった。第２・四半期からは値下がりしたものの、物価を押し上げた。住宅建設費も上昇した。

接戦となっている１１月７日の総選挙を前に、インフレが主要な争点となっている。景気低迷と歴史的な高インフレに不満を募らせる有権者が負担軽減を求める中、各政党はさまざまな政策対応を打ち出している。

今回のＣＰＩは中銀予想の前年同期比３．９％上昇も下回った。来週の金融政策見直しを前に発表される最後の主要経済指標となる。

中銀はインフレ率を目標レンジの中央値に戻すため、今年に入り２回利上げし、政策金利は２．７５％となっている。

市場は現在、来週の追加利上げの確率を９８％織り込み、２０２７年２月末までの計５０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを完全に織り込んでいる。

ウエストパックＮＺのシニアエコノミスト、サティシュ・ランチョッド氏は、今回の結果は中銀予想を下回ったものの、コアインフレが根強いことから中銀は来週の政策見直しに向けて慎重な検討を迫られるだろうと指摘。「市場の織り込みや見方は１０月の利上げで一致してきた。金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）も、それを最も抵抗の少ない選択肢と見なすのではないか」と語った。

非貿易財のインフレ率は前年比３．３％と、第２・四半期の３．４％から鈍化した。一方、第３・四半期の貿易財のインフレ率は４．３％だった。

燃料価格が再び上昇しているため、エコノミストは第４・四半期にインフレ率が再加速すると予想している。

ＡＳＢ銀行は年末までにインフレ率が４．５％に上昇すると予想。リポートで、２７年のインフレ率の推移も、中銀が９月に示した予測を「かなり上回りそうだ」と指摘した。

items.title: Brazil's Bolsonaro sets terms for records release after Lula's disclosure challenge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian presidential candidate Senator Flavio Bolsonaro imposed conditions on Wednesday to disclose his bank, tax and telephone records after a challenge from President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, his opponent in Sunday's election runoff.
items.body:
Brazilian presidential candidate Senator Flavio Bolsonaro imposed conditions on Wednesday to disclose his bank, tax and telephone records after a challenge from President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, his opponent in Sunday's election runoff.
The challenge has become a new battlefront in what polls portray as a strongly contested election, with the candidates seeking to convince voters of their transparency and integrity, and their rival's lack of it, in the last days of the campaign.
Lula's [USN:L6N46611M TEXT:"campaign submitted"] on Tuesday to Brazil's electoral court a document authorizing the release of personal data including his own bank, tax and telephone records, as well as those of his family members, if Flavio followed suit.
The challenge included legal entities in which the candidates are partners or directors.
In a response to the court, Bolsonaro's campaign authorized the release of the data requested by Lula, but only if the president expands his own pledges to include advisors, security staff and records from companies held by Lula's children.
Camilo Santana, a senator and representative of Lula's campaign, told journalists that Lula agreed with the new demands, and that the campaign would file an official response with the court on Thursday morning.
Bolsonaro, who [USN:S0N45F029 TEXT:"narrowly leads"] Lula in polls, is under investigation over alleged corruption and money laundering related to an investment he allegedly sought from a banker, who is jailed and accused of fraud, to help finance a film about his father, ex-president Jair Bolsonaro.
The senator has acknowledged seeking funding but denies any wrongdoing. He is also under investigation in a separate probe over alleged money laundering.
Brazil's Supreme Court has authorized an investigation into Fabio Luis Lula da Silva, one of Lula's sons, over alleged influence peddling and corruption tied to Health Ministry dealings, as well as a separate pension-fraud probe.
Lula's son denies the allegations and the president has said his son would be treated like any other citizen.

items.title: Republicans fly past former spending caps nixed by US Supreme Court
items.author: John Kruzel
items.creator: John Kruzel
items.summary: Since the US Supreme Court in June struck down federal caps on political party spending with input from candidates, Republican committees have surged past the former limits by more than $126 million while their Democratic counterparts have topped them by more than $46 million ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
items.body:
Since the US Supreme Court in June [USN:L1N4310Y4 TEXT:"struck down"] federal caps on political party spending with input from candidates, Republican committees have surged past the former limits by more than $126 million while their Democratic counterparts have topped them by more than $46 million ahead of the November 3 midterm elections .
President Donald Trump 's fellow Republicans are seeking to retain control of Congress in the midterms. Coordinated spending by Republican and Democratic committees from July through September was nearly eight times what they spent during the same months of the last [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"] in 2022.
Republican and Democratic committees supporting candidates in races for the House of Representatives and Senate disclosed their coordinated spending totals for September in filings on Tuesday night to the Federal Election Commission.
In July, August and September — the three months since the court's ruling — the Republican committees poured a total of about $137 million of coordinated spending into House and Senate races across the country, according to their filings. Their Democratic counterparts spent a total of around $55 million during this period in coordinated spending, the filings showed.
Justice Elena Kagan, one of the nine-member court's three liberals, in remarks on Tuesday [USN:L1N46700J TEXT:"criticized"] its conservative majority for failing to appreciate the real-world impact of striking down coordinated spending limits.
"The people of America look around this political system and think that all this money, chasing all these political candidates, is a nightmare, and they're right," Kagan told an audience at Catholic University's law school in Washington.
The Supreme Court, in a 6-3 ruling on June 30 powered by its conservative majority, rejected coordinated-spending restrictions, agreeing with challengers including Trump's Vice President JD Vance that the limits violated the US Constitution's First Amendment protections against government abridgment of freedom of speech.
Republican committees have sought to use newly unlimited coordinated spending to help level the playing field in key races in which individual Democratic candidates had outraised their Republican opponents, according to political analysts.
A NEW FCC POLICY More than two in three dollars of recent coordinated spending, or $129 million, by Republicans and Democrats came in September, when party committees gained access to discounted TV and radio advertising rates long available to political candidates under a new Federal Communications Commission policy.
The FCC, which currently has a 2-1 Republican majority, extended its so-called "lowest unit charge" rule in March to include party committees, a move seen as a boost to Republicans.
The Supreme Court twice intervened in recent weeks to stymie challenges to the FCC policy brought by Democratic candidates, handing a legal victory to Republican committees, whose coordinated spending in September was around two-thirds higher than that of their Democratic counterparts.
The National Republican Senatorial Committee, or NRSC, was one of the challengers in the case decided in June by the Supreme Court. It supports Republican Senate candidates, while the National Republican Congressional Committee, or NRCC, supports the party's House candidates. Both can accept funding from the Republican National Committee.
These three national Republican committees ended September with about $187 million in cash and $20 million in debt, according to FEC filings. Their Democratic counterparts held roughly $100 million and carried nearly $15 million in debt.
A 1971 US law called the Federal Election Campaign Act imposed contribution limits and other restrictions on campaign spending, with the aim of preventing corruption. Under it, spending by a political party to advocate for or against a candidate that was not coordinated with a candidate's campaign was considered an "independent expenditure" — and was not subject to a cap.
Spending coordinated between a party and a campaign was restricted. Before the Supreme Court's ruling, the 2026 limits had ranged from $130,600 to about $4.1 million for Senate candidates and from $65,300 to $130,600 for House candidates, depending on a state's population.

items.summary: US pipeline operator Kinder Morgan said on Wednesday it has approved a total of $4.7 billion as its share of investments in two major natural gas pipeline joint ventures, citing rising demand from power plants, data centers and LNG exporters.
items.body:
US pipeline operator Kinder Morgan (KMI.N) said on Wednesday it has approved a total of $4.7 billion as its share of investments in two major natural gas pipeline joint ventures, citing rising demand from power plants, data centers and LNG exporters.
The projects helped lift Kinder Morgan's natural-gas project backlog to a record level, underscoring the industry's efforts to expand infrastructure to serve the new demand.
Shares of the company rose 2.7% in extended trading after it also beat estimates for quarterly profits.
Kinder Morgan would invest about $3.1 billion in Southern Natural Gas' Southeast Connector project and $1.6 billion in Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America's (NGPL) Permian Link project.
The Southeast Connector project would transport up to 2.6 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of natural gas through about 470 miles of new pipeline to growing markets in the US Southeast.
The Permian Link is designed to transport roughly 2.8 Bcf/d of natural gas from the Permian Basin near Pecos County, Texas, to NGPL's Midcontinent system through about 434 miles of new pipeline.
The approvals lifted Kinder Morgan's project backlog to $14.4 billion, including a record $13.2 billion of natural gas projects.
Permian Link will supply gas to power providers serving an investment-grade hyperscale data-center customer, Kinder Morgan said. Executives said on an earnings call that the project had drawn interest from customers beyond the anchor hyperscaler.
The Permian Link is expected to enter service in the third quarter of 2030, while Southeast Connector is expected to start in phases beginning in the fourth quarter of 2030.
The Houston, Texas-based firm posted an adjusted profit of 35 cents per share for the three months ended September 30, compared with analysts' estimate of 32 cents per share, according to data compiled by LSEG.

items.title: Australia's Santos trims 2026 output forecast on Alaska oilfield delays
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Santos narrowed its 2026 production forecast on Thursday after delays due to bad weather and a pipeline disruption at its Pikka oil project in Alaska, even as third-quarter revenue jumped 78%.
items.body:
Santos (STO.AX) narrowed its 2026 production forecast on Thursday after delays due to bad weather and a pipeline disruption at its Pikka oil project in Alaska, even as third-quarter revenue jumped 78%.
Australia's second-largest independent oil and gas producer now expects production of 99 million to 102 million barrels of oil equivalent (mmboe) in 2026, compared with its [USN:L4N43O2HD TEXT:"previous projection of 99 to 105 mmboe"].
Its sales volume forecast was also narrowed to 102 to 105 mmboe, from 102 to 108 mmboe.
Santos said its full-year outlook took a hit due to delays in commissioning a seawater treatment plant at Pikka, output curtailments following a weather event, and a shutdown of the Kuparuk pipeline after a road accident.
The company said the output at Pikka would be held at around 70,000 barrels per day for a short period before ramping up toward 80,000 barrels per day.
But third-quarter sales revenue rose to $2.01 billion from $1.13 billion a year earlier, matching estimates compiled by Visible Alpha.
Santos' third-quarter production climbed 23% to a record 26.3 mmboe, boosted by its Barossa LNG project in Australia reaching steady production and the ramp-up of output at Pikka. Sales revenue also benefited from higher realised LNG prices and higher sales volumes from Barossa.

items.title: 中国系ハッカー集団、ＡＩ使いコネクトワイズにサイバー攻撃
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２１日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは２１日、中国系ハッカー集団「ストーム―０９４０」が人工知能（ＡＩ）による侵入テストツール「ＡＲＴＥＸ（アルテックス）」を使い、ＩＴサービス企業コネクトワイズへのサイバー攻撃を実行したと発表した。

コネクトワイズはコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかったものの、今月１６日にホームページで「『コネクトワイズ・クラウド・バックアップ』の環境に関する最近の不正アクセスの試みについて調査中である」との声明を出していた。

米首都ワシントンの駐米中国大使館はコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。中国政府はサイバー攻撃によるデータ窃取や、行為の容認についてこれまで否定してきた。

侵入テストは本来、ネットワークやサービスのセキュリティーを検証する正当な手法であり、複数のツールを用いて実施されている。マイクロソフトによると、アルテックスではユーザーが任意のＡＩモデルを使ってさまざまな侵入テスト作業を自動化できるほか、偵察やデータ持ち出しなどの自律的なタスクを実行するように設定することも可能だ。

「ストーム―０９４０」の攻撃は、航空宇宙や防衛、自動車、化学、エネルギー、金融サービス、政府機関、法律、製造、メディア、軍事、半導体、ソフトウエア、テクノロジー、シンクタンク、非営利団体（ＮＰＯ）などの幅広い分野を標的としていたと説明している。

マイクロソフトによると、「ストーム―０９４０」の大部分の攻撃は成功しなかったものの、攻撃先の多くでクリーンアップ作業後も続けられる高レベルのアクセス権を確保することに成功した。

items.title: Philippines exploring deeper cooperation with Taiwan to protect cables
items.author: David Brunnstrom
items.creator: David Brunnstrom
items.summary: The Philippines is exploring deeper cooperation with Taiwan on protecting undersea cables and addressing "gray-zone" activity, despite Manila's one-China policy, which recognizes Beijing and not Taipei, a Philippine diplomat said on Wednesday.
items.body:
The Philippines is exploring deeper cooperation with Taiwan on protecting undersea cables and addressing "gray-zone" activity, despite Manila's one-China policy, which recognizes Beijing and not Taipei, a Philippine diplomat said on Wednesday.
The Philippines and Taiwan have repeatedly complained about Chinese activities designed to pressure the countries without direct confrontation. China claims Taiwan as its own territory and has overlapping claims with both Taiwan and the Philippines in the South China Sea.
Felipe F. Carino III, Manila's deputy chief of mission in Washington, told a seminar this "pragmatic and practical approach" with Taiwan was necessary to protect mutual interests in the Bashi Channel between Taiwan and the Philippines.
Speaking to Washington's Center for a New American Security, Carino linked cable security to South China Sea tensions, but did not mention China by name.
He said security of undersea cables was vital given that they carried nearly all intercontinental data flows "and that 60-67% of cyber incidents happen in our region."
"These are very important features that should be protected, so much so that we are exploring deeper cooperation with our friends in Taiwan," Carino said, adding that the Philippines was doing so "notwithstanding our one China policy."
He said the Philippines and Taiwan were exploring "practical and more pragmatic approaches in cooperation, including knowledge-sharing and capacity building" and added: "We see this cooperation leading towards ... addressing the gray-zone issues in our part of the world."
Asked if this cooperation could include joint patrols or accountability for vessels that disrupt communications, Carino said he did not have details, but said: "I'm sure that this is a constantly evolving cooperation, and some of the things that you mentioned may be actually coming to fruition."
Taipei has stepped up efforts to protect undersea communications links, which are vital to the island's connections to the rest of the world, after several incidents involving cables and China-linked vessels.
This month, the Philippines' coast guard said it had deployed its largest vessel and an aircraft to challenge a Chinese research ship operating off northern Batanes province [USN:L6N45N0JJ TEXT:"near undersea cable corridors"].
At the same seminar, Andrea Yang, Taiwan's deputy representative in Washington, referred to the [USN:L4N3SF0G1 TEXT:"jailing in Taiwan of a Chinese ship captain"] over damage to an undersea cable. She said Taiwan would put more resources into developing unmanned systems to improve maritime surveillance.
Yang said interference with undersea cables was an issue that should be taken up by the United Nations, which should consider mechanisms to prevent "bad behavior."

items.title: ロシアが米民主党候補標的の偽情報工作、国家情報長官から説明と有力議員
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jonathan Landay

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jonathan Landay

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米議会上下両院の情報特別委員会でそれぞれ野党民主党トップを務めるマーク・ワーナー上院議員とジム・ハイムズ下院議員は２１日、ロシアが来月の中間選挙に出馬する民主党候補を標的に偽情報キャンペーンを展開しているとの説明を情報当局から受けたと明らかにした。

ワーナー氏とハイムズ氏は記者団に、自ら要請した選挙安全保障に関してクレイトン国家情報長官から説明されたと述べた。ただ内容は機密指定されているため詳細は公にできないという。

ただ両氏は、ロシアは米情報機関が２０１６年、２０年、２４年の各選挙で確認した活動と同様のオンラインでの偽情報工作を行っていると指摘した。

ワーナー氏は「現在の状況は過去と同様にロシアが民主党を標的にしているということだ」と語った。

またワーナー氏は、南部テキサス州の上院議員選挙に出馬している民主党のジェームズ・タラリコ氏や、同じ南部のジョージア州選出で再選を目指すジョン・オソフ上院議員が、人工知能（ＡＩ）で生成された偽広告による攻撃を受けているとの報道にも言及した。

ホワイトハウスと国家情報長官室はコメント要請に回答せず、在米ロシア大使館もコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。ロシア政府はこれまでも米選挙への介入を否定している。

一方ハイムズ氏は、ロシアが拡散している偽情報の具体的内容については機密情報のため説明できないとしながらも、その手法は「いつもと同じだ」と述べた上で「ロシアはあらゆる情報をばらまいている。混乱を生み出し、投票機器を信用するなと訴えている」と非難した。

さらに、中国も過去と同様に有権者へ影響を与えるための「極めて標的を絞った」活動を続けている可能性を否定する理由はないと付け加えた。

在米中国大使館もコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。中国政府も従来、米選挙への介入を否定している。

ワーナー氏とハイムズ氏は、トランプ大統領が投票インフラへの外国勢力によるハッキングを主張するなど、選挙結果に異議を唱える可能性に懸念を表明。これに関連してハイムズ氏は、外国政府が米国の選挙システムに侵入して結果を改ざんできることを示す証拠は存在しないと強調した。

items.title: Gilmore: US Has Made a ‘180 Degree’ Shift on Ukraine
items.summary: Jim Gilmore, former Virginia governor, RNC chair and ambassador to the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe, says the US has made a dramatic reversal in its policy toward Ukraine and argues Americans deserve an explanation for the shift. He also says a plan involving Russian diesel and oil would put money into Russian pockets. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Meta crea acciones sin voto para Zuckerberg ante posible impuesto al patrimonio en California
items.author: Pierre Paulden
items.summary: El acuerdo contempla que Zuckerberg permanezca en la jurisdicción donde Meta tenga su sede mientras ocupe un cargo directivo a tiempo completo. La empresa emitirá acciones sin derecho a voto que podrá ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ) firmó un acuerdo con Mark Zuckerberg para que este siga residiendo en la misma jurisdicción en la que se encuentra la sede central de la empresa, después de que el CEO manifestara que estaba barajando la posibilidad de marcharse de California si el estado aprobara un impuesto sobre el patrimonio. Zuckerberg “seguirá siendo residente en California, o en cualquier otra jurisdicción en la que la empresa mantenga su sede central, durante ocho años”, indicó Meta en un documento presentado este miércoles. Meta señaló que Zuckerberg estaba considerando marcharse de California porque el impuesto sobre el patrimonio propuesto podría suponerle una factura de varios miles de millones de dólares, lo que podría obligarle a vender acciones con derecho a voto para pagarla. Ver más: Meta eleva su previsión de gasto y anuncia una nueva clase de acciones en sus resultados trimestrales La empresa anunció que emitiría acciones de Clase C en una operación diseñada, en parte, para evitar ese desenlace. Zuckerberg obtendrá acciones sin derecho a voto que podrá vender para obtener liquidez sin reducir su control de voto. A cambio, se ha comprometido a permanecer en California —o dondequiera que Meta tenga su sede— durante ocho años, mientras siga desempeñando un cargo directivo a tiempo completo. Los votantes de California se pronunciarán sobre la medida el próximo mes, la cual afectará a aquellas personas cuyo patrimonio neto supere los mil millones de dólares a 1 de enero de 2026. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Australia's CSL faces investor proceeding over disclosure obligations
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: CSL said on Thursday it had been hit with a shareholder class action in Victoria's Supreme Court, alleging the Australian biotech giant breached its continuous disclosure obligations over financial forecasts.
items.body:
CSL (CSL.AX) said on Thursday it had been hit with a shareholder class action in Victoria's Supreme Court, alleging the Australian biotech giant breached its continuous disclosure obligations over financial forecasts.
The class action, filed by law firm Echo Law, was commenced on behalf of investors who acquired certain CSL securities between February 11, 2025, and May 11, 2026.
"The allegations relate to the company's medium-term and FY26 guidance, both of which were retracted or downgraded during the claim period, and the reasonableness of the guidance in the context of changes to market conditions for immunoglobulin and albumin products in 2024 and 2025," Echo Law said in a statement on its website.
CSL said it denied any liability and would defend the proceeding.

items.body:
Phoebe Seers　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ロンドン／パリ ２１日 ロイター] - 欧州の金融規制当局は、米グーグルのクラウドコンピューティングサービスで障害が発生し、数百万の銀行顧客が数時間にわたって主要な金融サービスを利用できなくなった問題を巡り、同社に説明を求めている。

欧州銀行監督機構（ＥＢＡ）の報道担当者はロイターに、障害の詳細や影響について把握して欧州連合（ＥＵ）域内の金融機関への影響を評価するため、グーグル・クラウドと連絡を取っていると明らかにした。

グーグル親会社アルファベット によると、障害は欧州の顧客向けサービスを支えるロンドンのネットワーク施設で起きた電源トラブルが原因で、数時間続いた。影響を受けた金融機関にはデジタル専業銀行レボリュートのほか、ロイズ・バンキング・グループ 、ＨＳＢＣ が含まれる。

ＨＳＢＣとロイズはコメントしていない。

グーグルの広報担当者は「欧州西部第２リージョンにある第三者施設で発生した電源トラブルにより、グーグル・クラウドのサービスに障害が発生したが、現在は復旧している。今後、公開のステータスダッシュボードで原因分析を公表する」と述べた。

英国で約１３００万人の顧客を抱えるレボリュートの利用者向けサイトによると、ログインやカード決済、現金引き出しなど幅広いサービスに影響が及んだ。

レボリュートは声明で、今後の第三者サービス障害による影響を軽減するため今回の事案を検証しているとし、顧客の資金やデータの安全性に問題はなかったと説明した。

ＥＵは昨年、金融セクターにとって重要な第三者技術プロバイダーとして１９社を指定し、ＥＢＡを含む３つの金融規制当局による共同監督の対象とした。英国も同様に、主要供給事業者の障害が複数の金融機関に同時に影響を及ぼすリスクを理由に、４つのクラウド事業者を監督対象に指定している。グーグル・クラウドはＥＵと英国の両方の枠組みで対象となっている。

ＥＢＡは電子メールによるコメントで「重要第三者プロバイダーの指定はＥＵレベルの監督体制を構築するものだが、障害対応の責任をプロバイダーから移すものではなく、金融機関自身の規制上の義務を軽減するものでもない」と述べた。

英国では議会の財務委員会がイングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、中央銀行）と金融行為監督機構（ＦＣＡ）に対し、今回の障害への対応状況や影響規模、利用者に生じた経済的損害について説明を求める書簡を送付した。

ＦＣＡは今回の障害についてグーグルと協議していると明らかにした。英国の重要第三者プロバイダー制度の下では、グーグル・クラウドのような指定事業者は重大な障害についてＦＣＡおよびイングランド銀行へ報告する義務を負う。

ＢＯＥの広報担当者はコメントを拒否した。

ＥＵと英国の規制では、いずれも銀行は顧客に提供するサービスについて最終的な責任を負っており、第三者プロバイダーに依存する場合でもその責任は変わらない。

items.title: New World screwworm cases confirmed in cow in New Mexico, wildlife in Texas, officials say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The New Mexico Department of Agriculture said on Wednesday that it had confirmed a case of New World screwworm in a beef cow.
items.body:
The New Mexico Department of Agriculture said on Wednesday that it had confirmed a case of New World screwworm in a beef cow.
The department said it is continuing to expand surveillance around affected locations to identify any additional cases and determine whether the pest has spread beyond the affected animals
"We are working closely with our state and federal partners to investigate these cases, increase surveillance and monitor for additional infestations," Samantha Holeck, state veterinarian with the New Mexico Livestock Board, said in a statement
The news came after the US Department of Agriculture said earlier in the day that it had confirmed the first detection of flesh-eating parasite New World screwworm in US wildlife in an elk in Pecos County, Texas
The elk was located on a game ranch and was reported after being harvested by a hunter, the USDA said in a statement
The Texas Animal Health Commission will modify a previously established infested zone, and the USDA and the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department are conducting additional wildlife surveillance in the area, the USDA said
Eradicated from the US decades ago, the pest has surged north from Central America through Mexico, prompting Washington to impose a more than year-long ban on Mexican cattle imports
The US [USN:L1N45912W TEXT:"halted livestock"] imports from Mexico last year to keep out screwworm but resumed trade in August at an Arizona port as part of a phased reopening plan
The halt tightened US cattle supplies, contributing to a rise in beef prices to record highs for American consumers

items.title: Diplomata sênior dos Emirados Árabes Unidos entra na disputa para secretária-geral da ONU
items.author: Maha Dahan
items.creator: Maha Dahan
items.summary: A diplomata sênior dos Emirados Árabes Unidos Lana Nusseibeh entrou na disputa para se tornar a próxima secretária-geral da Organização das Nações Unidas nesta quarta-feira, trazendo uma candidata de destaque do Oriente Médio para uma disputa que tem enfrentado dificuldades para chegar a um consenso entre os membros mais poderosos do Conselho de Segurança.
items.body:
A diplomata sênior dos Emirados Árabes Unidos Lana Nusseibeh entrou na disputa para se tornar a próxima secretária-geral da Organização das Nações Unidas nesta quarta-feira, trazendo uma candidata de destaque do Oriente Médio para uma disputa que tem enfrentado dificuldades para chegar a um consenso entre os membros mais poderosos do Conselho de Segurança.
Nusseibeh, ex-embaixadora dos Emirados Árabes Unidos na ONU por mais de uma década, disse à Reuters que buscaria restaurar o papel do órgão mundial como mediador diplomático em um momento de crises globais crescentes.
“Está claro que hoje precisamos de uma secretária-geral que possa renovar o compromisso com o futuro do multilateralismo e com o futuro das Nações Unidas como mediadora, em vez de uma mera espectadora das crises mundiais”, disse ela pouco antes de tornar pública sua candidatura.
Nusseibeh, ministra de Estado no Ministério das Relações Exteriores dos Emirados Árabes Unidos, entrou tarde na disputa. Uma votação informal do Conselho de Segurança havia colocado a ex-vice-presidente da Costa Rica, Rebeca Grynspan, liderando por uma pequena margem, segundo fontes.
Embora Grynspan tenha liderado a “votação informal”, na semana passada, ela e todos os outros candidatos receberam dois ou mais votos contrários dos cinco membros permanentes do Conselho — Reino Unido, China, França, Rússia e Estados Unidos —, que terão a palavra final.
Os membros do Conselho estão negociando se realizarão outra votação na sexta-feira ou em uma data posterior.
DIPLOMACIA EMPREENDEDORA Nusseibeh, de 48 anos, disse que foi abordada por vários países durante a última Assembleia Geral da ONU para se candidatar. Anteriormente, ela liderou a campanha bem-sucedida dos Emirados Árabes Unidos para a eleição ao Conselho de Segurança. Diplomatas em Nova York afirmam que ela é respeitada como uma gestora competente.
“Hoje em dia, reconhece-se que precisamos de alguém que proporcione uma mudança geracional para a organização”, disse ela.
Seu mandato na ONU coincidiu com o início da guerra em Gaza, em 2023, quando ela garantiu a aprovação da Resolução 2720, abrindo caminho para a entrega de ajuda humanitária.
Nusseibeh disse que garantiu o apoio à resolução organizando uma visita dos membros do Conselho ao posto de fronteira de Rafah para que pudessem ver por si mesmos a situação no local, descrevendo a iniciativa como parte de sua “diplomacia empreendedora criativa”, que caracteriza sua abordagem.
DIPLOMACIA INCANSÁVEL Como uma das principais diplomatas dos Emirados Árabes Unidos, Nusseibeh tem defendido a política externa assertiva de Abu Dhabi e seu forte foco no combate ao islamismo político.
Os Emirados Árabes Unidos têm enfrentado críticas em relação ao Sudão depois que monitores das sanções da ONU descreveram como críveis as alegações de que o país teria fornecido apoio militar às Forças de Apoio Rápido, um grupo paramilitar. Os Emirados Árabes Unidos negam as alegações.
Questionada sobre como as alegações poderiam afetar sua candidatura, Nusseibeh disse que havia se afastado de seu cargo nos Emirados Árabes Unidos e que se concentraria na crise humanitária do Sudão.
Uma vitória de Nusseibeh faria dela a segunda secretária-geral da ONU do Oriente Médio, depois do egípcio Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
“Venho de um país mais jovem do que as Nações Unidas, mas nossa região vem enfrentando sérios desafios”, disse ela.
Ela também se tornaria a primeira mulher a liderar a ONU, embora Nusseibeh tenha afirmado que não está concorrendo por causa de seu gênero.
“Acho que seria ótimo se a próxima secretária-geral fosse uma mulher, mas não estou concorrendo por ser mulher; estou concorrendo porque sou obstinadamente otimista em relação ao futuro das Nações Unidas e acredito que precisamos de alguém que seja incansável na busca pela diplomacia para abrir portas.”

items.summary: Australia's Fortescue said on Thursday its operations might be affected if talks with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group (CMRG) did not conclude by year-end, as the world's fourth-largest iron ore miner released results that showed sales lagging shipments.
items.body:
Australia's Fortescue said on Thursday its operations might be affected if talks with state-backed buyer China Mineral Resources Group (CMRG) did not conclude by year-end, as the world's fourth-largest iron ore miner released results that showed sales lagging shipments.
Fortescue maintained its full-year 2027 forecast for iron ore shipments, C1 unit cost for hematite and metals capital expenditure.
Maintenance activities and a standoff with CMRG over supply contracts and price negotiations hurt the Perth-based miner's iron ore shipments and sales during the September quarter.
During annual supply talks earlier this year, [USN:L1N4330JC TEXT:"CMRG"] asked some mills not to take delivery of Fortescue's flagship iron ore product and sought a bigger role in iron ore contract negotiations with major miners, seeking to secure better terms for domestic steelmakers.
Fortescue's iron ore sales stood at 42.9 million metric tons (Mt) for the first quarter and was more than 9% below iron ore shipments of 46.8 million Mt. That compared with 49.7 Mt shipped a year ago and a Visible Alpha consensus estimate of 47.5 Mt.
The company said earlier this month its [USN:L4N45T1MF TEXT:"cash balance fell"] 37% in the three months ended September 30.
The miner [USN:L1N46704L TEXT:"said on Wednesday"] it had fired a senior executive following an investigation into allegations of sexual harassment and bullying.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞
items.body:
＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を来週に控え、市場では原油高に伴うインフレ再燃リスクが意識されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．０２％高の１５８．１２円。 日銀の氷見野良三副総裁は衆院財務金融委員会で、９月の利上げについて、中長期の予想物価上昇率が引き続き上昇していることも踏まえれば「基調的な物価上昇率は２％にかなり近づいており、先行き物価安定の目標とおおむね整合的な水準となる」と指摘。こうした中心的な見通しに加え、金融環境が緩和的な状態にあることや物価の上振れリスクに留意する必要があることなどを踏まえて決めたとし、利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されており、引き続き経済活動はしっかりとサポートされている」と述べた。

スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン主任ＦＸストラテジストは、「市場全体を左右する明確なテーマは現在のところ見当たらない。少なくとも来週のＦＯＭＣまでこうした状況が続く」と指摘。「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が何を考えているのかを見極める必要がある」としている。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが小幅に低下した。投資家は、経済成長を後押ししてきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株に対する高金利の影響を見極めたいとしている。２０年債入札後は利回りが低下幅を縮めた。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは０．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．１１１％と、２営業日連続の低下に向かっている。一時は５．０８１％まで低下した。

ただ、１３０億ドルの２０年債入札後、利回りは低下幅を縮めた。最高落札利回りは５．４６９％と入札締め切り時の市場利回りを上回った一方、応札倍率も２．７３倍と平均を上回り、アナリストの評価は強弱まちまちだった。

３０年債利回りは１．３ｂｐ低下の５．４１２％となった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合を中心に上昇した。スペースＸとスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターの四半期決算を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への投資意欲が改善した。ただ、通信サービス株の下落が上値を抑えた。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宙開発企業スペースＸは７．８％上昇。上場企業として初の黒字を計上した。マスク氏は決算発表後、スペースＸとテスラの合併は「良い考えだ」と述べ、テスラ株も買われた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーメーカーのスーパー・マイクロは９．６％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の構成銘柄で上昇率上位に入った。四半期の売上高と利益率について市場予想を上回る見通しを示し、ＡＩ需要の底堅さを示唆した。同業にも買いが波及し、ＨＰＥは３．７％、デルは５．３％それぞれ上昇した。

メタ・プラットフォームズは通常取引終了後に四半期決算を発表し、時間外取引で３％上昇した。通常取引を３．４％高で終えたテスラも、引け後の決算発表を受け、時間外でさらに１．６％上昇した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策決定会合を控え、米国債利回りの低下を背景に反発した。スポット金は一時１５日以来の安値を付けた後、０．３％高の１オンス＝４１３７．９４ドルとなった。米金先物１２月限は０．２％高の１オンス＝４１５０ドルで取引を終えた。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ロシアとウクライナの協議進展への期待と、米原油在庫の減少や米国とイランの対話欠如を見極める動きが交錯し、ほぼ横ばいとなった。米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前日比０．６７ドル（０．７％）安の１バレル＝９７．１５ドルだった。北海ブレント先物は０．０３ドル（０．０３％）高の１０８．８２ドルで取引を終えた。

items.title: 北朝鮮、対韓拡声器を境界線全域で待機へ 金与正氏が警告 - Reuters
items.summary: 北朝鮮、対韓拡声器を境界線全域で待機へ 金与正氏が警告    Reuters
items.raw_description: 北朝鮮、対韓拡声器を境界線全域で待機へ 金与正氏が警告    Reuters

items.title: 北朝鮮、対韓拡声器を境界線全域で待機へ　金与正氏が連日の警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮の金正恩総書記の妹で強い影響力を持つ金与正氏は２２日、数日以内に韓国との境界線全域で韓国向けの拡声器を待機状態にするとともに、新たな対抗措置を即応態勢に移したと明らかにした。

北朝鮮が干渉と呼ぶ行為を韓国政府が続ければ、「最も恐ろしく苦痛に満ちた状況」に直面すると警告した。

与正氏の声明は２１日夜に続き２日連続。宣伝用拡声器の再配備をちらつかせたことで、韓国の李在明大統領が南北の緊張緩和で挙げてきた主要な成果が覆され、厳重に要塞化された境界線沿いの緊張が同氏の就任以来、最も高い水準に達する恐れがある。

朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、与正氏は、李氏の国防政策補佐官の発言に反論したと説明した。この補佐官は、北朝鮮が埋設した地雷で韓国兵が負傷したと非難し、拡声器放送で緊張を高めないよう北朝鮮に求めていた。

与正氏は「われわれの新たな対抗手段は南部境界線全域で即応態勢に入り、対韓拡声器も数日以内に待機状態になる」と表明。また、南部境界線の要塞化を続けるとした。

韓国側は、９月に境界線付近で起きた爆発で兵士２人が重傷を負ったのは、北朝鮮が敷設した地雷が原因だとしている。北朝鮮は韓国による捏造だと主張している。

慶南大学のイム・ウルチュル教授は、与正氏の警告は必ずしも拡声器が稼働することを意味しないと指摘。ただ、李政権は平和的な関与政策を進めるか、境界線沿いでの北朝鮮の攻撃的な軍事活動を抑え込むかの選択を迫られており、今回の警告によって「極めて大きなジレンマ」に直面すると述べた。

items.creator: Andrew Chung
items.summary: President Donald Trump's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Wednesday to let it proceed with a plan to build a US-Mexico border barrier in a remote region in West Texas that includes Big Bend National Park.
items.body:
President Donald Trump 's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Wednesday to let it proceed with a plan to build a US-Mexico border barrier in a remote region in West Texas that includes Big Bend National Park.
The Justice Department filed an emergency request for the court to lift a federal judge's order [USN:L1N45P007 TEXT:"halting"] wall construction in the region while a lawsuit against the project brought by an environmental group and other challengers plays out.
The Republican president has long touted building or reinforcing barriers along the US-Mexico border as a signature part of his anti-immigration policies. But his administration's push to extend border infrastructure into the national park, around 250 miles (400 km) southeast of El Paso, has faced opposition from local officials, conservationists and some Texas Republicans.
The lawsuit was brought by the Center for Biological Diversity, a Big Bend-area river guide and a group seeking to preserve a historic church in Ruidosa, Texas, that says its fragile adobe structure is threatened by the border construction.
The plaintiffs challenged a series of waivers issued by the US Department of Homeland Security to expedite construction of roads and barriers in the Big Bend region, avoiding the application of a variety of environmental and conservation laws.
Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and the current Secretary Markwayne Mullin, who issued the waivers between February and July, found the region to be an "area of high illegal entry," requiring additional barriers to control the border.
US District Judge Kathleen Cardone in El Paso issued an injunction on October 2 halting the construction. In an opinion issued later, the judge found that the waivers exceeded the authority of Noem and Mullin.
The Justice Department in its request urged the Supreme Court to pause or overturn Cardone's injunction.
"Even assuming that the secretary's waiver authority implicates a question of 'vast economic and political significance,' Congress did clearly authorize the secretary both to build border barriers and to waive legal requirements in order to facilitate their expeditious construction," the Justice Department wrote.
In August, the administration [USN:L6N44E0WK TEXT:"paused"] construction in Big Bend after the project drew bipartisan criticism over its potential impact on the park's landscape and wildlife. Crews had begun clearing land in the park for roads and border security infrastructure, prompting protests and lawsuits seeking to halt the work.

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 21 : Major stock indexes climbed on Wednesday, lifted by more strong results from AI-focused companies, while France's 10-year bond yield hit 5 per cent for the first time since 2002 due to growing concern about the country's economic outlook.
The Nasdaq gained more than 1 per cent, with Super Micro shares rising 9.5 per cent after the AI server maker forecast quarterly revenue and profit margin above Wall Street estimates.
 Shares of SpaceX shot up 7.8 per cent after Elon Musk said late on Tuesday that a merger of his two companies SpaceX and Tesla would be "a good idea." SpaceX also posted its first profit as a public company.
AI-related shares sold off ahead of third-quarter results on investor worries about how long the AI trade can last.

"A lot of the concerns that we had over the last few weeks that sent the market lower are being alleviated," said Adam Sarhan, chief executive of 50 Park Investments in New York. Earnings "are coming in mixed to stronger than expected," which he called a relief.
"Tech stocks fell hard last week on fears that the AI party is over," he said.
In addition, US bond yields have been falling after their recent run higher, and US interest rate hike expectations have waned, he said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 360.21 points, or 0.69 per cent, to close at 52,856.09, the S&P 500 rose 44.60 points, or 0.58 per cent, to 7,757.17 and the Nasdaq Composite gained 278.04 points, or 1.05 per cent, to 26,702.86.
After the closing bell, Meta Platforms shares gained after the Facebook owner raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast. Meta ended the regular session up 0.5 per cent. Tesla shares also rose in after-hours trading as it reported a surprise positive cash flow for the third quarter. The stock ended the regular session up 3.4 per cent. 
MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe rose 7.48 points, or 0.7 per cent, to 1,137.88. The pan-European STOXX 600 index climbed 0.92 per cent.
US Treasury yields edged lower, with the yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note shedding 0.6 basis point to 5.111 per cent. 
Stocks have slipped of late and bonds have rallied due to concerns about the effect of higher borrowing costs on AI infrastructure stocks.
FRENCH BOND YIELDS RISE
French bond yields rose again, with 10-year bond yields hitting a new 24-year high above 5 per cent. The premium on French yields over benchmark 10-year German Bunds has also edged back toward early October's 15-year high of nearly 160 bps.
French President Emmanuel Macron vowed to prevent a repeat of last weekend's violence at protests planned in the coming days, and dismissed as "stupid" and "unacceptable" comments from some foreign leaders about the unrest. 
 French supermarket operator Carrefour fell about 13 per cent after it cut its guidance due to the recent protests.
The euro was nearly flat at $1.1237.
The US dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.14 per cent to 101.65. 
The Australian dollar gained after Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook looked "materially worse." The Aussie gained 0.41 per cent versus the greenback to $0.7031.
Benchmark oil futures ended little changed, with investors weighing possible progress toward Russia-Ukraine talks against data showing a fall in US oil stocks.
Brent crude rose 3 cents to settle at $108.82 a barrel. US West Texas Intermediate crude fell 67 cents, or 0.7 per cent, to settle at $97.15.

Source: Reuters
