items.title: STRICTLY EMBARGOED UNTIL WEDS 11PM - U.S. climate champion Gina McCarthy honoured in Reuters Global Sustainability awards
items.author: Oliver Balch
items.creator: Oliver Balch
items.summary: Gina McCarthy seems remarkably chipper given the seemingly relentless opposition to climate action, led by her own government under President Donald Trump.
items.body:
Gina McCarthy seems remarkably chipper given the seemingly relentless opposition to climate action, led by her own government under President Donald Trump.
McCarthy, who was head of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency during the Obama administration, and White House climate adviser under Joe Biden, accepts that her view isn’t universally held. “It may sound a little crazy to people,” she says. “But I'm really bullish on what's happening next.”
She spoke to The Ethical Corporation on the eve of Reuters Global Sustainability Awards, where she was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement award, in recognition of spending more than three decades “at the forefront of America's fight for cleaner air, safer water, and a liveable climate”.
Her bullishness was also clear in her acceptance speech, which was delivered by video from her home outside Boston.
“Despite all the nonsense from my federal government and their fossil fuel allies, there has been a massive surge this past year in clean energy,” she said, with state and local governments from across the U.S. “working together to drive a more aggressive energy transition ... with a relentless spirit of optimism”.
McCarthy will be taking that optimistic spirit to next month’s United Nations’ climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, as chair of America Is All In , a coalition of pro-climate U.S. cities, states, corporations and community groups.
Newly assembled solar panels at a new solar facility in Humble, Texas, US, October 6, 2026. REUTERS/Antranik Tavitian “We don't want the rest of the world to think that the United States is what Trump says. The United States is what our state and local governments say,” she tells The Ethical Corporation.
With the U.S. midterm elections, in the week prior to COP31, expected to restore the House of Representatives to Democratic control and weaken Republicans’ grip on the Senate, that message will be even easier to sell.
She cites Illinois, which has passed legislation to add 3 gigawatts of battery storage to its grid by 2030, and California, which plans to modernise its already pioneering carbon credit programme.
Cleveland, Ohio, meanwhile, is pursuing a new five-year plan to cut emissions by nearly two-thirds (against 2018 levels).
Sceptics will note that all the examples derive from strongly Democrat-controlled constituencies, but McCarthy points out that the Republican stronghold of Texas is home to a substantial portion of the record additions of solar and battery projects added to the U.S. grid in the past year.
McCarthy has long believed that for the average U.S. voter, economics trump ideology when it comes to powering their homes and businesses.
A drone view shows California’s largest battery storage facility, as it nears completion on a 43-acre site in Menifee, California, U.S., March 28, 2024. REUTERS/Mike Blake The relative affordability of renewable power compared to fossil fuels makes it increasingly attractive to householders, in the face of a monthly inflation rate of 3.4%.
Corporations, meanwhile, have been leaning heavily into renewable energy, mindful not only of rising energy costs but growing threats to energy security.
According to the business-backed Corporate Energy Buyers Association (CEBA), corporate-sponsored clean energy projects in 2025 exceeded the total power generation of 45 individual U.S. states.
With U.S. investment in the global clean energy transition now running at around $378 billion, it may seem like supporters of America Is All In, who collectively represent 63% of the U.S. population and 74% of U.S. GDP, can rest easy.
Gina McCarthy pictured in Washington in 2014 as she arrives to sign a proposal under the Clean Air Act to cut carbon pollution from existing power plants. REUTERS/Joshua Roberts Yet having seen many of the environmental advances made under her watch rolled back by the Trump Administration, McCarthy is far from complacent. In mid-September, for example, the EPA, which she headed up between 2013 and 2017, said it planned to desist from regulating greenhouse gas emissions from the power sector.
According to America Is All In, the proposed move could see a potential ten-fold increase in coal-fired power, with severe impacts on greenhouse gas emissions but also human health.
“To have this (Clean Power Plan) arbitrarily taken off the books by this administration was absolutely ludicrous. It had nothing but benefits,” she says.
Another policy reversal that she admits was “not easy” to watch was the scrapping of the EPA’s landmark 2009 Greenhouse Gas Endangerment Finding , barring the agency from tracking and capping emissions from cars and heavy-duty vehicles.
But it was the dilution of the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) that McCarthy deems the most consequential of all the Trump administration’s recent moves to halt transition efforts.
Introduced in the wake of the COVID pandemic, the IRA earmarked around $485 billion in public spending and tax breaks for investments in healthcare, clean tech and other transition-related investments.
Its dismantlement continues to incense McCarthy, who describes it as “one of the biggest opportunities that our country ever had” to provide U.S. citizens with clean, secure and affordable energy.
A drone view shows Elon Musk's xAI Colossus 2 "Macrohard" data centre in Southaven, Mississippi, U.S., May 30, 2026. REUTERS/Kevin Wurm Yet her response is typically indefatigable. “You know, we all have to pull up our big boy, big girl pants when these challenges happen.”
Fuelling her confidence are two fundamental convictions; namely, that people will be ultimately won over by clean power’s cost competitiveness, and will also realise that “this administration isn’t forever”.
She takes heart from the multiple lawsuits now being brought by state authorities and campaign groups against various efforts by the Trump administration to weaken environmental protections.
Earlier this month, a coalition of 25 cities and states – including New York, California, North Carolina and Washington D.C. – issued a petition to the U.S. court of appeals for the District of Columbia to review the EPA’s proposal to remove emission standards for power plants.
Also encouraging is the spirit of cross-sector collaboration that is now emerging across the U.S. She points to the C40 Global Urban Data Centres Pact . A new mayor-led initiative endorsed by 49 cities, including 22 in the U.S., seeks to promote greater public accountability in the management of resource-hungry data centres.
The pact, which includes Chicago, Austin, Seattle and Miami, comes on the back of increasing disquiet in the U.S. over the water and energy consumption of AI data centres.
While McCarthy acknowledges the potential economic benefits of such facilities, she argues that companies and regulators have not paid enough attention at their environmental and community impacts.
She would like to see tax revenues from data centres used to help fund renewable energy projects and community infrastructure.
“They (data centres) are one of the fastest-growing challenges that we have in the United States,” she says. “There has to be a way to ensure that they can do their thing without destroying us.”

items.title: New Zealand third-quarter inflation slows to 3.7% but expectations remain of a hike next week
items.author: Lucy Craymer
items.creator: Lucy Craymer
items.summary: New Zealand's annual inflation slowed in the third quarter, coming in below analysts' forecasts at 3.7%, but remained above the top end of the central bank's target range, official data showed on Thursday, as data adds to expectations the central bank will hike rates next week.
items.body:
New Zealand's annual inflation slowed in the third quarter, coming in below analysts' forecasts at 3.7%, but remained above the top end of the central bank's target range, official data showed on Thursday, as data adds to expectations the central bank will hike rates next week.
The consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.7% in the third quarter from the second, Statistics New Zealand said.
Economists polled by Reuters had expected a 3.8% annual increase and 0.8% quarterly rise.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand targets annual inflation between 1% and 3% over the medium term.
The New Zealand dollar dipped to $0.5692 after the data came in below forecasts.
Statistics New Zealand said the largest contributor to inflation was petrol prices, even though prices had eased since the June quarter. It noted that the cost of building houses had also increased.
Inflation has become a key battleground ahead of the close-fought November 7 general election, as voters fed up with the sluggish economy and historically high inflation look for relief and political parties offer various policy solutions.
The data, which came in lower than the central bank forecast of 3.9%, is the last top-tier data release ahead of the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's monetary policy review next week.
The central bank has raised the cash rate twice this year to 2.75% as it tries to bring inflation back to the midpoint of its 1% to 3% target range.
The market is currently pricing in a 98% chance that the central bank will hike again next week and a 100% chance that there will be 50 basis points of hikes before the end of February.
Satish Ranchhod, senior economist at Westpac New Zealand, said while the result was lower than the central bank's forecast, the firmness in core inflation will give the RBNZ pause for thought ahead of its policy review next week.
"Market pricing and views have coalesced around an October hike which we now suspect the MPC will see as the path of least resistance," he said.
Annual non-tradeable inflation was 3.3% compared with 3.4% in the second quarter while tradeable inflation was at 4.3% in the third quarter.
Inflation globally is proving more persistent than expected, with economists raising price forecasts and trimming growth outlooks as central banks confront renewed energy-driven pressures. The Middle East war is amplifying the risk of stagflation - stagnant growth and high inflation - by disrupting energy supplies and shipping, lifting fuel, fertiliser and transport costs.
Economists expect inflation to pick up again in the fourth quarter as fuel prices are again on the rise.
ASB Bank is picking inflation to rise to 4.5% by the end of the year and said in a note that the 2027 inflation profile "also looks to be considerably firmer" than the central bank's forecasts in September.

items.title: North Korea's Kim Yo Jong warns South Korea, says border loudspeakers to be ready within days
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korea will place anti-South Korea loudspeakers on standby along the entire border within days and has put new countermeasures on alert, Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader, said on Thursday, warning Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation" if it continues what Pyongyang calls interference.
items.body:
North Korea will place anti-South Korea loudspeakers on standby along the entire border within days and has put new countermeasures on alert, Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader, said on Thursday, warning Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation" if it continues what Pyongyang calls interference.
The threats to redeploy propaganda loudspeakers, announced in Kim’s second statement within hours, risk reversing South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s signature gains in easing inter-Korean tensions and pushing tensions along the heavily fortified frontier to their highest level since he took office.
In a statement carried by state media KCNA, Kim said she was responding to a special adviser to Lee on defence policy, who accused North Korea of planting mines that wounded South Korean soldiers and told it not to escalate tensions with loudspeaker broadcasts.
"Our new counter means will get into the alert for duty at all the southern border line and the loudspeakers against the ROK will be on standby in a matter of days,” she said.
She said North Korea would continue fortifying its southern border.
On Wednesday evening, Kim said North Korea would [USN:L1N46706V TEXT:"activate"] anti-South Korea loudspeakers across the border by the end of October after visiting fortification sites with senior military officials.
South Korea says North Korean mines caused a border blast last month that seriously wounded two soldiers. North Korea denies responsibility, calling the incident a South Korean fabrication.
Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Seoul's Kyungnam University, said Kim's warnings did not necessarily mean the loudspeakers would be activated.
But they present Lee's administration with an "enormous dilemma", he said, as it faces a choice between pursuing its policy of peaceful engagement and containing aggressive North Korean military activity along the border.

items.title: Meta Boosts Bet on AI With Spending Outlook, New Stock Class
items.summary: Meta Platforms boosted its capital spending outlook and announced plans for a new class of nonvoting stock, escalating its already-stratospheric bet on artificial intelligence. Capital expenditures will be $135 billion to $145 billion in 2026, the social-media giant said during its quarterly earnings report Wednesday, raising the bottom end of the range from $130 billion. The new class of shares, meanwhile, will be distributed to existing investors through a stock dividend. Holders will get one share of the new stock in what will essentially be a two-for-one stock split, Meta said. It expects trading of the new shares to begin in January. Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. He speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: EQT to buy molecular testing firm Qiagen for $10.8 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Sweden's EQT will buy molecular testing company Qiagen for about €9.6 billion ($10.78 billion), the companies said on Wednesday, ending years of takeover speculation surrounding the Dutch firm.
items.body:
Sweden's EQT (EQTAB.ST) will buy molecular testing company Qiagen (QIA.DE) for about €9.6 billion ($10.78 billion), the companies said on Wednesday, ending years of takeover speculation surrounding the Dutch firm.
The deal reflects increasing private-equity appetite in the sector, where demand for molecular testing technologies has driven dealmaking.
Buyout firm EQT offered €46.50 ($52.22) a share for Qiagen, representing an 8.6% premium to its last close. Affiliates of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board are also participating in the offer.
Qiagen's US-listed shares rose 0.7% in extended trading after the announcement. Its stock is up about 10% so far this year as reports of takeover interest from private equity firms including EQT helped it recover from more than six-year lows hit in May.
The deal, which values Qiagen at about $12.1 billion including about $1.1 billion in net debt, is expected to close in mid-2027. EQT has secured equity and debt financing to fund the offer.
Qiagen's board has approved the offer, with supervisory board chairman Stephen Rusckowski saying going private was the "best path forward for Qiagen, its shareholders and other stakeholders."
Qiagen, which provides technologies and services for analyzing genetic material in research and clinical laboratories, became a takeover target after previous CEO Peer Schatz announced his departure in October 2019.
Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO.N) agreed in 2020 to acquire Qiagen in a deal valued at about $11.5 billion, but abandoned the takeover after failing to secure enough shareholder support.
Surging demand for Qiagen's coronavirus testing products during the COVID-19 pandemic boosted the company's performance and share price, leading some investors to view the offer as too low.
Qiagen said it was suspending its full-year 2026 outlook pending the deal. It reported preliminary third-quarter net sales of $548 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.65.
($1 = 0.8904 euros)

items.title: Surgery 'not on table' for Shohei Ohtani, expected to pitch next year
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Although the Los Angeles Dodgers' bid for a three-peat ended last week with a sweep by the Milwaukee Brewers, superstar Shohei Ohtani is expected to avoid offseason surgery and resume pitching next season.
items.body:
Although the Los Angeles Dodgers' bid for a three-peat ended last week with a sweep by the Milwaukee Brewers, superstar Shohei Ohtani is expected to avoid offseason surgery and resume pitching next season.
At the Dodgers' end-of-season news conference Wednesday, president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said surgery was "not on the table" for Ohtani and that he "fully expects" the four-time MVP to return to the mound in 2027.
Friedman's comments echoed those of Ohtani, who said after Game 4 of the National League Championship Series last Thursday that he intended to return to being a two-way player.
"I haven't been able to come to grips with what I learned overall this season," Ohtani said through an interpreter after the Dodgers were swept. "I will go back to the drawing board in terms of treatment, a training program and see what I can come up with for next season. ... And looking forward to having a better season next year."
In that game, Ohtani ended a 25-game home run drought, the longest of his career, with his first extra-base hit and first three RBIs of the 2026 postseason. He had been 4-for-23 (.174) in the playoffs before the homer.
Ohtani, 32, was limited to 14 starts on the mound in 2026 because of his injuries, finishing 8-2 with a 1.79 ERA, 95 strikeouts and 26 walks in 85 2/3 innings. He last pitched July 3, then served exclusively as the designated hitter for the remainder of the regular season and postseason.
At the plate, Ohtani batted .275 with 30 home runs and 81 RBIs in 135 games and made his sixth consecutive All-Star appearance.
Ohtani won MVP awards twice with the Los Angeles Angels and twice with the Dodgers during his nine major league seasons. He hit three postseason homers in 2024 and eight in 2025 as the Dodgers won back-to-back World Series titles.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Legendary Cowboys DB Cornell Green dies at 86
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Dallas Cowboys star defensive back Cornell Green died Wednesday. He was 86.
items.body:
Former Dallas Cowboys star defensive back Cornell Green died Wednesday. He was 86.
The Cowboys announced Green's passing but didn't reveal a cause of death.
"We are sad to share news of the passing of Cowboys Legend Cornell Green this morning," the team said. "Cornell was a true trailblazer having never played football in college, yet becoming a multi-time Pro Bowler, All Pro and NFL Super Bowl Champion with the Cowboys playing defensive back from 1962 to 1974. He was a member of the 25th Anniversary Cowboys Team as well. Cornell remarkably never missed a game in 13 seasons, becoming one of the best and most dependable teammates to ever wear the star. Our thoughts and prayers are with his family."
Green earned five Pro Bowl invitations during his stellar career from 1962-74 as a key member of the famed Doomsday Defense. He was a three-time Pro Bowl pick as a cornerback (1965-67) and received two more nods (1971-72) as a safety. He also was a member of the Cowboys' 1971 Super Bowl champions.
Green is tied for fifth in Cowboys' history with 34 interceptions 52 years after his retirement.
Green was a cornerback for his first eight seasons and twice had seven interceptions in a season. He returned picks for touchdowns in 1966 and 1968.
In the 1967 playoffs, Green had a 60-yard interception return for a touchdown during a 52-14 rout of the Cleveland Browns. That was his lone interception in 15 postseason games.
The next week, Dallas lost 21-17 to the host Green Bay Packers in the NFL Championship Game. That contest is better known as the Ice Bowl when the temperature was minus-13 degrees with a minus-36 wind chill at kickoff.
Basketball was Green's sport growing up and he was a college standout for Utah State from 1959-62 and inducted into the school's athletic Hall of Fame in 1993.
Green holds the school's career rebounding mark of 1,067 while he ranks sixth in career points with 1,890. He also holds the school single-season rebounding record of 403.
Green twice earned All-American honors for the Aggies and was a fifth-round selection (35th overall) by the Chicago Zephyrs in the 1962 NBA Draft.
Instead, Green accepted an offer to try out for the Cowboys and he made the team. After his rookie season, Green started 167 of 168 regular-season games for Dallas.
In 2020, Green was named to the Cowboys' 60th anniversary team. Earlier, he also was named to the 25th anniversary team.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Walmart deixa agentes de IA fazerem compras para clientes nos EUA
items.author: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.summary: O Walmart apresentou nesta quarta-feira novas ferramentas que permitirão que agentes de inteligência artificial façam compras e concluam transações para os clientes.
items.body:
O Walmart (WMT.O) apresentou nesta quarta-feira novas ferramentas que permitirão que agentes de inteligência artificial façam compras e concluam transações para os clientes.
A iniciativa ressalta o empenho do Walmart em promover compras com tecnologia de IA e contrasta com a Amazon (AMZN.O) , que tem buscado limitar o acesso de agentes de compras de IA de terceiros à sua plataforma.
A rede de varejo informou que lançará os “Perfis de Agentes” no próximo mês, permitindo que os consumidores autorizem agentes de IA individualmente, acompanhem suas compras separadamente e definam limites de gastos ou exijam aprovação para cada transação.
O Walmart afirmou que os clientes poderão monitorar as compras feitas por agentes de IA separadamente de seus próprios pedidos e revogar o acesso dos agentes a qualquer momento.
A empresa também lançou o “Walmart Agent Gateway”, uma plataforma que permite que assistentes de IA, como o ChatGPT da OpenAI, o Gemini do Google e o Muse da Meta, se conectem diretamente aos sistemas do Walmart e do Sam’s Club para pesquisar produtos e concluir compras.
O Walmart afirmou que os clientes manterão o controle sobre as compras, enquanto os agentes de IA não terão acesso aos dados dos cartões de pagamento e poderão ser bloqueados por violarem as regras da empresa.
A empresa informou que as ferramentas estarão disponíveis para todos os titulares de contas do Walmart.

items.title: 米、サウジ駐在の外交官・家族に退避命令　フーシ派攻撃受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [エルサレム／イスタンブール／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[エルサレム／イスタンブール／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] - 米国務省は、サウジアラビアの在外公館から一部の外交官とその家族に退避を命じ、さらに湾岸地域にある他の複数の米在外公館からも家族を退避させる計画だ。複数の米当局者が２１日、ロイターに対し明らかにした。 

国務省のトミー・ピゴット報道官は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「Ｘ」への投稿で、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジ国内の民間施設に攻撃を加える中、「サウジアラビアに駐在する緊急業務以外に従事する米政府職員とその家族」に限り退避を命じたと説明した。

米当局者４人によると、湾岸諸国にある他の米在外公館でも家族に退避を命じる方針。ピゴット氏はサウジ以外の在外公館に関する変更については言及しなかった。

在サウジアラビア米大使館は２１日、首都リヤドの空港などに対する攻撃を受け、フーシ派による一段の攻撃の可能性があるとして安全警報を発出した。

items.title: Rússia liberta professor aposentado dos EUA em gesto de boa vontade, enquanto Putin se reúne com Witkoff
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Rússia libertou nesta quarta-feira Stephen Hubbard, um professor aposentado dos EUA que estava detido desde 2022, e o levou a São Petersburgo para que ele voltasse de avião aos Estados Unidos, após negociações que, segundo Washington, representaram um passo em direção ao fim da guerra na Ucrânia.
items.body:
A Rússia libertou nesta quarta-feira Stephen Hubbard, um professor aposentado dos EUA que estava detido desde 2022, e o levou a São Petersburgo para que ele voltasse de avião aos Estados Unidos, após negociações que, segundo Washington, representaram um passo em direção ao fim da guerra na Ucrânia.
O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, fez o anúncio em uma reunião em São Petersburgo com o enviado norte-americano Steve Witkoff, que posteriormente afirmou que as negociações continuarão com vistas a discussões em nível técnico envolvendo os EUA, a Rússia e a Ucrânia.
Witkoff chamou Putin de “humanitário” ao agradecer-lhe pela medida, uma observação que gerou forte repreensão de parlamentares republicanos e democratas, tendo em vista a invasão em grande escala da Ucrânia pela Rússia em 2022.
A libertação do prisioneiro ocorre no momento em que os recentes gestos do presidente Donald Trump em relação a Moscou — incluindo um acordo para comprar diesel russo e a suspensão de novas sanções — já provocaram reações contrárias de ambos os partidos no Congresso dos EUA e preocupação nas capitais europeias.
O porta-voz de Putin, Dmitry Peskov, afirmou que Putin havia libertado Hubbard, de 74 anos, a pedido de Trump, e que também havia levado em consideração o estado de saúde precário do norte-americano. Trump confirmou posteriormente que havia feito o pedido a Putin em uma ligação nos últimos dias, e que Putin concordou.
“O presidente envia seus agradecimentos, toda a nossa nação envia seus agradecimentos, por causa de Stephen Hubbard”, disse Witkoff a Putin na reunião transmitida pela TV estatal russa. “Graças a você, ele está voltando para casa, para sua família.”
Em um vídeo compartilhado com a Reuters, Hubbard, vestindo um moletom escuro e bem barbeado, é visto em um local não revelado na Rússia apertando a mão de Witkoff e agradecendo a ele. Mais tarde, Trump postou uma foto de Hubbard dentro de um avião com outras pessoas, segurando uma bandeira norte-americana.
O filho de Hubbard, Joseph Coleman, disse à Reuters em uma mensagem de voz que conversou brevemente por telefone com seu pai antes de ele embarcar no avião na Rússia.
“Hoje ele parecia mais animado, com um tom de felicidade na voz”, disse Coleman.

items.title: ウクライナ汚職捜査当局が中銀を捜索、「業務とは無関係」と総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ　２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ　２１日　ロイター] - ウクライナ国家汚職対策局（ＮＡＢＵ）は２１日、捜査員がウクライナ国立銀行（中央銀行）と職員１人の自宅を家宅捜索していると明らかにした。同中銀総裁は、捜索は中銀の業務とは無関係であると述べた。

ＮＡＢＵは通信アプリ「テレグラム」上の声明で、誰も拘束されておらず、容疑通知も出されていないと述べた。

ウクライナ中銀のピシュニー総裁はその後、フェイスブックへの投稿で、今回の家宅捜索は中銀の業務や自身の銀行運営とは一切関係がないと表明。

「捜査では、他の状況や個人に関連する事件の証拠を探していた」とした上で、「今回の家宅捜索の結果、私や中銀職員が何らかの不正行為を行ったことを示すものは何も見つからなかった」と述べた。 

総裁は、法律の範囲内で捜査当局と協力する用意があると述べた上で、中銀の独立性と行動する能力を強調。「特に戦時中は、金融システムの安定が国にとって極めて重要だ」と語った。

items.title: Walmart lanza herramientas para que los agentes de IA realicen compras en nombre de los clientes
items.author: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.summary: Walmart presentó el miércoles nuevas herramientas que permitirán a los agentes de inteligencia artificial realizar compras y completar transacciones para los clientes, en un intento de la cadena minorista por posicionarse en el creciente uso de asistentes basados en IA en el comercio electrónico.
items.body:
Walmart (WMT.O) presentó el miércoles nuevas herramientas que permitirán a los agentes de inteligencia artificial realizar compras y completar transacciones para los clientes, en un intento de la cadena minorista por posicionarse en el creciente uso de asistentes basados en IA en el comercio electrónico.
Esta medida subraya la apuesta de Walmart por las compras basadas en la IA y contrasta con la estrategia de Amazon (AMZN.O) , que ha tratado de limitar el acceso de los agentes de compras de IA de terceros a su plataforma.
Estos son los detalles:
La cadena ha anunciado que lanzará el próximo mes los "perfiles de agente", lo que permitirá a los compradores autorizar a agentes de IA individuales, realizar un seguimiento de sus compras por separado y establecer un límite de gasto o exigir la aprobación de cada transacción.
Walmart ha señalado que los clientes podrán supervisar las compras realizadas por los agentes de IA de forma independiente de sus propios pedidos y revocar el acceso de los agentes en cualquier momento.
La empresa también ha lanzado "Walmart Agent Gateway", una plataforma que permite a asistentes de IA como ChatGPT de OpenAI, Gemini de Google y Muse de Meta conectarse directamente con los sistemas de Walmart y Sam’s Club para buscar productos y realizar compras.
Walmart ha señalado que los clientes mantendrán el control sobre las compras, mientras que a los agentes de IA se les impedirá acceder a los datos de las tarjetas de pago y podrán ser bloqueados por infringir las normas de la empresa.
La empresa ha señalado que las herramientas estarán disponibles para todos los titulares de cuentas de Walmart y no requerirán una suscripción a Walmart+.

items.title: Chinese-linked hackers compromise ConnectWise, target hundreds in global attack, Microsoft says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Chinese-linked hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign that targeted hundreds of organizations globally, Microsoft said on Wednesday.
items.body:
A Chinese-linked hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign that targeted hundreds of organizations globally, Microsoft said on Wednesday.
ConnectWise did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Microsoft's conclusions, although a statement posted to the company's website on October 16 said it was "investigating recent attempts of unauthorized access associated with the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment."
The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing regularly denies conducting or condoning cyber-enabled data theft.
The hackers, which Microsoft tracks as Storm-0940, used an open-source penetration testing framework called ARTEX to carry out the campaign, Microsoft said.
There are multiple tools used to conduct penetration testing, a form of legitimate testing of the security of networks or services. ARTEX allows users to use any AI model to automate a variety of penetration testing tasks and can be configured to run autonomous tasks including reconnaissance and data exfiltration, Microsoft said.
The attack targeted organizations across a wide variety of sectors, including aerospace, defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services, government, legal, manufacturing, media, military, semiconductor, software, technology, think tanks and nonprofits, Microsoft said.
While the majority of the targeting was not successful, Microsoft said, Storm-0940 achieved privileged cloud persistence — or high-level access that could continue even after cleanup efforts — at many organizations in a brief time.

items.title: Walmart launches tools for AI agents to shop for customers
items.author: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.summary: Walmart on Wednesday intrduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers, as the retailer seeks to position itself in the growing use of AI-powered assistants in online commerce.
items.body:
Walmart (WMT.O) on Wednesday intrduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers, as the retailer seeks to position itself in the growing use of AI-powered assistants in online commerce.
The move underscores Walmart's push into AI-enabled shopping, and strikes a contrast with Amazon (AMZN.O) , which has sought to limit third-party AI shopping agents' access to its platform.
Here are the details:
The retailer said it will roll out "Agent Profiles" next month, enabling shoppers to authorize individual AI agents, track their purchases separately and set spending limit or require approval for each transaction
Walmart said customers would be able to monitor purchases made by AI agents separately from their own orders and revoke agent access at any time
The tools instilled confidence in the "experimental" shopping process of agentic purchases, said Mizuho analyst David Bellinger in a note
"... the momentum and buy-in from top management teams seems to be making this into a real thing," Bellinger added.
The company also launched the "Walmart Agent Gateway," a platform that allows AI assistants such as OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Meta's Muse to connect directly with Walmart and Sam's Club systems to search products and complete purchases
Walmart said customers would remain in control of purchases, while AI agents would be barred from accessing payment card data and could be blocked for violating company rules
The company said the tools will be available to all Walmart account holders and will not require a Walmart+ membership

"Our hearts go out to his family," Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said to begin his news conference on Wednesday. "Prayers are with them. Way too young, obviously. One of my favorite players. Great kid. Just sorry to see that happened to him."
Bailey was found dead on Tuesday in his Florida home, with his family telling TMZ that they believe he died from natural causes. No official cause of death had been released as of Wednesday afternoon.
"Allen Bailey was an excellent teammate, generous man, and kind soul," the Chiefs posted on social media on Wednesday. "We're deeply saddened to hear of his passing, and our thoughts and prayers are with his family and friends."
Kansas City selected Bailey in the third round of the 2011 NFL Draft out of Miami.
He totaled 248 career tackles, 22 sacks, 40 tackles for loss, 40 quarterback hits, four forced fumbles and seven fumble recoveries (one returned for a touchdown) in 133 regular-season games (70 starts) for the Chiefs (2011-18) and Atlanta Falcons (2019-20).
He also played in six playoff games (five starts) and had 10 tackles, two sacks and two forced fumbles.
"Rest in peace, Allen Bailey," the Falcons posted on social media, using the folded hands/prayer emoji. "We send our deepest condolences to his family and friends."
Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes said Wednesday that Bailey was the first person he saw when he entered the locker room after getting drafted in 2017. Seeing the burly and athletic Bailey, listed at 6-foot-3 and 288 pounds, made Mahomes realize he wasn't in college anymore, calling it "surreal."
"Obviously, it's terrible to hear the news," said Mahomes, Bailey's teammate for two seasons. "A great teammate -- he's one of those glue guys on the team. He makes plays. He's not necessarily a superstar, but the guy that kind of makes everything go. We're praying for his family. (As) teammates, we've talked and we know that we're going to do whatever we can to support those guys."
A native of Sapelo Island, Ga., Bailey played 50 games for the Miami Hurricanes from 2007-10 and made 107 tackles, 19 sacks and 31 tackles for loss with two forced fumbles. He was a two-time All-Atlantic Coast Conference selection.
"It's terrible, especially with all the good he (did)," Reid said of Bailey's death. "He's got a family and that's a sad deal. I know his father passed away young, too. It makes you sick when it happens to somebody that young."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Vance defends Ramaswamy's explosive attack ad in Ohio governor race
items.author: Helen Coster
items.creator: Helen Coster
items.summary: US Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday defended an explosive attack ad by Republican Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign against his Democratic rival in the Ohio governor’s race.
items.body:
US Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday defended an explosive attack ad by Republican Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign against his Democratic rival in the Ohio governor’s race.
The ad features Democrat Amy Acton’s estranged mother, Donna Arthur, disputing Acton’s account of a childhood she says involved a period of homelessness and sexual abuse. Arthur, whom Acton says she has not seen since 1978, urges Ohioans not to vote for her daughter.
Acton has said she was sexually abused by her stepfather when she was 12. Her mother stayed with the stepfather, who was charged with rape but fled the state and was never tried. He died in 2004.
Acton's brother has supported her account.
The ad initially appeared on social media on Tuesday without identifying its source, but Ramaswamy’s campaign later said it was behind the spot and was spending $4 million to promote it.
The ad, which has been widely condemned, underscores the incivility of the run-up to the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"November 3 midterm elections"] and could backfire on Ramaswamy and other Republican candidates in Ohio, which has moved to the right during the Trump years, analysts said.
Vance, campaigning with Ramaswamy and Republican US Senator Jon Husted on Wednesday, brushed aside the blowback.
“Vivek Ramaswamy had the audacity to run a TV commercial which calls it out like it is and calls Amy Acton a liar,” said Vance, who rose to fame on his own story of childhood neglect in Ohio.
“And my message, ladies and gentlemen, is very simple. Whatever you think about any of the TV advertisements, focus on the substance and focus on the facts.”
'DISGUSTING ATTACK' Acton's brother, Philip Stearns, said in a statement that Ramaswamy's ad was a "desperate, disgusting attack."
Acton campaign spokesperson Addie Bullock said Ramaswamy's decision to promote the ad was "both despicable and entirely predictable."
As the backlash built on Tuesday, Ramaswamy's campaign spokesperson Connie Luck issued a statement saying: "We don't know what happened between Amy and her mother ... but we know that Amy Acton is a serial fabulist."
Opinion polls show Acton with a narrow lead over Ramaswamy, and the scandal could help cement her position as the favorite in the race, analysts said.
“It was campaign malpractice,” said David Cohen, a political science professor at the University of Akron.
Cohen said it could also mean trouble for Husted, who said in a statement that he would "not have run that ad" and who polls show trailing Democrat Sherrod Brown in a [USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:"race"] that will help determine control of the US Senate.
Among Republicans, Cohen predicted, "I think this will either encourage some people to switch parties, or more likely, you're going to have a lot of people staying home" on Election Day.

items.title: Café arábica atinge maior nível em quase 6 semanas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE subiram nesta quarta-feira, sendo negociados perto da maior cotação em seis semanas, em meio a baixos estoques nos países de destino e a um aumento lento nos volumes dos armazéns certificados.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE subiram nesta quarta-feira, sendo negociados perto da maior cotação em seis semanas, em meio a baixos estoques nos países de destino e a um aumento lento nos volumes dos armazéns certificados.
O cacau também registrou alta, enquanto o açúcar apresentou ligeira queda.
CAFÉ Os futuros de café arábica fecharam em alta de 4,85 centavos, ou 1,6%, a US$3,1615 por libra-peso, após atingirem US$3,1820 na sessão anterior, sua maior cotação desde 9 de setembro.
Os estoques de café verde no Japão e na Europa, dois dos maiores mercados para a bebida, diminuíram em agosto em relação ao ano passado, de acordo com dados de entidades do setor.
Os corretores esperam que os estoques nos países de destino aumentem gradualmente à medida que o fluxo da safra recorde de café no Brasil melhore.
Os estoques de café arábica nos armazéns da ICE continuam limitados a 239.748 sacas, com um pequeno volume aguardando recomendação.
"Nenhum lote significativo chegou à bolsa na semana passada, o que o mercado interpretou como um sinal de alta", afirmou Ilya Byzov, trader quantitativo da Sucafina, em uma nota.
Byzov disse que o mercado está acompanhando de perto a eleição presidencial no Brasil neste domingo, que pode ter implicações para a moeda local e para as vendas dos cafeicultores.
O café robusta caiu 1,8%, para US$3.364 por tonelada métrica.
AÇÚCAR
O preço do açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,07 centavos, ou 0,3%, a 20,45 centavos por libra-peso, após atingir na semana passada uma máxima de 19 meses, de 21,29.
Foi a quarta sessão consecutiva de perdas para o açúcar, embora pequenas.
Com os fundos mantendo uma posição comprada quase recorde, o mercado está sujeito a uma correção, afirmaram os corretores.
O déficit de oferta no mercado global de açúcar, ou a diferença entre produção e demanda, foi projetado na terça-feira para crescer para 6,28 milhões de toneladas, 3 milhões de toneladas a mais do que a estimativa anterior, de acordo com a analista de mercado Green Pool Commodities.
O preço do açúcar branco caiu 0,6%, para US$ 543,70 a tonelada.
CACAU O preço do cacau em Londres fechou em alta de £24, ou 0,5%, a £4.469 por tonelada.
O presidente de Gana, John Dramani Mahama, disse na quarta-feira que o país tem como meta processar pelo menos 50% dos grãos de cacau localmente, com apenas 50% da produção anual disponível para exportação.
"Isso deve trazer parte do processamento para o país e gerar empregos para a população", disse ele.
O cacau de Nova York subiu 0,7%, para US$ 5.843 por tonelada.
(Reportagem de Sybille de La Hamaide e Marcelo Teixeira)

items.title: Federación de Costa Rica confirma a ex capitán Bryan Ruiz como DT de selección rumbo a Mundial 2030
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) confirmó el miércoles al histórico ex capitán de la selección mayor, Bryan Ruiz, como director técnico de la selección centroamericana para encabezar el proceso hacia la Copa del Mundo del 2030.
items.body:
La Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) confirmó el miércoles al histórico ex capitán de la selección mayor, Bryan Ruiz, como director técnico de la selección centroamericana para encabezar el proceso hacia la Copa del Mundo del 2030.
Ruiz, de 41 años, asume su primera experiencia como entrenador de la selección después de dirigirla de manera interina en dos triunfos el 1 y el 4 de octubre en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, tras el fracaso del argentino Fernando "Bocha" Batista que provocó su despido.
"Como futbolista, Bryan Ruiz fue durante años uno de los grandes referentes de la Selección Nacional y llevó con orgullo la cinta de capitán de la Tricolor. Ahora, desde el banquillo, pondrá al servicio de Costa Rica toda esa experiencia, liderazgo y conocimiento del fútbol nacional e internacional y de la selección", informó la FCRF en un comunicado.
El nuevo seleccionador viene de dirigir en las ligas menores del club local Alajuelense. En septiembre dirigió al primer equipo en dos juegos de Copa Centroamericana antes de ser llamado como emergente a la selección.
Dos victorias contra Nicaragua y Haití permitieron a los "ticos" mantener la categoría y opciones de jugar la fase preliminar para ir a la Copa Oro de 2027, aunque quedaron fuera de la Liga de Naciones.
Satisfechos por un mejor desempeño, los seleccionados costarricenses alabaron las virtudes de Ruiz después de esos juegos y pidieron que continúe, al igual que los dirigentes para intentar volver a un Mundial, pues Costa Rica se ausentó en 2026 al fracasar en la clasificación con el técnico mexicano Miguel "Piojo" Herrera.
Ruiz asume como técnico de la selección cuatro años después de retirarse como jugador, y después de brillar como centrocampista ofensivo en el Alajuelense, en el Twente de Países Bajos y en el Fulham de Inglaterra, además de participar en los mundiales de Brasil 2014, Rusia 2018 y Qatar 2022.
El nuevo director técnico estará acompañado por los ex seleccionados Wilmer López y Christian Bolaños como asistentes, además del ex portero Wardy Alfaro.
Ruiz debutará como técnico oficial en partidos amistosos ante las selecciones de Ecuador el 13 de noviembre en Quito, y tres días después ante Argentina en Córdoba.

Oct 21 : Crocodilians — today's crocodiles, alligators, caimans and gharials and their many extinct relatives — have been a roaring success since debuting more than 240 million years ago. And new research identifies one important factor in their success — stubbornly keeping to warm climates throughout their history.
In fact, the researchers said, this trait may help explain why crocs as a group survived the asteroid strike 66 million years ago that doomed the dinosaurs, along with certain physiological characteristics that make them one tough bunch of reptiles.
The crocodilian evolutionary lineage, called Pseudosuchia, arose during the Triassic Period in the aftermath of Earth's worst mass extinction event at the end of the Permian, appearing on the scene millions of years before the first dinosaurs and mammals.
The researchers tracked the geographic range for crocs during their entire history, guided by an evolutionary tree of more than 400 extinct and living species. They used data from more than 7,000 fossils and geographic records of modern crocs such as the alligators of Florida, saltwater crocodiles of Australia, gharials of India, caimans of Brazil and more.

They combined this information with 52 global palaeoclimate reconstructions to determine the climatic conditions under which crocs lived over time. While other groups such as dinosaurs and mammals conquered a variety of climates, the study showed that crocs consistently kept to warm climes.
"Rather than continually adapting to new climatic conditions, they largely tracked suitable environments as these shifted geographically, expanding towards the poles during warmer periods and retreating towards the equator during cooler ones," said University College London vertebrate paleontologist Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, lead author of the research published in the journal Science Advances.
For example, during an exceptionally warm moment in Earth's history around 50 million years ago, Chiarenza said, crocs inhabited high-latitude regions of North America, Europe and even Antarctica.
"One of the most striking patterns is the repeated expansion and contraction of suitable habitat in response to global temperature changes," Chiarenza said.
While living crocs are primarily semiaquatic ambush predators, their extinct relatives included a broad diversity of forms, University College London paleontologist and study co-author Philip Mannion said.
"They have occupied almost every conceivable ecological role," Chiarenza said.
There were fully land-dwelling apex predators like 30-foot-long (9-meter-long) Fasolasuchus, pug-snouted herbivores like Simosuchus, armored plant-eaters like Aetosaurus, mollusk-eaters like Kuttanacaiman, filter-feeders like Mourasuchus and ocean-going types like Metriorhynchus. During the age of dinosaurs, there also were semiaquatic crocs like Deinosuchus up to 40 feet (12 meters) long that may have rivaled Tyrannosaurus in mass.
"Modern crocodilians are only the surviving remnants of a once extraordinarily diverse evolutionary group," Chiarenza said.
DISASTER FROM ABOVE
The asteroid strike at a site called Chicxulub off the coast of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula at the end of the Cretaceous unleashed a global environmental cataclysm. Three-quarters of Earth's species including the dinosaurs, aside from their bird descendants, vanished. The crocs survived.
"The Chicxulub impact caused a dramatic reduction in incoming sunlight, producing an impact winter and widespread environmental disruption. However, our climate simulations suggest that this cooling did not affect the availability of suitable climatic conditions equally for all groups," Chiarenza said.
"Under all but the most extreme impact scenario we tested, tropical and subtropical regions retained climatic conditions suitable" for the crocs, Chiarenza said.
This suggests that the longstanding association of crocs with warm and low-latitude environments may have placed some surviving populations in geographic refuges near the equator and in the subtropics where climatic conditions remained within their tolerances, Chiarenza said.
For dinosaurs, there was a collapse of suitable habitat under these impact conditions.
Crocs also possess physiological traits beneficial for times of environmental stress. They can enter states of dormancy to cope with harsh conditions — aestivation to survive extreme heat or drought, and brumation to withstand extreme cold. Crocs today, for instance, may dig burrows or encase themselves in hardened mud during severe droughts, slowing their heartbeat and breathing.
"Following the Chicxulub impact, when sunlight was dramatically reduced and terrestrial primary productivity collapsed, the ability to reduce energy expenditure and survive periods of limited food availability could have been extremely advantageous," Chiarenza said.
Crocs also are cold-blooded, while recent research points to at least some dinosaurs including Tyrannosaurus as warm-blooded. Baseline metabolic requirements for cold-blooded animals are much lower than for comparably sized warm-blooded animals.
"That can become a significant advantage when food becomes scarce. Crocodilians can survive extended periods without feeding," Chiarenza said. "But even if an animal can survive prolonged starvation, it still needs environmental conditions that remain within its physiological limits."

Source: Reuters

While other groups such as dinosaurs and [USN:L1N45T0VO TEXT:"mammals"] conquered a variety of climates, the study showed that crocs consistently kept to warm climes.
"Rather than continually adapting to new climatic conditions, they largely tracked suitable environments as these shifted geographically, expanding towards the poles during warmer periods and retreating towards the equator during cooler ones," said University College London vertebrate paleontologist Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, lead author of the research published in the journal Science Advances .
For example, during an exceptionally warm moment in Earth's history around 50 million years ago, Chiarenza said, crocs inhabited high-latitude regions of North America, Europe and even Antarctica.
"One of the most striking patterns is the repeated expansion and contraction of suitable habitat in response to global temperature changes," Chiarenza said.
While living crocs are primarily semiaquatic ambush predators, their extinct relatives included a broad diversity of forms, University College London paleontologist and study co-author Philip Mannion said.
"They have occupied almost every conceivable ecological role," Chiarenza said.
There were fully land-dwelling apex predators like 30-foot-long (9-meter-long) Fasolasuchus, pug-snouted herbivores like Simosuchus, armored plant-eaters like Aetosaurus, mollusk-eaters like Kuttanacaiman, filter-feeders like Mourasuchus and ocean-going types like Metriorhynchus. During the age of dinosaurs, there also were semiaquatic crocs like Deinosuchus up to 40 feet (12 meters) long that may have rivaled Tyrannosaurus in mass.
"Modern crocodilians are only the surviving remnants of a once extraordinarily diverse evolutionary group," Chiarenza said.
DISASTER FROM ABOVE The asteroid strike at a site called Chicxulub off the coast of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula at the end of the Cretaceous unleashed a [USN:L1N3BU2U6 TEXT:"global environmental cataclysm"]. Three-quarters of Earth's species [USN:L1N32W1OO TEXT:"including the dinosaurs"], aside from their bird descendants, vanished. The crocs survived.
"The Chicxulub impact caused a dramatic reduction in incoming sunlight, producing an impact winter and widespread environmental disruption. However, our climate simulations suggest that this cooling did not affect the availability of suitable climatic conditions equally for all groups," Chiarenza said.
"Under all but the most extreme impact scenario we tested, tropical and subtropical regions retained climatic conditions suitable" for the crocs, Chiarenza said.
This suggests that the longstanding association of crocs with warm and low-latitude environments may have placed some surviving populations in geographic refuges near the equator and in the subtropics where climatic conditions remained within their tolerances, Chiarenza said.
For dinosaurs, there was a collapse of suitable habitat under these impact conditions.
Crocs also possess physiological traits beneficial for times of environmental stress. They can enter states of dormancy to cope with harsh conditions — aestivation to survive extreme heat or drought, and brumation to withstand extreme cold. Crocs today, for instance, may dig burrows or encase themselves in hardened mud during severe droughts, slowing their heartbeat and breathing.
"Following the Chicxulub impact, when sunlight was dramatically reduced and terrestrial primary productivity collapsed, the ability to reduce energy expenditure and survive periods of limited food availability could have been extremely advantageous," Chiarenza said.
Crocs also are cold-blooded, while recent research points to at least some dinosaurs including [USN:L1N4560E4 TEXT:"Tyrannosaurus as warm-blooded"]. Baseline metabolic requirements for cold-blooded animals are much lower than for comparably sized warm-blooded animals.
"That can become a significant advantage when food becomes scarce. Crocodilians can survive extended periods without feeding," Chiarenza said. "But even if an animal can survive prolonged starvation, it still needs environmental conditions that remain within its physiological limits."
items.raw_description: Crocodilians — today's crocodiles, alligators, caimans and gharials and their many extinct relatives — have been a roaring success since debuting more than 240 million years ago. And new research identifies one important factor in their success — stubbornly keeping to warm climates throughout their history.

items.title: Diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos entra en carrera por la jefatura de la ONU
items.author: Maha Dahan
items.creator: Maha Dahan
items.summary: Lana Nusseibeh, una diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, ingresó el miércoles a la carrera por la secretaría general de la ONU, lo que supone la incorporación de una destacada candidata de Oriente Medio a una contienda en la que ha resultado difícil alcanzar consenso.
items.body:
Lana Nusseibeh, una diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, ingresó el miércoles a la carrera por la secretaría general de la ONU, lo que supone la incorporación de una destacada candidata de Oriente Medio a una contienda en la que ha resultado difícil alcanzar consenso.
Nusseibeh, que fue embajadora de los EAU ante la ONU durante más de una década, declaró a Reuters que trataría de restablecer el papel del organismo como mediador diplomático en un momento de crecientes crisis globales.
"Está claro que hoy necesitamos un secretario general que pueda renovar su compromiso con el futuro del multilateralismo y con el futuro de las Naciones Unidas como mediador, en lugar de como mero espectador de las crisis mundiales", afirmó poco antes de hacer pública su candidatura.
Nusseibeh, ministra de Estado de Asuntos Exteriores de los EAU, se ha sumado tarde a la carrera. Según algunas fuentes, una encuesta informal del Consejo de Seguridad situaba a Rebeca Grynspan, exvicepresidenta de Costa Rica, como la favorita por un estrecho margen.
Aunque Grynspan ha liderado las "encuestas informales", la semana pasada tanto ella como el resto de candidatos recibieron dos o más votos en contra de los cinco miembros permanentes del Consejo -Reino Unido, China, Francia, Rusia y Estados Unidos-, que son los que tienen la última palabra.
Los miembros del Consejo están negociando si celebrar otra votación el viernes o en una fecha posterior.
Nusseibeh, de 48 años, afirmó que varios países se pusieron en contacto con ella durante la última Asamblea General de la ONU para que presentara su candidatura. Los diplomáticos en Nueva York afirman que es respetada por su competencia como gestora.
"Hoy en día se reconoce que necesitamos a alguien que aporte un cambio generacional a la organización", afirmó.
Su permanencia en la ONU coincidió con el estallido de la guerra de Gaza en 2023, cuando logró que se aprobara la Resolución 2720, allanando el camino para la entrega de ayuda humanitaria.
Nusseibeh explicó que consiguió el apoyo a la resolución organizando una visita de los miembros del Consejo al paso fronterizo de Rafá para que pudieran comprobar por sí mismos la situación en terreno, y describió la iniciativa como parte de la "diplomacia emprendedora y creativa" que caracteriza su enfoque.
Una victoria de Nusseibeh la convertiría en la segunda secretaria general de la ONU procedente de Oriente Medio, tras el egipcio Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
"Vengo de un país que es más joven que las Naciones Unidas, pero nuestra región se ha enfrentado a graves desafíos", afirmó.
También se convertiría en la primera mujer en dirigir la ONU, aunque Nusseibeh señaló que no se presentaba por su género.
"Creo que sería estupendo que el próximo secretario general fuera una mujer, pero no me presento por ser mujer; me presento porque soy obstinadamente optimista sobre el futuro de las Naciones Unidas y creo que necesitamos a alguien que sea incansable en la búsqueda de la diplomacia para abrir puertas".

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mattel said on Wednesday it has added a top executive of its largest shareholder, EdgePoint Investment Group, to its board of directors as the toymaker grapples with weak performance and leadership upheaval.
items.body:
Mattel (MAT.O) said on Wednesday it has added a top executive of its largest shareholder, EdgePoint Investment Group, to its board of directors as the toymaker grapples with weak performance and leadership upheaval.
The company has faced pressure from some investors asking the company to consider a sale this year as it battles choppy sales and higher input costs.
The Barbie maker appointed EdgePoint partner Lee Matheson to its board, effective immediately.
EdgePoint owns about 18% of Mattel.

items.title: Trading Day: Tech it away
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: Buoyant AI sentiment on the back of quarterly results from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer lifted Wall Street on Wednesday, as relatively calm energy, currency, and US bond markets allowed tech earnings to dominate. European markets were more lively, however, and France's 10-year bond yield rose above 5% for the first time in nearly a quarter of a century.
items.body:
Buoyant AI sentiment on the back of quarterly results from [USN:L6N4670OB TEXT:"SpaceX"] and [USN:L4N4670MA TEXT:"Super Micro Computer"] lifted [USN:L4N4670PS TEXT:"Wall Street"] on Wednesday, as relatively calm energy, currency, and US bond markets allowed tech earnings to dominate. European markets were more lively, however, and [USN:L6N4670MD TEXT:"France's 10-year bond yield"] rose above 5% for the first time in nearly a quarter of a century.
In [USN:L6N46613H TEXT:"my column today"], I look at five AI quirks and conundrums that investors should be aware of as the US earnings season gets underway.
Today's Key Reads
[USN:FWN4661WD TEXT:"Government websites go dark as software flaw sparks security scramble"]
[USN:L4N4661JI TEXT:"Anthropic logged net loss of over $80 billion in first half of 2026"]
[USN:L6N46617I TEXT:"Smouldering debt risk haunts French markets: Mike Dolan"]
[USN:L8N4661GS TEXT:"UK inflation and borrowing climb before Healey’s first budget"]
[USN:L6N467165 TEXT:"Meta ordered to pay $25 billion to New Mexico after jury finds company misled consumers about data privacy"]
Today's Key Market Moves
STOCKS: South Korea +3.3%, best day since September 7. [USN:L4N4670HV TEXT:"Europe"] +1%, [USN:L6N4670O3 TEXT:"UK"] steady. Mexico +1.5%. Nasdaq +1%, Dow +0.7%, S&P 500 +0.6%.
SECTORS/SHARES: Seven sectors on the S&P 500 rise, four fall. Tech +1.6%, communications services -1.3%. [USN:L4N4671RL TEXT:"Meta"] +4% after the bell on earnings, [USN:L4N4671SB TEXT:"Tesla"] +2%, [USN:L6N4650TO TEXT:"IBM"] +7%.
FX: [USN:L1N46700T TEXT:"US dollar"] steady. Biggest G10 gainer is [USN:P8N44M02K TEXT:"Aussie dollar"], [USN:L4N467067 TEXT:"Indian rupee"] rises to six-week high. Biggest decliner Mexican peso, -1.5%.
BONDS: [USN:L6N4670MD TEXT:"French"] 10-year yield hits 5% for first time since 2002. US 20-year auction mixed — 2.73 bid/cover at the higher end of range of the last year, but highest auction yield since 1986, some analysts say.
COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N4661ZE TEXT:"Oil"] mixed — Brent steady, WTI settles lower. [USN:L4N467007 TEXT:"Gold"] little changed at $4,135/oz.

Today's Talking Points:
Anthropic
AI leader [USN:L4N4661JI TEXT:"Anthropic"] posted a whopping $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of this year. That was up significantly from a $13 billion loss a year earlier, largely due to a $72 billion accounting charge. The net loss is almost double the $42 billion loss reported for calendar year 2025. Revenue in the first six months of the year was just over $16 billion.
Are these figures bullish or bearish? Depends which camp you're in. The headline loss is alarming, but it was mainly due to a one-off charge. Revenue is low and growth is slowing, but exclude the accounting charge and break-even doesn't look quite so far away. However, are the numbers and trends those of a company eyeing a $1.5-$2 trillion IPO valuation?
Sub subprime
Is the US housing market frozen? It's certainly seizing up, which is traditionally a major red flag for the wider economy. [USN:L1N4650NQ TEXT:"Pending home sales"] in September plunged to the lowest since records began a quarter of a century ago, and [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"housing starts"] fell 5.2% in the month to their lowest since the pandemic. US homebuilder sentiment, meanwhile, has plunged to the lowest level in nearly 14-1/2 years.
Rising Fed interest rates, stubbornly high home prices, and mortgage rates the highest in three years at 7.50% are all factors. But it is remarkable that activity now is even weaker than it was at the heights — or depths? — of the 2008 US housing market crash and its aftermath, and the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020. Given the importance of housing and related services to the US economy, growth could suffer.
Pounding the beat
UK finance minister John Healey delivers his first budget next week. To say he faces a few challenges would be an understatement. [USN:L8N4661Q9 TEXT:"Figures this week"] show government borrowing in September rose more than expected again, and public debt surpassed the psychologically key £3 trillion mark. Part of the reason why borrowing last month rose so much was debt interest payments — bond yields are the highest in decades, and with the debt pile growing, it's a difficult cycle to get out of. He has little wiggle room next week.
Bad news for sterling, right? Not necessarily. The latest [USN:L8N4661GS TEXT:"inflation"] and [USN:L8N4650JW TEXT:"wage growth"] data have cemented market expectations for a rate hike on November 5. Indeed, traders now reckon the Bank of England will be the most hawkish G10 central bank over the next year or so, along with the Reserve Bank of New Zealand, and raise rates more than 100 bps. Sterling has pounced on the euro's weakness, surging almost 3% in the last month to its highest since May last year. And cable is rebounding from its year low. Next stop $1.35?
What could move markets tomorrow?
New Zealand inflation (September)
[USN:L6N46505J TEXT:"South Korea"] interest rate decision
Canada PPI inflation (September)
US Treasury sells $26 billion of 5-year TIPS
US earnings including Procter & Gamble, Union Pacific, Western Digital, Lockheed Martin

items.summary: Bank of America announced two new board members on Wednesday, appointing Jim Fitterling, 65, and Bill Thomas, 58, effective immediately.
items.body:
Bank of America (BAC.N) announced two new board members on Wednesday, appointing Jim Fitterling, 65, and Bill Thomas, 58, effective immediately.
Both were previously CEOs of large companies: Fitterling led Dow (DOW.N) , where he is still executive chairman, and Thomas has been KPMG's chairman and CEO.
“We are pleased to welcome two seasoned CEOs," said Bank of America's Chair and CEO Brian Moynihan.
Bank of America's lead independent director, Lionel Nowell III, said both members would help strengthen oversight of the bank's long-term strategy.
The two executives will replace former board members who had retired earlier this year after reaching the retirement age of 75, Pierre de Weck and Linda Hudson.

items.title: Papa Leão não precisará de mais tratamento contra o câncer, dizem médicos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Papa Leão não precisará de mais nenhum tratamento após ter sido submetido a uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão na semana passada, informaram seus médicos nesta quarta-feira, indicando que o tumor não havia se espalhado.
items.body:
O Papa Leão não precisará de mais nenhum tratamento após ter sido submetido a uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão na semana passada, informaram seus médicos nesta quarta-feira, indicando que o tumor não havia se espalhado.
O anúncio foi feito em um momento em que ainda não estava claro se o papa, nascido nos Estados Unidos, seguiria adiante com a viagem planejada ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru, marcada para os dias 6 a 17 de novembro.
O pontífice, de 71 anos, passou por uma cirurgia em 13 de outubro para a remoção do lobo inferior do pulmão direito e foi diagnosticado com adenocarcinoma pulmonar, a forma mais comum de câncer de pulmão.
Exames histológicos finais e análises de biologia molecular do tecido removido confirmaram o diagnóstico, com a doença permanecendo localizada, afirmaram os médicos em comunicado divulgado pelo Vaticano.
“Uma avaliação oncológica posterior confirmou que não é necessária nenhuma terapia adicional”, afirmaram o cirurgião-chefe do papa, Stefano Margaritora, e seu médico pessoal, Luigi Carbone.
Leão recebeu alta do hospital no sábado e está retomando gradualmente suas atividades normais. Nesta quarta-feira, ele voltou à Praça de São Pedro para sua audiência semanal com os peregrinos.
Margaritora afirmou na semana passada que não havia “nenhuma razão clínica” que impedisse o papa de viajar para a América do Sul, mas o secretário de Estado do Vaticano indicou que o pontífice talvez precise ajustar o ritmo de sua agenda para facilitar sua recuperação.

items.summary: Tesla anunció el miércoles un inesperado flujo de caja positivo del tercer trimestre, ya que gastó mucho menos de lo que esperaban los analistas en sus proyectos de inteligencia artificial y robótica, en un momento en el que el fabricante de vehículos eléctricos está considerando una fusión con SpaceX , la firma de cohetes de su presidente ejecutivo, Elon Musk.
items.body:
Tesla anunció el miércoles un inesperado flujo de caja positivo del tercer trimestre, ya que gastó mucho menos de lo que esperaban los analistas en sus proyectos de inteligencia artificial y robótica, en un momento en el que el fabricante de vehículos eléctricos está considerando una fusión con SpaceX (SPCX.O) , la firma de cohetes de su presidente ejecutivo, Elon Musk.
Las acciones de Tesla (TSLA.O) subían más de un 1,7% en las operaciones tras el cierre de la sesión regular.
El gasto de capital en el tercer trimestre se situó en 4.730 millones de dólares, frente a la previsión de unos 7.500 millones, lo que contrasta con los 5.790 millones del segundo trimestre y se compara con los 2.250 millones del año anterior.
El flujo de caja libre en el trimestre de septiembre se situó en 1.530 millones de dólares, frente a la previsión de que quemara 4.920 millones de dólares de efectivo.
La empresa también superó las estimaciones de Wall Street en cuanto a los ingresos del tercer trimestre, ya que el repunte en las entregas de vehículos, impulsadas por los altos precios de la gasolina, y el crecimiento de su unidad de almacenamiento de energía impulsaron las ventas.
Musk había dicho el martes que una fusión entre Tesla y SpaceX era una "buena idea" y que las empresas habían creado comités especiales para debatir un acuerdo.
El fabricante de automóviles de Austin, en Texas, registró ingresos de 28.050 millones de dólares en el trimestre que finalizó el 30 de septiembre, frente a la estimación promedio de los analistas de 27.880 millones de dólares, según datos recopilados por LSEG.
Tesla entregó 486.532 vehículos en el tercer trimestre, superando las expectativas de Wall Street, que se situaban en torno a los 461.100 vehículos. Las entregas descendieron aproximadamente un 2% respecto del año anterior.
Su negocio principal de automoción sigue bajo la lupa, ya que sus rivales lanzan modelos más nuevos y, a menudo, más baratos, mientras que Tesla se apoya en gran medida en los ya veteranos Model 3 y Model Y.
La compañía ha dicho que superó los 10 millones de vehículos entregados y que el Model Y va camino de convertirse en el vehículo más vendido del mundo este año.

items.title: CV e PCC não declararam apoio a Lula no 2º turno, dizem órgãos competentes
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: As facções criminosas Comando Vermelho (CV) e Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) não manifestaram apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno das eleições, que ocorre no próximo domingo.
items.body:
As facções criminosas Comando Vermelho (CV) e Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) não manifestaram apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno das eleições, que ocorre no próximo domingo.
“PCC e CV declaram apoio a Lula no 2º turno”, anunciam postagens no Facebook.
As publicações reaproveitam um post da Jovem Pan divulgado no Facebook no último dia 7, cujo texto original é “PSTU e PCB declaram apoio a Lula no 2º turno”.
Não há registros de que a emissora ou qualquer outro veículo de imprensa tenha noticiado a suposta adesão das facções à candidatura do presidente.
À Reuters, a Procuradoria-Geral Eleitoral (PGE) disse que não identificou “nenhuma representação que mencione que lideranças do PCC, do CV ou de outra organização criminosa teriam declarado apoio a qualquer candidatura”.
Segundo o órgão, há ao menos um caso relacionado ao tema, no qual um cidadão questiona a divulgação de “notícias falsas” que vinculam tais grupos ao petista.
O Ministério Público do Rio de Janeiro (MPRJ), Estado onde surgiu o CV, disse que não encontrou informações sobre pronunciamentos de lideranças de organizações criminosas em apoio a candidatos.
O Ministério Público de São Paulo (MPSP), Estado berço do PCC, não havia enviado uma resposta até a publicação desta checagem.
No pleito deste ano, o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) derrubou propagandas que associavam Lula a facções, além de peças que indicavam uma ligação de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), adversário do petista no segundo turno, com criminosos.
Na campanha eleitoral de 2022, a Reuters desmentiu posts que diziam que Lula havia usado um boné em alusão ao crime organizado -- mas que na verdade trazia a abreviação de “complexo” -- e que afirmavam que ele tinha declarado ter pago o PCC , quando na realidade se referiu ao Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).
VEREDICTO Falso. Órgãos do Ministério Público negaram que facções criminosas tenham declarado apoio a Lula no segundo turno das eleições de 2026.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: EUA ordenam que diplomatas deixem Arábia Saudita em meio a ataques dos houthis
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Departamento de Estado dos Estados Unidos ordenou que alguns diplomatas e seus familiares deixassem suas missões na Arábia Saudita e planeja retirar familiares de várias outras missões norte-americanas no Golfo Pérsico, informaram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters.
items.body:
O Departamento de Estado dos Estados Unidos ordenou que alguns diplomatas e seus familiares deixassem suas missões na Arábia Saudita e planeja retirar familiares de várias outras missões norte-americanas no Golfo Pérsico, informaram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters.
O porta-voz do Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, afirmou em uma postagem no X que o departamento ordenou a saída de “funcionários não essenciais do governo dos EUA e seus familiares apenas na Arábia Saudita”, em meio aos ataques dos houthis — alinhados ao Irã — no Iêmen contra alvos civis no país.
Washington havia enviado de volta alguns membros do corpo diplomático à região nos últimos meses, depois que muitos haviam sido retirados quando Teerã lançou ataques de retaliação contra instalações norte-americanas após o início da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, no final de fevereiro.
“Os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, têm se envolvido cada vez mais em hostilidades contra a Arábia Saudita, incluindo ataques a aeroportos civis e outras infraestruturas críticas, resultando em vítimas civis e graves interrupções nas viagens”, disse Pigott.
Quatro autoridades norte-americanas disseram à Reuters que as missões dos EUA em outros países do Golfo Pérsico também estariam ordenando que familiares deixassem o local. Pigott não se pronunciou sobre mudanças em outras missões fora da Arábia Saudita.
A embaixada dos EUA em Riad emitiu um alerta de segurança nesta quarta-feira sobre possíveis novos ataques dos houthis à Arábia Saudita, após recentes ataques mortais, incluindo um ao aeroporto de Riad.

items.title: Colheita nos EUA e negociações sobre Ucrânia pressionam grãos em Chicago
items.author: Renee Hickman
items.creator: Renee Hickman
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do trigo e do milho negociados na bolsa de Chicago caíram para mínimas de três meses nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o avanço da colheita nos EUA, os novos esforços diplomáticos para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia e as vendas técnicas pesaram sobre os preços.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do trigo e do milho negociados na bolsa de Chicago caíram para mínimas de três meses nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o avanço da colheita nos EUA, os novos esforços diplomáticos para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia e as vendas técnicas pesaram sobre os preços.
O contrato de trigo mais negociado fechou em queda de 15 centavos, a US$6,2825 o bushel. O contrato de soja mais ativo recuou 3 centavos, para US$12,4525.
O milho encerrou em alta de 1,25 centavo, para US$ 4,63-1/4 o bushel, após cair no início do pregão.
Novas negociações entre os EUA e a Rússia para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia pressionaram os preços dos grãos, afirmou Arlan Suderman, economista-chefe de commodities da StoneX.
As discussões aumentaram as expectativas de uma possível redução da tensão, o que poderia reativar os embarques de grãos por essa importante rota marítima.
O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, recebeu o enviado dos EUA, Steve Witkoff, na quarta-feira, um dia após Witkoff se reunir com o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, na Noruega.
O avanço da colheita nos EUA incentivou os fundos de investimento a liquidar posições compradas acumuladas nos últimos meses, quando os mercados de grãos atingiram máximas não vistas há vários anos.
A previsão de tempo seco em todo o Meio-Oeste nesta semana deve permitir que os agricultores norte-americanos acelerem a colheita do que o governo projeta ser grandes safras de milho e soja. As chuvas da semana passada deixaram o andamento da colheita abaixo das expectativas do mercado.
A oferta da safra ofuscou a renovada demanda chinesa por soja dos EUA, já que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA confirmou mais compras na terça-feira.
No Brasil, os agricultores haviam plantado 26% da área projetada para a safra de soja 2026/27 até a última quinta-feira, informou na segunda-feira a consultoria do agronegócio AgRural.
