items.title: ロシア、ウクライナの首都キーウに弾道ミサイル攻撃　6人負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２１日 ロイター] - ロシアは２１日夜、ウクライナの首都キーウに対する弾道ミサイル攻撃を実施した。ウクライナ当局によると、住宅やガソリンスタンド、交通関連設備が損傷したほか、６人が負傷した。

キーウのクリチコ市長は通信アプリ「テレグラム」で、市内を流れるドニプロ川東岸の２地区が攻撃を受けた。負傷した６人のうち４人が病院で治療を受けているという。

最初の警報発令から２時間以上が経過した後も、市内ではドローン攻撃への警戒が続いていた。

items.title: Acción de SpaceX se dispara en bolsa: la IA supera a Starlink y Wall Street cree que puede subir 60%Acción de SpaceX se dispara en bolsa: la IA supera a Starlink y Wall ...
items.author: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
items.summary: La división de inteligencia artificial de SpaceX aumentó sus ingresos 830% interanual y superó por primera vez a Starlink como principal negocio de la compañía.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — SpaceX ( SPCX ) gana terreno en Wall Street tras unos resultados trimestrales que confirman el avance de la inteligencia artificial como su principal fuente de ingresos, mientras Elon Musk abre la posibilidad de una fusión con Tesla ( TSLA ). Ver más: El oro digital apunta a US$170.000 millones en 2031: qué es y qué impulsa su expansión Las acciones de la compañía subieron 7,79% a US$159,31, después de que sus ingresos aumentaran 161% interanual en el tercer trimestre. El negocio de inteligencia artificial superó por primera vez a Starlink y a las operaciones espaciales. El optimismo también se refleja en las recomendaciones de Wall Street: el 77,6% de los analistas aconseja comprar sus acciones con un potencial alcista de 50,3% respecto al cierre de ayer, según Bloomberg . Elon Musk reconoció el atractivo de una integración con Tesla. “¿Creo que sería una buena idea? Sí”, dijo durante la conferencia de resultados. SpaceX registró ingresos de US$14.600 millones en el tercer trimestre, un aumento interanual de 161% , y un beneficio neto de US$4.400 millones. Un año antes había reportado pérdidas de US$1.100 millones. Así se han comportado las acciones de SpaceX. Símbolo: SPCX:UN. Clase de activo: equity. Ruben Dalfovo, estratega de inversiones de Saxo Bank, destacó que “más de la mitad de los ingresos de SpaceX provienen ahora de la inteligencia artificial, no de cohetes ni satélites”, un cambio en la composición del negocio de la compañía. La división Super Intelligence generó US$7.600 millones, con un crecimiento interanual de 830% y un avance trimestral de 195%. El negocio superó las previsiones de US$6.500 millones del consenso y de US$6.900 millones de Citi ( C ). La unidad obtuvo un EBITDA ajustado de US$5.000 millones, por encima de los US$3.600 millones proyectados por el banco. La expansión refleja nuevos contratos de capacidad informática, la adopción de Grok y la adquisición de Cursor. → Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. SpaceX completó en agosto la compra de esta plataforma de programación asistida por inteligencia artificial, mediante una operación con una valoración implícita de US$60.000 millones. John Godyn, analista de Citi, destacó que “los resultados de cada uno de los tres segmentos principales de SPCX superaron nuestras previsiones en prácticamente todos los indicadores clave que impulsan la acción, incluidos ingresos, beneficio bruto y EBITDA ajustado”. La compañía proyectó ingresos de entre US$33.000 millones y US$37.000 millones para el primer trimestre de 2027, frente a un consenso cercano a US$23.000 millones, según Citi. Godyn también subrayó que “la dirección hizo un esfuerzo especial por dejar claro hasta qué punto la compañía estaba superando las expectativas del consenso”. El banco elevó su precio objetivo para SpaceX de US$200 a US$240, equivalente a un potencial alcista de 62,4% respecto del cierre del martes. También aumentó su estimación de beneficio por acción para 2027 de US$2,14 a US$3,25. La expansión exige inversiones considerables. SpaceX prevé cerrar 2027 con unos 13 gigavatios de capacidad informática, frente a su objetivo anterior de entre cinco y diez gigavatios. Ver más: Goldman Sachs advierte sobre riesgos en Wall Street y revela 23 acciones para protegerse Para el cuarto trimestre, la compañía anticipó inversiones de capital de entre US$35.000 millones y US$40.000 millones, por encima de los US$27.800 millones previstos por Citi. El negocio de conectividad, que incluye Starlink, registró ingresos de US$5.200 millones, un aumento interanual de 69%, y un beneficio operativo de US$2.400 millones. Los suscriptores particulares alcanzaron 13,6 millones, aunque las incorporaciones netas disminuyeron a 1,6 millones, desde 1,7 millones en el segundo trimestre. John Butler, analista de Bloomberg Intelligence , sostuvo que “los resultados de conectividad de SpaceX en el tercer trimestre refuerzan nuestra opinión de que la disponibilidad comercial de Starship es clave para desbloquear la siguiente etapa de crecimiento de la unidad”. El ingreso promedio por usuario alcanzó US$69, frente a una estimación de US$65, gracias a una mayor participación de mercados desarrollados y al desempeño de los segmentos empresarial y gubernamental. Bloomberg Intelligence observó que “los resultados de Starlink mostraron fuertes economías de escala, ya que US$1.000 millones de ingresos secuenciales adicionales elevaron el beneficio operativo en US$700 millones”. Ver más: ¿Adiós a la estrategia 60/40? Wall Street debate cómo invertir en acciones y bonos Sin embargo, el crecimiento no se tradujo en una generación positiva de efectivo. Según Bloomberg Intelligence , SpaceX consumió aproximadamente US$23.000 millones de flujo de caja libre durante el trimestre. En inteligencia artificial, la inversión de capital rondó US$16.000 millones, frente a un EBITDA de US$3.500 millones bajo las cifras utilizadas por Bloomberg Intelligence , pese al pequeño beneficio operativo de la división. La próxima prueba del vuelo 15 de Starship también concentra la atención, después de que SpaceX confirmara que intentará recuperar la segunda etapa mediante el sistema de brazos mecánicos conocido como chopsticks . Godyn considera que la prueba constituye “un acontecimiento monumental que representa un avance fundamental para el valor futuro”, dentro de los hitos tecnológicos necesarios para ampliar la reutilización de Starship. El precio objetivo promedio de los analistas para SpaceX aumentó 8,2% en una semana, desde US$221,12 el 14 de octubre hasta US$239,42 el 21 de octubre, según datos de Bloomberg . El 77,6% de los analistas recomienda comprar acciones de la empresa, frente al 14,3% que aconseja mantenerlas y el 8,2% que sugiere vender. El precio objetivo implica un potencial alcista de 50,3%. Ver más: Tesla Roadster: así reaccionan las acciones a su nuevo carro volador y qué prevé Wall Street La posible fusión con Tesla añade otra variable a las perspectivas de SpaceX. Ambas compañías establecieron comités independientes para estudiar una combinación, aunque todavía no existe un acuerdo y cualquier operación requeriría la aprobación de los accionistas. La transacción reuniría los negocios de vehículos eléctricos, robótica y energía de Tesla con la infraestructura espacial, conectividad satelital y capacidad informática de SpaceX. Dalfovo, estratega de Saxo Bank, advierte que “más grande no significa automáticamente mejor”, ante una eventual combinación entre compañías cuyo valor bursátil conjunto ronda US$3,5 billones. Así se han comportado las acciones de Tesla. Símbolo: TSLA:UN. Clase de activo: equity. En Wall Street, JPMorgan ( JPM ) elevó su precio objetivo para SpaceX de US$240 a US$500 y mantuvo su recomendación de sobreponderar, con un potencial alcista de 238% respecto del cierre del martes. Doug Anmuth, analista del banco, duplicó con creces sus estimaciones para 2027 y 2028. El banco proyecta ingresos de US$254.000 millones en 2027 y una capacidad informática de diez gigavatios al cierre de ese año. Morgan Stanley ( MS ) mantuvo su recomendación de sobreponderar y un precio objetivo de US$300. Además, elevó su previsión de ingresos para 2027 de US$113.000 millones a US$178.000 millones, principalmente por el negocio de IA. El banco incrementó su estimación de ingresos de IA para 2027 de US$81.000 millones a US$146.000 millones, mientras revisó su previsión de beneficio operativo de US$35.000 millones a US$58.000 millones. Sin embargo, Morgan Stanley también elevó su proyección de inversiones de capital para 2027 de US$161.000 millones a US$278.000 millones, de los cuales US$242.000 millones corresponderían a inteligencia artificial. Citi mantiene igualmente su recomendación de compra y activó una perspectiva alcista a 90 días, respaldada por los próximos lanzamientos de Starship, nuevos modelos de Grok y avances en infraestructura energética. Ver más: Bank of America propone una nueva estrategia para invertir y superar al portafolio 60/40 Las diferencias entre las previsiones de los bancos reflejan la importancia de la ejecución de los proyectos de inteligencia artificial, el ritmo de inversión y la capacidad de SpaceX para convertir su expansión en generación de efectivo. Esta historia se actualizó al cierre de la jornada.

items.title: New Zealand's Fisher & Paykel Healthcare hit by cyber breach
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Medical device maker Fisher & Paykel Healthcare on Thursday said it was made aware of unauthorized and unlawful access to a subset of company files and two employee email accounts.
items.body:
Medical device maker Fisher & Paykel Healthcare (FPH.NZ) on Thursday said it was made aware of unauthorized and unlawful access to a subset of company files and two employee email accounts.
Here are the details:
Some of the files accessed contained personally identifiable information and the company is in the process of informing the people affected. It said it has notified the relevant authorities
"There is no evidence that the unlawful activity compromised the company's system that maintains patient data," the New Zealand company said.
Fisher & Paykel, which makes devices to treat obstructive sleep apnea, said there has been no impact on the company's products, manufacturing operations or supply chain
The company said it believes the incident is contained, with no evidence of ransomware or malware identified, and that it expects no material financial impact
New Zealand's National Cyber Security Centre did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the issue
The incident comes a day after government websites in Europe and elsewhere [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"went offline"], when the disclosure of critical flaws in a widely used programming language sent site operators worldwide scrambling to protect their systems

items.title: 米メタ、投資拡大へ無議決権株発行　ＡＩエージェント急拡大
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jaspreet Singh

[２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Jaspreet Singh

[２１日　ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは２１日、年間設備投資見通しの下限を引き上げるとともに、無議決権株を新たに発行すると発表した。巨額の投資が必要なＡＩ（人工知能）事業拡大の資金を調達する。消費者向けＡＩエージェントアプリ「ミューズ」の利用が急拡大していることも明らかにした。

この日発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドル。ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回り、株価は時間外取引で４％超上昇した。

メタは２０２７年１月に議決権のない新たなクラスＣ普通株を発行する。実質的には１対２の株式分割となる。ＡＩ開発競争が激化する中、マーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の支配権を維持しつつ、企業買収や優秀な人材の確保に必要な資金を調達することが狙い。

ザッカーバーグ氏は、米国とカナダでは１カ月半で１０００万人超がミューズのアカウントを開設し、その後も力強い伸びが続いていると指摘。ミューズが「数十億人」に利用されるようになり、メタの平均的なユーザーよりも多くの収益を生み出す可能性があるとの見方を示した。

２６年の設備投資額見通しは１３５０億─１４５０億ドル。従来見通しは１３００億─１４５０億ドルだった。

第３・四半期のフリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ）は２１億２０００万ドルのマイナス。前年同期は１０６億３０００万ドルのプラスだった。

第４・四半期の業績見通しは、売上高が７３０億─７６０億ドル。市場予想は７３７億３０００万ドルだった。

ザッカーバーグ氏は声明で「われわれの投資は成果を上げている。中核事業は好調で、全分野で勢いがみられる」とした。

＜高いコスト＞

ただ、ザッカーバーグ氏は、ミューズにかかるコストが、これまで投入してきた多くの新製品より高いと認めた。収益化については「通常の進め方よりもやや早く」着手すると述べた。 スーザン・リー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、ＡＩ事業が２７年に収益の上積みに寄与し始め、「長期的には収益源の多様化に大きく貢献する」との見通しを示した。

消費者向けＡＩエージェントのミューズが早くも人気を集め、競争力のある新たなＡＩモデル群も公開されたことで、メタは投資家に巨額支出の妥当性を説明しやすくなった。ただ、セキュリティー懸念から、ミューズによるアクセスを制限している企業もある。

インベスティング・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、ジェシー・コーエン氏は「市場はメタの支出を嫌気する姿勢から、魅力的な製品の成長シナリオを評価する姿勢へと変わった」と述べた。

一方、法的問題も増えている。ニューメキシコ州の地裁は２１日、メタに対し２５０億ドルの支払いを命じた。１６年の米大統領選でトランプ陣営に関与した政治コンサルティング会社がフェイスブック利用者数百万人のデータを本人の同意なく取得したとされる問題を巡る訴訟で、陪審がメタは利用者を欺いていたと認定したことを受けた。

イーマーケターのシニアアナリスト、ミンダ・スマイリー氏は、２５０億ドルの制裁金について「メタが現在直面している法的問題の深刻さを改めて示している。こうした問題は２７年も続く」と述べた。さらに「ＡＩエージェントが一段と普及すれば、プライバシーと安全性に関する疑問や懸念は強まるばかりだ。この分野でのメタの評判を踏まえると、最終的に同社に打撃を与える可能性がある」と語った。

さらに８月には、メタのプラットフォームが子どもを依存させるよう設計されているとして米国のほぼ全州が起こした訴訟で、同社は１０年間で最大１８０億ドルを支払い、１０代の若者によるフェイスブックとインスタグラムの利用を制限することで和解した。

第３・四半期の希薄化後１株利益（ＥＰＳ）は３．８３ドルだったが、この和解に関連する９８億９０００万ドルの費用計上がなければ、７．４０ドルだったとしている。

この和解により、メタの株価の重しとなっていた規制面の大きな懸案が解消した。また、若年利用者への対応に関する社内文書がさらに公開される恐れがあった裁判も回避できた。

ただ、メタは２１日に示した業績見通しで、若年層に関する問題を巡る監視や米国での裁判に引き続き直面しており、業績に影響する可能性があると警告した。

items.title: Meta emitirá nuevas acciones para financiar el gasto en inteligencia artificial
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Meta elevó el miércoles el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual y anunció que emitiría nuevas acciones sin derecho a voto para ayudar a financiar su costosa expansión en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial.
items.body:
Meta (META.O) elevó el miércoles el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual y anunció que emitiría nuevas acciones sin derecho a voto para ayudar a financiar su costosa expansión en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial.
Las acciones de la empresa subían alrededor de un 4% en la negociación tras el cierre de la sesión regular.
Meta ha estado invirtiendo grandes cantidades de dinero en chips y centros de datos para competir de forma más agresiva con OpenAI y Anthropic, lo que ha mermado su flujo de caja libre, que históricamente ha sido muy sólido.
Las nuevas acciones podrían permitir a la empresa financiar adquisiciones y atraer a los mejores talentos sin diluir el control de voto del presidente ejecutivo, Mark Zuckerberg, cuando la carrera por la IA en Silicon Valley se vuelve más intensa.
La empresa matriz de Facebook e Instagram ha indicado que ahora prevé que el gasto de capital se sitúe entre 135.000 millones y 145.000 millones de dólares este año, frente a la previsión anterior de entre 130.000 millones y 145.000 millones de dólares.
La empresa tuvo unos ingresos de 64.600 millones de dólares en el trimestre finalizado el 30 de septiembre, más que las previsiones de Wall Street de 63.370 millones de dólares, según datos recopilados por LSEG. Además, prevé unos ingresos para el cuarto trimestre también superiores a las estimaciones.
"Nuestras inversiones están dando frutos, el negocio principal es sólido y estamos observando un impulso generalizado", dijo Zuckerberg en un comunicado.
La rápida popularidad de su agente de IA orientado al consumidor, Muse, y el lanzamiento de una nueva y competitiva serie de modelos de IA han ayudado a Meta a justificar las inversiones, aunque algunas empresas están restringiendo el acceso al agente por motivos de seguridad.
Los retos legales también se están acumulando, incluida una multa de 25.000 millones de dólares impuesta por un juez de Nuevo México después de que un jurado determinó que Meta había engañado a los residentes del estado sobre cómo compartía los datos de los usuarios con terceros y aplicaba las políticas sobre discurso de odio y desinformación.
Meta reportó un beneficio por acción diluido de 3,83 dólares en el trimestre, una cifra que habría sido de 7,40 dólares de no ser por un cargo de 9.890 millones de dólares relacionado con un acuerdo judicial alcanzado en agosto.
El acuerdo eliminó un importante obstáculo regulatorio que había lastrado las acciones de Meta y permitió a la empresa evitar un juicio potencialmente largo que podría haber sacado a la luz más documentos internos sobre su trato a los usuarios jóvenes.
Casi todos los ingresos de Meta proceden de la publicidad: Reels compite con TikTok y YouTube Shorts por el dominio del mercado de los videos cortos, y Threads se enfrenta a X, de Elon Musk, mientras que su IA perfecciona la segmentación publicitaria y las recomendaciones para impulsar la participación de los usuarios.

items.title: Analog chipmaker Texas Instruments sees quarterly sales above estimates
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Texas Instruments forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign of recovery in industrial chip demand and growing momentum for its AI data-center chips.
items.body:
Texas Instruments (TXN.O) forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign of recovery in industrial chip demand and growing momentum for its AI data-center chips.
Unlike Nvidia (NVDA.O) , which makes high-performance AI processors, Dallas, Texas-based TI produces analog chips that manage power and convert real-world inputs such as sound, light and temperature into digital signals for other semiconductors to process
The analog chipmaker expects fourth-quarter revenue between $5.80 billion and $6.30 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $5.73 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Quarterly profit is expected to be between $2.45 and $2.79 per share
Texas Instruments, one of the first major chipmakers to post quarterly results, is widely considered a bellwether for the broader electronics and semiconductor industries
Its analog and embedded chips are used in smartphones, laptops, cars as well as factory equipment
TI's third-quarter revenue rose 28% to $6.06 billion from the same period last year, topping estimates of $5.92 billion. Quarterly profit rose 77% to $2.62 per share.
"Our cash flow from operations of $9.9 billion for the trailing 12 months again underscored the strength of our business model, the quality of our product portfolio and the benefit of 300mm production," CEO Haviv Ilan said

• "Our cash flow from operations of $9.9 billion for the trailing 12 months again underscored the strength of our business model, the quality of our product portfolio and the benefit of 300mm production," CEO Haviv Ilan said

items.title: トランプ氏のスーパーＰＡＣ、中間選挙終盤に2.7億ドル投入　接戦3州に集中
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Virginia Furness

[２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Virginia Furness

[２１日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、米議会での共和党の多数派維持に向けた鍵を握る選挙区で候補者を支援するため、中間選挙戦終盤の６週間でテレビ広告やダイレクトメール広告に２億７７００万ドル超を投じたことが分かった。 

連邦選挙委員会（ＦＥＣ）のデータによると、トランプ氏の特別政治活動委員会（スーパーＰＡＣ）「ＭＡＧＡインク」は、今回の中間選挙でこれまでに３億ドル超を費やしており、ほとんどの世論調査で民主党の対立候補に後れを取っているテキサス州、ミシガン州、オハイオ州の上院選に、直接または他のＰＡＣを通じて最も多額の資金を投入した。 

トランプ氏は２０日、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、１１月３日に投票が行われる中間選挙までに共和党の選挙活動支援に４億─５億ドルを投じると表明した。選挙資金に関する届け出によると、最近の支出のうち２億２５００万ドルを「ノー・ゴーイング・バック」と「セーフティー・アンド・アフォーダビリティー」という他の２つのスーパーＰＡＣを通じて拠出した。

スーパーＰＡＣは、ほとんど制約なく選挙運動のために無制限に資金を受け取り、支出することができる。

これらのＰＡＣは、テキサス州上院選に立候補するケン・パクストン氏の支援に３６００万ドル超、ミシガン州のマイク・ロジャーズ候補に３０１０万ドル、オハイオ州のジョン・ハステッド候補に２８００万ドル超を投じた。共和党が５３対４７の過半数を占める上院の支配権を維持するには、これら３議席が鍵を握る。

選挙予測で知られるネイト・シルバー氏の最新データによると、民主党が上院を制する確率は７７％超で、５３対４７の多数派になると予測。下院を制する確率は９４％超で、２４０対１９５の多数派になると予測している。

items.title: 米テスラ、第3四半期はフリーキャッシュフロー黒字　ＡＩ支出が予想下回る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[２１日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２１日発表した第３・四半期決算は、人工知能（ＡＩ）とロボット事業への支出が市場予想を大幅に下回り、フリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ）が予想外の黒字となった。

イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸとテスラの経営統合は「良い案だ」と述べ、両社が統合を協議する特別委員会を設置したことを明らかにした。

テスラは難しいかじ取りを迫られている。投資家が統合の可能性を踏まえて同社の企業価値を見極める中、予想外のキャッシュフロー黒字は評価を支える材料となり得る。ただ、企業価値の多くがＡＩ、自動運転タクシー（ロボタクシー）、人型ロボットへの期待に支えられているため、投資を抑えて手元資金を確保すれば、投資家が期待する成長シナリオそのものを損なう恐れがある。

テスラに連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を提供するディレクションで商品・戦略担当シニアバイスプレジデントを務めるライアン・リー氏は「フリーキャッシュフローが予想を上回ったのはうれしい驚きだったが、設備投資が予想を下回ったことと合わせて考えると、テスラの次の一手に疑問が生じる」と指摘。「設備投資の少なさは、ＡＩ開発競争に対する姿勢が、マスク氏から想像するほど『全力投入』ではないことを示唆している」と語った。

テスラ株は時間外取引で１．８％下落した。

第３・四半期の設備投資は４７億ドルと、前年同期の２倍超となったものの、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の７５億ドルを下回った。

フリーキャッシュフローは１５億３０００万ドルの黒字。予想は４９億２０００万ドルの赤字だった。

売上高も市場予想を上回った。納車台数が前四半期から増加した。

インベスティング・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、トーマス・モンテイロ氏は「（スペースＸとの）統合のハードルは依然として高いが、今晩の決算を受け、財務面での合理性は無視しにくくなった」とした上で「重要なのは、テスラの四半期キャッシュフローが予想外の黒字になったのは利益が増えたためではなく、支出が計画を数十億ドル下回ったためだという点だ。一方でスペースＸは、１四半期に最大４００億ドルを投資する準備を進めている」と述べた。

＜売上高が予想上回る＞

第３・四半期の売上高は２８０億５０００万ドルで、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の２７８億８０００万ドルを上回った。２０２５年に販売を支えた米国の税額控除は終了したものの、ガソリン高が特に欧州でＥＶ需要を押し上げた。

テスラは「乗用車の受注残は四半期末時点で過去４年間で最多となった」と表明した。

車両納車台数は４８万６５３２台で、年間ベースで３年ぶりの増加となる見通し。

規制クレジットを除く自動車部門の売上総利益率は１８．１％で、ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想の１６．７％を上回った。

ただ、世界の競合各社が新型でより安価なモデルを相次ぎ投入する一方、テスラは発売から時間が経過した「モデル３」と「モデルＹ」に依存しており、中核の自動車事業には依然厳しい目が向けられている。同社はこれまでに累計納車台数が１０００万台を突破したと表明し、モデルＹは今年、世界で最も売れた車両になる見通しだとしている。

需要喚起に向け、テスラは両モデルで装備を簡素化した低価格版を投入したほか、７月には米国で６人乗りのモデルＹを発売した。

items.title: Venezuela to attract investors after elections, Branson says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas.
items.body:
British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas.
Venezuela's Interim President Delcy Rodriguez and US President Donald Trump have both said Venezuela [USN:L1N45G0XU TEXT:"will hold elections"] but have not provided a timeline.
The country will attract more investment once it holds elections, Branson said, but for now investors are waiting for more legal certainty.
"A lot obviously depends on the next 18 months," Branson said, adding that Venezuela will have a "tremendous opportunity" once elections occur and rule of law is established. He did not elaborate on a possible timeline.
"Investment needs certainty. It needs a proper judicial process and legal security. It needs transparency," Branson said. "And an access to capital needs to know the capital is secure."
Branson spoke at an event in Venezuela with entrepreneurs and investment fund representatives, which was also attended by Venezuelan Foreign Minister Felix Plasencia and Industry Minister Luis Villegas.
Rodriguez, who has Washington's backing, assumed power after President Nicolas Maduro's capture in a US operation in January. She promised elections in a [USN:L1N45F13J TEXT:"UN speech"] in September.
Despite legal reforms approved by Venezuela's parliament to boost investment, global investors remain hesitant due to distrust of the legal system and political uncertainty, particularly in non-energy sectors.
items.raw_description: British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas.

items.title: Lawmakers say US briefing showed Russia targeting Democrats with misinformation
items.author: Jonathan Landay
items.creator: Jonathan Landay
items.summary: The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's midterm elections.
items.body:
The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"].
The comments by Senator Mark Warner and Representative Jim Himes come as Republican President Donald Trump has in recent weeks eased economic sanctions on Russia and increased pressure on Ukraine to end its fight against Russian forces.
Warner and Himes told reporters they were limited in revealing what they had learned in an election security briefing that they had requested from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton because it was classified.
But, they said, Russia was waging the same kind of online misinformation campaign that the US intelligence community had tracked in US elections in 2016, 2020, and 2024.
"And the state of play, I would argue, is that, you know, Russia, similar to prior occasions, is going after Democrats," Warner said.
He noted news reports that Democrat James Talarico, who is running for the US Senate in Texas, and Senator Jon Ossoff, who is seeking re-election in Georgia, "in particular are being dinged" by fake advertisements created with AI.
The White House and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The Russian embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Moscow in the past has denied meddling in US elections.
Himes said the pair could not provide details of the misinformation spread by Russia because the material was classified. But he added that Moscow's conduct has been "the same old, same old."
"The Russians are kind of throwing everything out there," said Himes. "Chaos, you know, don't trust your voting machines."
He added there was "no reason to believe" that China has not been conducting "extremely targeted" efforts as it has done in the past to influence voters.
The Chinese embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing has previously denied interfering in US elections.
Recent Reuters/Ipsos polling has shown Democrats leading Republicans on the generic congressional ballot by high single digits to low double digits nationally, bolstering Democratic hopes of regaining control of the House of Representatives and possibly the Senate.
The lawmakers said they were concerned that Trump could pursue efforts to contest election results, including by claiming foreign hacking of voting infrastructure.
Himes emphasized that there was no evidence that any country could penetrate US election systems and change results.
"Nothing out there suggests that there is even the capability or the intent to do interference, whereas there is a pretty robust influence environment," said Himes.

items.title: Austrian and Swiss women freed after 18 months in Niger reach Benghazi, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
items.body:
An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
[USN:L1N4530IW TEXT:"The Austrian"], identified by Austrian authorities as Eva G, who is in her 70s, was kidnapped in the desert town of Agadez in central Niger in January 2025. Little information has been released about which group was holding her or what demands they may have made. She had been living in Niger for years.
The Swiss woman was taken hostage in April 2025. The Swiss Foreign Ministry did not previously name the hostage.
The two officials said the women would be handed over to authorities in their respective countries after the necessary procedures were completed. They added that the operation was overseen by Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of Libya's armed forces.
Niger, like its neighbours Mali and Burkina Faso, is battling a jihadist insurgency linked to al Qaeda and Islamic State that spun out of a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali in 2012. The fighting has killed thousands and displaced millions across West Africa's central Sahel region over the past decade.
Kidnappings appeared to intensify in Niger last year.

items.title: Estatal egípcia volta ao mercado e adquire 5 cargas de trigo, dizem operadores
items.author: Sarah Safty, Olga Popova, Michael Hogan
items.creator: Sarah Safty, Olga Popova, Michael Hogan
items.summary: A Future of Egypt, empresa estatal egípcia responsável pela compra de grãos, adquiriu cerca de cinco cargas de trigo nesta semana, em uma de suas primeiras importações conhecidas nos últimos meses, segundo informaram seis fontes do setor à Reuters, à medida que as interrupções nas exportações do Mar Negro reduzem a oferta.
items.body:
A Future of Egypt, empresa estatal egípcia responsável pela compra de grãos, adquiriu cerca de cinco cargas de trigo nesta semana, em uma de suas primeiras importações conhecidas nos últimos meses, segundo informaram seis fontes do setor à Reuters, à medida que as interrupções nas exportações do Mar Negro reduzem a oferta.
O trigo foi adquirido por meio de negociações privadas, e não por licitação. A origem das cargas ainda não está clara, mas quatro operadores afirmaram que elas devem vir da Europa, incluindo França e Romênia.
A compra marca um retorno ao mercado para a empresa estatal egípcia, que permaneceu praticamente à margem nos últimos meses em meio às interrupções no abastecimento causadas pelo conflito entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia.
O Egito comprou uma quantidade recorde de trigo de produtores locais este ano, enquanto as autoridades afirmaram que as reservas estratégicas eram suficientes para cobrir as necessidades domésticas por vários meses.
A Rússia e a Ucrânia atenderam mais de 82% das importações de trigo do Egito no primeiro semestre de 2026. Contudo, ataques recíprocos a portos, terminais de exportação e navios comerciais forçaram os transportadores a adiar ou cancelar cargas, levando os importadores a buscar fontes alternativas de abastecimento.
A interrupção também forçou alguns exportadores russos a redirecionar cargas por portos do Báltico, embora os comerciantes afirmem que as rotas alternativas tenham capacidade muito menor do que a do Mar Negro.
Os comerciantes afirmaram que o comprador estatal tem se mostrado mais ativo recentemente na solicitação de indicações de preços e ofertas.

items.title: El Salvador dice bandas de Haití tienen como rehenes a cuatro connacionales, anuncia misión rescate
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente Nayib Bukele afirmó el miércoles que bandas haitianas tenían como rehenes a cuatro salvadoreños miembros de una fuerza de seguridad internacional respaldada por la ONU, y que había puesto en marcha una operación militar para rescatarlos sanos y salvos.
items.body:
El presidente Nayib Bukele afirmó el miércoles que bandas haitianas tenían como rehenes a cuatro salvadoreños miembros de una fuerza de seguridad internacional respaldada por la ONU, y que había puesto en marcha una operación militar para rescatarlos sanos y salvos.
El ejército de El Salvador y la Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas, encargada de ayudar a la policía haitiana a combatir a las poderosas pandillas, anunciaron a principios de la semana que estaban trabajando para rescatar a los salvadoreños desaparecidos, pero señalaron que los intensos combates en la zona habían limitado el acceso.
"Hoy hemos lanzado una operación militar para rescatarlos", afirmó Bukele en su cuenta de X, sin dar más detalles sobre la operación ni identificar al grupo que mantiene a los salvadoreños como rehenes.
La Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
Los cuatro salvadoreños desaparecieron el domingo tras saltar de un [USN:L6N46512U TEXT:"vehículo blindado en llamas"] que fue emboscado por bandas armadas en las afueras de la capital, cuando regresaban de un mercado a su base, informaron fuentes de seguridad.
Las bandas haitianas han consolidado su influencia sobre la capital y se han expandido a las regiones circundantes en los últimos años, aprovechando un vacío político de larga data, la extorsión generalizada y un flujo de armas ilegales procedentes en gran parte de Estados Unidos.
Varios países, entre ellos Chad y Sri Lanka, han desplegado soldados como parte de la Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas, que, tras un año de mandato, apenas ha alcanzado algo más de un tercio de su tamaño previsto y ha tenido un impacto limitado en la seguridad de Haití.
"Señores, los secuestrados no son combatientes. Son técnicos en el ámbito de la aviación que forman parte de nuestra misión en Haití, en el marco de una misión internacional", dijo Bukele.
"Nuestra misión solo cuenta con pilotos y personal técnico, cuyo trabajo principal es realizar evacuaciones médicas y salvar vidas, no hacer la guerra", agregó.

items.title: Luka Doncic makes promise to Lakers fans: 'No excuses; No nights off'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Luka Doncic is the undisputed face of the Los Angeles Lakers now, following LeBron James' departure, and promised the fans that the team is ready to make a serious charge to an NBA title.
items.body:
Luka Doncic is the undisputed face of the Los Angeles Lakers now, following LeBron James' departure, and promised the fans that the team is ready to make a serious charge to an NBA title.
In a full-page ad that ran in the Los Angeles Times, Doncic wrote that "the run for a championship" begins Wednesday and that the team's fans deserve a level of play that matches the intensity of its supporters.
"From the moment I arrived in LA, you welcomed me with open arms. That is something I will never forget," Doncic wrote. "So here is my promise to you: we are going to give you everything we have, every single night. No excuses. No nights off."
In turn, the six-time All-Star asked fans to come along for the ride.
"You are the best fans in the world, and we are going to need you," he wrote. "Every game, bring it with us."
The Lakers were 53-29 last season and had the fourth-best record in the Western Conference. But Doncic, a six-time All-NBA first team selection, missed the last two weeks of the regular season and the playoffs with a hamstring injury, as Los Angeles was eliminated in the second round.
James departed in the offseason and signed with the Philadelphia 76ers. It left the Lakers to retool the roster with the likes of new additions Walker Kessler, Sandro Mamukelashvili, Collin Sexton and Ziaire Williams, among others.
The Lakers last won the NBA title in the pandemic season of 2020 and have advanced past the first round of the playoffs twice in the past six seasons. Doncic hopes to return the Lakers to their former glory that includes 17 NBA championships.
"Each of us understands what it means to put on this purple and gold jersey and follow the players who wore it before us," Doncic wrote. "It means so much because of the passion and dedication that generations of you all have shown for this team."
The Lakers open the season Wednesday night at home against the Golden State Warriors. According to DraftKings, as of Wednesday afternoon, Los Angeles had the 14th-best odds of winning the title at +4000.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Southwest Airlines cuts profit forecast as fuel costs overshadow turnaround gains
items.author: Rajesh Singh, Nandan Mandayam
items.creator: Rajesh Singh, Nandan Mandayam
items.summary: Southwest Airlines sharply cut its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, as surging fuel costs overshadowed gains from higher airfares and a business overhaul.
items.body:
Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) sharply cut its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, as surging fuel costs overshadowed gains from higher airfares and a business overhaul.
The Dallas-based carrier expects adjusted earnings of $2.60 to $2.85 per share in 2026, down from its earlier forecast of $3.25 to $4.25. The midpoint of the new range is below analysts' average estimate of $2.85 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Southwest also forecast fourth-quarter earnings below Wall Street expectations, underscoring the challenge facing US airlines as rising fuel costs eat into revenue from sharply higher airfares.
The carrier, once known for its free checked bags and open seating, has been overhauling its business to attract higher-spending travelers and generate more revenue through new products and fees.
Southwest's results offer an early test of those efforts. The airline is collecting substantially more revenue even as it carries fewer travelers.
The fuel shock, however, is making it harder to gauge how much of those gains will translate into profit.
Southwest's average passenger fare jumped nearly 27% in the third quarter, helping lift revenue to a third-quarter record of $8.4 billion. Southwest also reported higher adjusted operating margin despite sharply higher fuel costs.
"With the transformation complete, our efforts have shifted to optimizing the business," CEO Bob Jordan said in a statement, adding that demand remained strong in the fourth quarter.
Southwest's fuel bill rose $821 million from a year earlier, and the carrier expects jet fuel prices to increase further in the final three months of the year.
The company reported third-quarter adjusted earnings of 66 cents per share, above analysts' expectations of 58 cents and up from 11 cents a year earlier.
HIGHER FARES, FUEL PRESSURE Southwest's outlook provides further evidence that higher airfares have not fully insulated US airlines from the fuel shock stemming from the Iran war .
Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) has [USN:L4N45U1TW TEXT:"warned"] that airlines may need to further restrain flight growth next year to sustain higher fares, while United Airlines (UAL.O) expects [USN:L4N4661GR TEXT:"elevated fuel costs throughout 2027"], complicating efforts to improve profit margins.
Southwest plans to increase capacity by 3% to 4% in the fourth quarter, after slightly reducing flying in the September quarter.
It will outline its longer-term financial targets at an investor event in March.
The carrier will discuss its financial results with analysts and investors on Thursday morning.

items.title: Germany's SAP hits €10 billion quarterly revenue milestone, lifts 2026 view
items.author: Leo Marchandon
items.creator: Leo Marchandon
items.summary: Europe's largest tech company SAP on Wednesday achieved a €10 billion ($11.2 billion) quarterly revenue milestone for the first time, while reporting a 26% rise in current cloud backlog and lifting its 2026 revenue outlook to the upper end of its range.
items.body:
Europe's largest tech company SAP (SAPG.DE) on Wednesday achieved a €10 billion ($11.2 billion) quarterly revenue milestone for the first time, while reporting a 26% rise in current cloud backlog and lifting its 2026 revenue outlook to the upper end of its range.
Cloud revenue rose 26% to €6.67 billion in the third quarter while non-IFRS operating profit rose 18% to €3.03 billion. SAP's cloud backlog at constant currencies grew 26% to €24.14 billion ($27.11 billion), ahead of the 24% to 25% growth UBS had forecast. SAP held its operating profit outlook at €11.8 billion to €12.2 billion at constant currencies, a range [USN:L6N43P1E1 TEXT:"trimmed"] in July for its recent acquisitions.
SAP's order book is watched as a gauge of enterprise tech spending worldwide as its software suite runs accounting and payroll at many of the world's biggest companies. A miss on the measure in January sent the shares down 15% in one [USN:L6N3YT0VR TEXT:"day"].
"AI was the main driver behind customers move to the cloud," in the quarter, CEO Christian Klein told analysts, with companies signing subscription contracts to get access to SAP's Joule assistant platform connecting to over 70 AI models. "SAP is not committing to a preferred model," he said.
CFO Dominik Asam said the fourth quarter would decide how the year lands, describing a gloomy backdrop with rising oil prices and US interest rates that "start to develop teeth."
SAP said growth in cloud revenue was helped by customers returning from "financial distress." Its profit margin widened to 29.5% from 28.3% while free cash flow rose 36% to €1.72 billion.
SAP now expects 2026 subscription revenue — access to software customers rent remotely rather than buy and run themselves — toward the top of its €25.8 billion to €26.2 billion forecast, up 23% to 25%. Including the declining classic licence business, it sees revenue of €36.3 billion to €36.8 billion, up 12% to 13%, at the top of its range.
Klein called it "an outstanding quarter." Customers are "investing in the technology behind" the company's AI strategy, he said. New cloud customers included AstraZeneca (AZN.L) , Infineon (IFXGn.DE) .
($1 = 0.8903 euros)

items.title: Long fight over refiner Citgo progresses at US appeals court
items.author: Marianna Parraga
items.creator: Marianna Parraga
items.summary: A US Court of Appeals in Philadelphia on Wednesday heard parties involved in a long-running, court-organized auction of the parent company of Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum.
items.body:
A US Court of Appeals in Philadelphia on Wednesday heard parties involved in a long-running, court-organized auction of the parent company of Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum.
Supporters defended a decision in a federal court in Delaware late last year that ordered the sale of the company for $5.9 billion to a hedge fund affiliate, while opponents including Venezuela, some creditors and rival bidders argued that the process was tainted, with the court passing over higher offers.
In November, a federal judge in Delaware approved the $5.9 billion [USN:L1N3X00MJ TEXT:"bid"] from an affiliate of Elliott Investment Management for Citgo's parent PDV Holding to pay a group of Venezuela-linked creditors. This triggered the opposition, and the sale has not yet been executed, awaiting approval from the US Treasury Department.
An April deadline looms over Elliott's Amber Energy to preserve its offer.
The court's selection followed several bidding rounds in a case initiated by miner Crystallex International against Venezuela in 2017 for the expropriation of its assets, which allowed other creditors to join the litigation in pursuit of Citgo's parent as compensation.
Opposition parties in January [USN:L1N3YE0H4 TEXT:"asked"] the US Court of Appeals of the Third Circuit to vacate the sale order over an alleged conflict of interest involving firms retained by the court as advisors, procedural "errors" that excluded higher bids and what some of them called the "low" valuation of the assets.
The court is expected to make a decision after the hearing. The main arguments discussed this week were:
BID PRICE The court's use of a methodology combining price and "[USN:L1N3RR0IH TEXT:"certainty of closure"]," or the likelihood that a bid would ultimately be executed, created controversy among bidders.
Some companies including miner Gold Reserve (GRZ.V) chose to submit high-price offers. Others, including Amber Energy, gave weight to transaction agreements they argued would help clear obstacles to execute a sale. The most important was a pact with holders of a defaulted Venezuelan bond who hold a collateral claim over one of Citgo's parents.
Some attorneys, including Crystallex's counsel Miguel Estrada, said then-US District Judge Leonard Stark in Delaware "went as far as he could to make (the process) transparent," while lawyer Katherine Wellington representing Citgo's ultimate parent PDVSA said the sale price was so low it "shocked the conscience."
ALLEGED CONFLICT OF INTEREST Venezuela, PDVSA and creditors including Gold Reserve alleged that a law firm hired by the court to advise on the auction had a work relationship with units of Elliott while the bidding was in process, which they argue "tainted" the process.
The parties tried to [USN:FWN3VR1PR TEXT:"disqualify"] Stark and the court officer who oversaw the auction, Robert Pincus. Pincus has denied the allegations. Stark last year denied the disqualification motion.
VALUATION AND PROCESS PDVSA's lawyer said the auction "fundamentally hurts the people of Venezuela at a time when they are rebuilding their economy."
The selected bid was about $7 billion lower than a valuation of assets completed by court-advising firm Evercore (EVR.N) and $12 billion below the figure presented by an expert brought by Venezuela to court, she said.
Citgo's valuation has increased since last year as strong refining margins have boosted [USN:TUA5KZTD9 TEXT:"profits"]. The company is projecting full-year 2026 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of some $5.8 billion, and a year-end cash balance of approximately $5.7 billion, it said in August.

items.title: Nasdaq lidera alta em Wall Street, com SpaceX e Super Micro impulsionando otimismo sobre IA
items.author: Sinead Carew, Purvi Agarwal
items.creator: Sinead Carew, Purvi Agarwal
items.summary: O Nasdaq, de forte peso tecnológico, liderou a alta de Wall Street no fechamento desta quarta-feira, depois que os resultados trimestrais da SpaceX e da Super Micro Computer aumentaram o apetite dos investidores por ações ligadas à inteligência artificial, enquanto a fraqueza dos papéis de serviços de comunicação limitou os ganhos.
items.body:
O Nasdaq, de forte peso tecnológico, liderou a alta de Wall Street no fechamento desta quarta-feira, depois que os resultados trimestrais da SpaceX e da Super Micro Computer aumentaram o apetite dos investidores por ações ligadas à inteligência artificial, enquanto a fraqueza dos papéis de serviços de comunicação limitou os ganhos.
As ações da SpaceX (SPCX.O) fecharam com alta de 7,8% depois que a empresa de foguetes e tecnologia espacial de Elon Musk registrou seu primeiro lucro como empresa de capital aberto. Musk afirmou, após a divulgação do relatório, que uma fusão entre a SpaceX e a Tesla (TSLA.O) seria “uma boa ideia”, o que também impulsionou as ações da Tesla.
Também em função de resultados, as ações da Super Micro (SMCI.O) dispararam 9,6% e a empresa ficou entre as que mais valorizaram no S&P 500 depois que a fabricante de servidores de IA previu receita trimestral e margem de lucro acima das estimativas de Wall Street, sinalizando que a demanda por IA continuava resiliente. O relatório também beneficiou empresas do mesmo setor, como a HPE (HPE.N) , que subiu 3,7%, e a Dell (DELL.N) , que saltou 5,3%.
Os relatórios pareceram trazer algum alívio aos investidores, que vinham se preocupando com a sustentabilidade dos gastos maciços em investimentos em IA e com a rentabilidade desses projetos. O setor de tecnologia foi duramente atingido na semana passada por uma onda de vendas de ações ligadas à IA, com a operadora de data centers CoreWeave (CRWV.O) no centro da tempestade.
As notícias da SpaceX “aliviam algumas das preocupações dos investidores” em relação à IA, com a ajuda da Super Micro, segundo Angelo Kourkafas, estrategista global sênior da Edward Jones.
Kourkafas afirmou que os relatórios não “responderão a todas as perguntas que os investidores têm sobre o retorno dos investimentos em IA, mas é um bom começo”.
Como resultado, o índice de Tecnologia da Informação do S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) fechou com alta de 1,6%, registrando o maior ganho entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500.
“É realmente uma notícia positiva para o setor de tecnologia para praticamente qualquer pessoa que esteja de alguma forma envolvida no ecossistema de inteligência artificial”, disse Marc Dizard, diretor de investimentos do Huntington Bank.
“A reação do mercado de tecnologia foi uma reafirmação de que o setor de inteligência artificial continua intacto”, acrescentou ele.
No entanto, Dizard disse que o sentimento em relação à IA pode mudar rapidamente e que os investidores buscarão confirmação ao acompanharem os relatórios de outras empresas.
As ações da Meta (META.O) subiram 3% no pós-mercado, após a divulgação de seus resultados trimestrais depois do fechamento do pregão regular. Depois de encerrarem o pregão regular com alta de 3,4%, as ações da Tesla subiram mais 1,6% após a divulgação de seu relatório, que também foi publicado após o fechamento.
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,69%, para 52.856,09 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançou 0,58%, para 7.757,17 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) teve alta de 1,05%, para 26.702,86 pontos.
No setor de tecnologia, uma das áreas mais fortes foi a de chips, com alta de 2% no índice Philadelphia Semiconductor (.SOX) , que teve um mês volátil até o momento, incluindo uma onda de vendas que durou oito pregões.
No entanto, os ganhos no índice de referência S&P 500 foram limitados por uma queda de 1,3% nas ações do setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) . Entre as maiores perdedoras estavam operadoras de telecomunicações, como a AT&T (T.N) , que tombou 6,5% mesmo tendo superado as expectativas de receita e lucro no terceiro trimestre.
Os resultados da SpaceX, juntamente com uma recente aquisição de espectro de telefonia móvel, alimentaram temores de que a empresa pudesse se tornar uma concorrente formidável no setor de telecomunicações, segundo Dizard. As ações da T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) caíram 2,5% e as da Verizon Communications (VZ.N) perderam 2,2%.
Ainda no setor de serviços de comunicação, as ações da Netflix (NFLX.O) afundaram 5,3% depois que a empresa de streaming de vídeo divulgou uma previsão de lucro para o quarto trimestre abaixo do esperado. A Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , controladora do Google, também registrou queda de 1,6%.
As ações da Abbott Laboratories (ABT.N) caíram 1,9% depois que a fabricante de dispositivos médicos reduziu sua previsão de crescimento de vendas para 2026.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック主導で上昇、決算受けＡＩ投資心理改善
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Purvi Agarwal

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Purvi Agarwal

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合を中心に上昇した。スペースＸとスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターの四半期決算を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への投資意欲が改善した。ただ、通信サービス株の下落が上値を抑えた。

米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宙開発企業スペースＸは７．８％上昇。上場企業として初の黒字を計上した。マスク氏は決算発表後、スペースＸとテスラの合併は「良い考えだ」と述べ、テスラ株も買われた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーメーカーのスーパー・マイクロは９．６％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の構成銘柄で上昇率上位に入った。四半期の売上高と利益率について市場予想を上回る見通しを示し、ＡＩ需要の底堅さを示唆した。同業にも買いが波及し、ＨＰＥは３．７％、デルは５．３％それぞれ上昇した。

両社の決算は、ＡＩインフラ整備への巨額投資の持続性や収益性を懸念していた投資家に一定の安心感を与えた。先週はデータセンター運営会社コアウィーブを中心にＡＩ関連株が売り込まれ、ハイテク株は大きな打撃を受けていた。

エドワード・ジョーンズのシニアグローバルストラテジスト、アンジェロ・クルカファス氏は、スペースＸのニュースがスーパー・マイクロの決算とともに、ＡＩに対する「投資家の懸念をある程度和らげている」と指摘。「ＡＩ投資のリターンに関する投資家の疑問全てに答えるものではないが、良い出発点だ」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の情報技術指数は１．６％上昇し、主要１１業種の中で上昇率トップとなった。

ハンティントン・バンクのマーク・ディザード最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「ＡＩのエコシステムに何らかの形で携わるほぼ全ての企業にとって、非常に前向きなニュースだ。ハイテク株の反応は、ＡＩ関連株を買う流れがなお健在であることを再確認するものだ」と指摘。その上で、ＡＩを巡る投資家心理は急速に変わり得るとし、投資家は他社の決算を見極めながら、強気の見方を裏付ける材料を探るだろうと語った。

メタ・プラットフォームズは通常取引終了後に四半期決算を発表し、時間外取引で３％上昇した。通常取引を３．４％高で終えたテスラも、引け後の決算発表を受け、時間外でさらに１．６％上昇した。

ハイテク株では半導体株が特に堅調で、フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２％上昇した。同指数は今月、８営業日続落するなど値動きの荒い展開となっている。

一方、通信サービス指数は１．３％下落し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の上値を抑えた。通信事業者の下げが目立ち、ＡＴ＆Ｔは第３・四半期の売上高と利益が予想を上回ったにもかかわらず、６．５％下落した。

ディザード氏によると、スペースＸの決算と最近の無線周波数帯の取得を受け、同社が通信業界で強力な競争相手になるとの懸念が強まった。ＴモバイルＵＳは２．５％、ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズは２．２％それぞれ下落した。

通信サービスでは、動画配信大手ネットフリックスも、第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、５．３％下落した。グーグルの親会社アルファベットも１．６％安となった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３７対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．３対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６１億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億株。

Oct 21 : IBM finance chief James Kavanaugh on Wednesday said delayed software deals that rattled investors in the last quarter were beginning to close, as the company lifted its forecast for the business and reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings.
In an interview with Reuters, Kavanaugh said IBM now expects annual software revenue growth of about 7 per cent to 8 per cent, up from 6 per cent to 8 per cent previously. IBM's shares rose about 4 per cent in extended trading.
Here are some more details:
• Third-quarter revenue rose 4.7 per cent to $17.10 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $16.82 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG

• Adjusted profit came in at $2.95 per share, beating estimates of $2.86 per share
• CEO Arvind Krishna had said in July that IBM had "faltered" in adapting to a shift in customer spending from software to data-center infrastructure, triggering its steepest one-day share drop in over a century
• Software revenue rose 8.3 per cent to $7.80 billion in the third quarter, topping estimates of $7.62 billion
• Within the segment, sales in its hybrid cloud unit grew 11 per cent and transaction processing software revenue rose 9 per cent, rebounding from an unexpected decline last quarter
• Kavanaugh said about 25 per cent of the transaction processing revenue came from deals deferred from the second quarter and "the remaining 75 per cent is net new business"
• Infrastructure revenue rose 4.2 per cent to $3.71 billion, as 31 per cent growth in distributed infrastructure, which includes servers and storage systems, helped offset weakness in its Z mainframe business

Oct 21 : Meta introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday to help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as executives laid out their vision for organizing the company's future around its nascent AI agent business.
Shares of the Facebook and Instagram parent rose more than 4 per cent in extended trading. Meta also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates and reported strong growth of its new consumer AI agent app Muse.
The company has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centers to compete more aggressively with AI market leaders OpenAI and Anthropic, propelling it to the vanguard of an emerging consumer AI agent race while also eroding its historically strong free cash flow.
Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control.

Zuckerberg said more than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half and growth remained strong.
He said he expected Muse would eventually serve "billions of people" who would potentially generate more revenue than the average Meta user, forecasting the venture would give rise to the kind of network effect that helped build his social media empire.
"Part of the reason why we're not just charging everyone up front to use this is we want to establish this Muse network, and we think that it's going to be more valuable for people at scale when there are a lot of people and businesses using Muse," Zuckerberg said on a conference call after Meta published its third-quarter financial report.
HIGHER COSTS
Still, Zuckerberg acknowledged that the costs of offering Muse were higher than those associated with many of Meta's other new products over the years, and said the company would move to monetize the agent "somewhat sooner on this than our normal playbook."
Meta CFO Susan Li forecast the company's AI businesses would begin contributing incremental revenue in 2027 and become "a meaningful source of revenue diversification over time."
The executives also emphasized that AI would be the focus moving forward for Meta’s loss-making Reality Labs unit, which had led the charge on the company’s vision to build the “metaverse,” an immersive digital world that inspired its name change from Facebook to Meta in 2021.
In their financial report, they said they “remain focused on improving Reality Labs profitability” and forecast its losses would narrow next year to around $15 billion “as we reallocate investment toward other priority areas, primarily AI.”
The company raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast, now expecting capital expenditure to be between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously.
It reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier.
Revenue for the third quarter came in better than expected at $64.60 billion, ahead of Wall Street estimates of $63.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Meta also projected fourth-quarter revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, above estimates of $73.73 billion.
The early popularity of Muse and the release of a competitive new series of AI models have helped Meta justify its spending to investors, even though some enterprises are restricting the agent's access over security concerns.
"The market has shifted from punishing Meta for spending to rewarding it for having a compelling product story," said Jesse Cohen, senior analyst at Investing.com.
LEGAL CHALLENGES
Legal challenges are mounting, including a $25 billion penalty ordered by a judge in New Mexico earlier on Wednesday after a jury found Meta misled the state's residents about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation in a case related to British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica.
The $25 billion penalty is a "stark reminder of the current legal challenges Meta faces, which will continue into next year," Emarketer senior analyst Minda Smiley said. "Questions and concerns related to privacy and safety will only ramp up should AI agents become more mainstream, which could ultimately hurt Meta considering its reputation in this area."
In August, Meta agreed to pay as much as $18 billion over a decade and restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states alleging that Meta's platforms were designed to addict children.
Meta posted diluted earnings per share of $3.83 in the quarter, a figure that would have been $7.40 had it not been for a $9.89 billion charge related to the August settlement.
The agreement removed a significant regulatory hurdle that had weighed on Meta's stock and allowed the company to avoid a potentially lengthy trial that could have exposed more internal documents about its treatment of young users.
Still, Meta warned in its guidance on Wednesday that it continued to face scrutiny and US trials around "youth-related issues" that could impact its financial results.

Source: Reuters

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russian forces attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with ballistic missiles on Wednesday evening, damaging homes, a petrol station and transport equipment and injuring six people, officials said.
items.body:
Russian forces attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with ballistic missiles on Wednesday evening, damaging homes, a petrol station and transport equipment and injuring six people, officials said.
Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram there were strikes in two districts on the east side of the Dnipro River bisecting the city.
He said six people were injured, including four being treated in hospital.
The city remained under a drone warning more than two hours after the initial alert was declared.

items.title: Tesla cuts spending before potential SpaceX deal even as Musk bets future on AI, robots
items.author: Akash Sriram, Abhirup Roy
items.creator: Akash Sriram, Abhirup Roy
items.summary: Tesla cut its annual capital expenditure forecast by a fifth and posted surprise positive free cash flow in the third quarter on Wednesday, after investing far less in its AI and robotics ambitions than Wall Street had expected.
items.body:
Tesla (TSLA.O) cut its annual capital expenditure forecast by a fifth and posted surprise positive free cash flow in the third quarter on Wednesday, after investing far less in its AI and robotics ambitions than Wall Street had expected.
The unexpected cash generated in the quarter comes at a critical moment for Tesla, as CEO Elon Musk [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"explores combining the EV maker"] with his far more capital-intensive space venture, SpaceX (SPCX.O) .
While the lower spending strengthens Tesla’s financial position ahead of any deal, preserving cash at the expense of investment — in AI, robotaxis and humanoid robots — could undermine the very growth story investors are betting on.
Tesla shares, which had risen 2% in after-hours trading after the company reported positive cash flow, higher gross margin and market-beating revenue, reversed course to trade down 2%. They have fallen about 14% this year.
"The free cash flow beat was a pleasant surprise, but when combined with the lower-than-expected capex, raises questions on the next step for the automaker," said Ryan Lee, senior vice president of product and strategy at Direxion, which offers ETFs tied to Tesla. "Lower capex suggests less of an 'all-in' approach to the AI arms race than one would expect from Elon."
Tesla said it expected capital expenses for 2026 to be roughly $20 billion, down from its previous forecast of more than $25 billion, but did not say what it would spend less on.
In the third quarter ended September 30, Tesla spent $4.7 billion in capex, double that of a year ago, but lower than the $7.5 billion analysts on average were expecting, according to LSEG data. Tesla reported free cash flow of $1.53 billion, compared with an expected $4.92 billion cash burn.
SPACEX MERGER UNDER DISCUSSION Musk said on Tuesday that a merger between Tesla and SpaceX was a "good idea" and that the companies had formed special committees to discuss a deal. On Wednesday, Musk said on a conference call with analysts that he had no more to say on the matter.
A merger would create a single company at the center of Musk's[USN:L6N46214X TEXT:" long-term vision"]: an integrated technology and manufacturing empire spanning AI, energy, robotics, communications and transportation on Earth and beyond.
Still, investors will seek evidence that Tesla is investing enough to turn Musk’s ambitions into commercial businesses, with the robotaxi rollout lagging his promises. Tesla's energy unit has recently offered a counterweight to its auto business, which remains under scrutiny as rivals globally launch newer, often cheaper models. Tesla still leans heavily on the aging Model 3 and Model Y.
"The merger still faces a high bar, but tonight’s numbers make the financial logic harder to ignore," said Thomas Monteiro, a senior analyst at Investing.com.
"The main takeaway is that Tesla's surprisingly positive cash flow quarter did not come from stronger profits, but from spending billions less than planned at a time when SpaceX is preparing to invest up to $40 billion in a single quarter."
REVENUE FLAT BUT BEATS ESTIMATES Revenue was flat from a year earlier, despite the end of US tax credits that supported sales last year. That was enough to top Wall Street targets. Net income plunged 43%.
Tesla said in a statement that it ended the quarter with the largest backlog for its passenger vehicles in four years. High gasoline prices have stoked demand for EVs, especially in Europe.
With 486,532 vehicles delivered in the third quarter, Tesla is on track to increase annual deliveries for the first time in three years.
"Demand is growing rapidly for our vehicles. It's exceeding our production by a significant margin," Musk said on the conference call with analysts. "In a nutshell, after many years of sort of grind and things being fairly flat, I think we're now headed for a lot of fun and significant growth."
The FSD (supervised) attach rate reached over three-quarters of new vehicle deliveries in North America, a nearly 20-percentage-point increase from the second quarter, Tesla said.
Automotive gross margin, excluding regulatory credits, came in at 18.1% in the third quarter, higher than analysts’ estimates of 16.7%, according to Visible Alpha data.
Tesla said it was aiming to produce 5 million vehicles a year by about 2030, up from an expected 2.5 million this year.

items.title: Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh enters race for UN chief
items.author: Maha Dahan
items.creator: Maha Dahan
items.summary: Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh entered the race to become the next United Nations secretary-general on Wednesday, injecting a prominent Middle Eastern candidate into a contest that has struggled to produce a consensus choice among the Security Council’s most powerful members.
items.body:
Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh entered the race to become the next United Nations secretary-general on Wednesday, injecting a prominent Middle Eastern candidate into a contest that has struggled to produce a consensus choice among the Security Council’s most powerful members.
Nusseibeh, a former UAE ambassador to the UN for more than a decade, told Reuters she would seek to restore the world body’s role as a diplomatic problem-solver at a time of mounting global crises.
“It's clear that today we need a secretary-general that can recommit to the future of multilateralism and the future of the United Nations as a problem-solver rather than as a spectator to the world's crises,” she said shortly before going public with her candidacy.
Nusseibeh, the UAE minister of state for foreign affairs, is a late entrant to the race. An informal Security Council poll had placed former Costa Rican Vice President [USN:L1N46112N TEXT:"Rebeca Grynspan"] as the narrow frontrunner, sources have said.
Although Grynspan has led the informal "straw polls," last week she and all other candidates [USN:L1N4620XQ TEXT:"received"] two or more opposing votes from the ultimately decisive five permanent members of the council — Britain, China, France, Russia and the US.
Council members are negotiating over whether to hold another poll this Friday or at a later stage.
ENTREPRENEURIAL DIPLOMACY Nusseibeh, 48, said she was approached by multiple countries during the last UN General Assembly to put herself forward. She previously led the UAE's successful campaign for election to the Security Council. Diplomats in New York say she is respected as a competent manager.
"It's recognized today that we need someone who offers generational change for the organization," she said.
Her UN tenure overlapped with the outbreak of the Gaza war in 2023 when she secured the adoption of Resolution 2720 paving the way for the delivery of humanitarian aid.
Nusseibeh said she secured support for the resolution by arranging a visit by council members to the Rafah border crossing to see for themselves the situation on the ground, describing the move as part of her "creative entrepreneurial diplomacy" that characterizes her approach.
RELENTLESS DIPLOMACY As a top UAE diplomat, Nusseibeh has championed Abu Dhabi’s assertive foreign policy and heavy focus on countering political Islam.
The UAE has faced criticism over Sudan after UN sanctions monitors described allegations that it provided military support to the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces as credible. The UAE denies the allegations.
Asked how the allegations might affect her candidacy, Nusseibeh said she had taken leave from her UAE post and would focus on Sudan’s humanitarian crisis.
A Nusseibeh victory would make her the second UN chief from the Middle East, after Egypt’s Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
"I come from a country that is younger than the United Nations but our region is one that has been facing severe challenges," she said.
She would also become the first woman to lead the UN, though Nusseibeh said she was not running on her gender.
"I think it would be great if the next secretary-general was a woman but I'm not running because I'm a woman; I'm running because I am stubbornly optimistic about the future of the United Nations and I believe we need someone who is relentless in the pursuit of diplomacy to open doors."

items.title: Ibovespa tem ajuste negativo com pesquisa e WEG sob holofote
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, após ultrapassar os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, em pregão de correção na bolsa paulista.
items.body:
O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, após ultrapassar os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, em pregão de correção na bolsa paulista.
O cenário eleitoral continuou dominando o foco dos investidores, com nova pesquisa reforçando a disputa apertada na corrida eleitoral. Mas a temporada de balanços também ocupou as atenções com uma recepção negativa aos números de terceiro trimestre da WEG.
Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuou 0,86%, a 206.495,23 pontos, após marcar 209.244,71 na máxima do dia, registrada nos primeiros negócios. No pior momento, chegou a 205.988.
O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$38,6 bilhões.
A piora do Ibovespa seguiu a divulgação de [USN:L6N4670YJ TEXT:"pesquisa Quaest, "]pelo jornal O Globo, com queda na vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) para o segundo turno da eleição presidencial.
O levantamento mostrou Flávio com 45% das intenções de votos e Lula com 44%, ainda em empate técnico. Na pesquisa anterior, há uma semana, Flávio aparecia com 46% e Lula registrava 44%.
Após a euforia inicial do primeiro turno, com Flávio à frente de Lula, o Ibovespa tem oscilado sem uma direção única, com investidores ajustando as posições antes do resultado das urnas no próximo domingo.
"O Ibovespa, definitivamente e sem dúvida, está reagindo ao noticiário político", afirmou o head da mesa de renda variável e sócio da AW Capital, Lucas Xavier. "Quanto mais provável o cenário de reeleição, mais cauteloso fica o mercado."
Na visão de Xavier, até o fim desta semana, o mercado deve mostrar um movimento "mais lateral".
"Acredito que não haverá grandes movimentos de alocação em um cenário tão próximo da eleição. Imagino que o mercado como um todo aguarde os resultados para fazer as movimentações necessárias em seus portfólios", afirmou.
Dados atualizados da B3 também mostraram uma saída líquida de capital externo no último dia 19, levando o saldo positivo acumulado no mês para R$19,98 bilhões, de R$20,99 bilhões até o dia 16.
O começo da safra de balanços do Brasil pouco animou, com WEG figurando entre as maiores perdas no dia, após um resultado ligeiramente abaixo das expectativas. Na quinta-feira, o destaque fica para os números do Bradesco sobre o terceiro trimestre, que serão divulgados após o fechamento do mercado.
Estrategistas da XP afirmaram que suas estimativas apontam para uma temporada fraca, com desempenho mais positivo concentrado em poucos setores, notadamente óleo e gás e saúde, enquanto mineração e siderurgia e varejo foram apontados como destaques negativos.
A correção negativa do Ibovespa contrastou com o viés em [USN:L6N46710Y TEXT:"Wall Street"], onde o S&P 500 (.SPX) fechou em alta de 0,58%, com os resultados trimestrais da SpaceX e da Super Micro Computer alimentando o interesse por ações ligadas à inteligência artificial.
DESTAQUES WEG ON (WEGE3.SA) tombou 7,34% após [USN:L1N4670FP TEXT:"balanço"] do terceiro trimestre mostrar lucro líquido de R$1,67 bilhão e Ebitda de R$2,35 bilhões, ligeiramente abaixo de previsões de analistas. Analistas do UBS BB chamaram a atenção principalmente para a queda em margens da companhia.
HAPVIDA ON (HAPV3.SA) desabou 8,48%, mais do que devolvendo a alta da véspera, quando fechou em alta de 7,55%. No mês, o papel ainda acumula um ganho de 31%.
BTG PACTUAL UNIT caiu 1,41%, em dia sem tendência única para o setor, após desempenho robusto na véspera. BRADESCO PN , que divulga [USN:L6N4660V1 TEXT:"balanço"] no final da quinta-feira, cedeu 0,15% e BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) recuou 0,41%, enquanto ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN subiu 0,2% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT valorizou-se 0,9%.
PETROBRAS PN cedeu 0,79%, em sessão sem direção definida dos preços do [USN:L6N4671AI TEXT:"petróleo"] no exterior. No fechamento, o barril sob o contrato Brent registrou variação positiva de 0,03%, a US$108,82.
VALE ON (VALE3.SA) caiu 2,15%, em dia também negativo para o setor no exterior (.SXPP) , tendo como pano de fundo variações modestas dos futuros do [USN:L6N4670TC TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China. Analistas do UBS BB reiteraram a recomendação neutra para as ações da mineradora brasileira e reduziram o preço-alvo dos papéis para R$73, ante R$77.
TOTVS ON (TOTS3.SA) avançou 2,78%, caminhando para o quarto pregão seguido de alta, ajudada nessa sessão pelo movimento positivo do setor de tecnologia no exterior.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、原油高によるインフレ懸念を警戒　ＦＯＭＣ控え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を来週に控え、市場では原油高に伴うインフレ再燃リスクが意識されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．０２％高の１５８．１２円。 日銀の氷見野良三副総裁は衆院財務金融委員会で、９月の利上げについて、中長期の予想物価上昇率が引き続き上昇していることも踏まえれば「基調的な物価上昇率は２％にかなり近づいており、先行き物価安定の目標とおおむね整合的な水準となる」と指摘。こうした中心的な見通しに加え、金融環境が緩和的な状態にあることや物価の上振れリスクに留意する必要があることなどを踏まえて決めたとし、利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されており、引き続き経済活動はしっかりとサポートされている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数＜＝USD＞は０．１４％安の１０１．６５。ユーロは対ドルで０．０１％高の１．１２３７ドル。

スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン主任ＦＸストラテジストは、「市場全体を左右する明確なテーマは現在のところ見当たらない。少なくとも来週のＦＯＭＣまでこうした状況が続く」と指摘。「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が何を考えているのかを見極める必要がある」としている。

米国とイランの戦闘の終着点が見えない中、原油価格上昇を通じたインフレ圧力がＦＲＢの政策に影響を及ぼすとの懸念が高まっている。ＦＲＢが２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げに動く可能性は小さいとみられており、次回の利上げは１２月８─９日の会合になるとの見方が優勢。来週のＦＯＭＣでウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が今後の政策運営について明確に示唆する可能性も低いとみられている。ただ、スコシアバンクのオズボーン氏は、今後の金利見通しや利上げ時期を巡る市場の見方は、来週にはある程度固まるとの見方を示している。

市場では、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄を中心とした相場上昇の持続可能性を巡る懸念も払しょくされていない。ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのＦＸストラテジスト、ノア・バファム氏は「米国の成長はＡＩ相場によって大きくけん引されてきた。米国のインフレ率が（ＦＲＢの）目標を超える水準にとどまる要因にもなっており、米国は他の国よりも大きな影響を受けている」と述べた。

ユーロに対しては、フランスで反政府デモが広がっていることや財政見通しの悪化がこのところ重しになっている。仏１０年債利回りはこの日の取引で２００２年７月以来初めて５％台に乗せた。コペンハーゲンに拠点を置くサクソのグローバル・マクロ戦略責任者、ジョン・ハーディ氏は「フランスの債務問題は容易に解決できる状況ではない。債務残高の増加に歯止めをかける真剣な姿勢を示すためにも、政府は財政面で適切な調整を実施する必要がある」と述べた。

items.title: 仏「黄色いベスト」、24日にパリでデモ　政権は暴動防止を言明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Elizabeth Pineau　Dominique Patton

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Elizabeth Pineau　Dominique Patton

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - フランス各地で抗議デモが繰り広げられる中、２０１８年にも抗議活動を行った団体「黄色いベスト」運動は、パリ中心部で２４日にデモ行進する計画を示した。教育環境改善を求める学生団体も同日の抗議行動を呼びかけている。

マクロン大統領は２１日、抗議デモに乗じた略奪や暴動などの再発を防ぐと言明した。ルコルニュ首相は、労働組合の指導者らと会談。閣僚らは初期対応の不備を認め、警察隊のほか軍隊も配備し、警備態勢を強化する方針だ。

カタールを訪問中のマクロン氏は、燃料費の上昇抑制につなげようとエネルギー関連の合意を目指している。２２日には情報機関当局者、ルコルニュ氏らと会合を開き、今回の混乱の詳細の説明を受ける予定。

先週末にフランス各地で行われた抗議デモは、パリやマルセイユ、リヨンなどで暴動や略奪といった暴力行為に発展。警察隊は事態の収拾までに数時間を要した。財政問題や政治への不安が高まり、フランス国債の利回りは今週、上昇している。

フランスの主要労働組合は１１月５日に全国的な動員を呼びかけている。仏労働総同盟（ＣＧＴ）の代表は、弾圧ではなく、政治的な対応で応じるべきとの見解を示した。

マクロン氏は、一部の外国の指導者が誤った情報を流していると非難した。フランスでの抗議拡大を巡っては、トランプ米大統領が移民問題を指摘していた。フランスの極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏は「政府は何も制御できなくなっている」と主張した。

items.title: STF exclui ISS de base de cálculo das contribuições federais, em vitória para empresas
items.author: Ricardo Brito
items.creator: Ricardo Brito
items.summary: O plenário do Supremo Tribunal Federal formou nesta quarta-feira maioria contrária à inclusão do ISS, o imposto municipal sobre serviços, da base de cálculo do PIS e da Cofins, contribuições federais criadas para financiar a seguridade social.
items.body:
O plenário do Supremo Tribunal Federal formou nesta quarta-feira maioria contrária à inclusão do ISS, o imposto municipal sobre serviços, da base de cálculo do PIS e da Cofins, contribuições federais criadas para financiar a seguridade social.
O governo calcula que o impacto potencial da decisão desta quarta-feira é de R$34,5 bilhões.
A decisão representa uma vitória para empresas que pleiteavam a retirada do ISS das contribuições federais e uma derrota para o governo federal, que estimava um impacto de dezenas de bilhões em caso de derrota.
Empatado até então em cinco votos a cinco, o julgamento foi retomado nesta quarta-feira e contou com o voto decisivo do ministro Luiz Fux, que acompanhou o voto do ministro aposentado Celso de Mello e se manifestou a favor da tese das empresas.
Fux chegou a propor uma modulação dos efeitos da decisão, mas os ministros decidiram aguardar a apresentação de eventuais embargos de declaração sobre os efeitos do julgamento.
Procurada pela reportagem, a Procuradoria-Geral da Fazenda Nacional (PGFN) disse estar "analisando a decisão do Supremo Tribunal Federal para definir a estratégia de atuação".
VITÓRIA A EMPRESAS O advogado tributarista Leonardo Roesler, sócio do RCA Advogados, disse que a decisão do STF recoloca um limite na relação entre arrecadação e atividade econômica, representando uma vitória a empresas prestadoras de serviços.
"Agora, o alcance temporal do julgamento merece tanta atenção quanto a vitória de mérito. A recuperação de valores depende dos termos da decisão, de eventual modulação, da prescrição e da situação processual de cada contribuinte. Não se pode anunciar uma devolução automática dos últimos cinco anos para todas as empresas", disse.
"É necessário examinar os recolhimentos, a documentação e os procedimentos cabíveis para restituição ou compensação, inclusive o trânsito em julgado quando exigido para compensar créditos reconhecidos judicialmente. A aplicação do precedente exige precisão quanto à tese fixada, aos regimes abrangidos e à comprovação contábil dos valores", explicou.
Para a Flávio Molinari, sócio da área tributária do Collavini Borges Molinari Advogados, a decisão deve ser "festejada", principalmente levando em consideração que o STF já tinha decidido que o imposto estadual ICMS não compõe a base de cálculo da PIS e da Cofins, no chamado Tema 69, em 2017. Além disso, no início do mês, o tribunal também decidiu que [USN:L1N45T10Q TEXT:"créditos"] fiscais presumidos de ICMS não podem ser incluídos na base de cálculo de PIS/Cofins.
"Evidentemente, tem um impacto orçamentário que provavelmente vai provocar um pedido de modulação de efeitos via embargos de declaração pela Procuradoria da Fazenda Nacional. E esse ponto vai inaugurar um novo capítulo ainda nessa discussão", afirmou Molinari.

items.title: National Bank looks to modernize personal banking unit to better compete, CEO says
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: National Bank’s chief executive says competition is rising in the personal banking space and the lender will look to modernize its operations to attract clients.
items.body: TORONTO — National Bank’s chief executive says competition is rising in the personal banking space and the lender will look to modernize its operations to attract more clients. While speaking at the Canadian Club Toronto on Wednesday, Laurent Ferreira noted that consumer habits are shifting and newer lenders are offering fully digital services that are gaining momentum. Ferreira says the rapid growth of AI will also shift the landscape for deposits and payments. He says the bank views these developments as structural changes with opportunities to gain market share, but that its personal banking segment will undergo changes over the next few years, like becoming more mobile-centric, digital and simple. Ferreira says its strategy may also involve partnering with some of the new players that have better technology or a different business model. As the bank looks to build out its digital platforms, he says it is also increasing investments to protect client data, as AI is being used as a cyber weapon by fraudsters and hostile foreign governments. --- Daniel Johnson, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 21, 2026.
