items.body:
Reuters World News Summary
Reuters | Updated: 22-10-2026 05:23 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 05:23 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Following is a summary of current world news briefs.
New Mexico sues to stop payouts to Jeffrey Epstein's lawyer, accountant
New Mexico has filed a civil lawsuit to block payments from Jeffrey Epstein's estate to the late sex offender's lawyer and accountant, and to recover damages for survivors of his alleged sexual abuse, the state's top law enforcement official said on Wednesday. The suit is the first law enforcement action against Epstein's longtime personal attorney Darren Indyke and accountant Richard Kahn, according to New Mexico Attorney General Raul Torrez.
Missiles strike Ukraine's Kyiv, Reuters witness says
Missiles struck Kyiv in the early hours of Thursday, a Reuters witness said, in another attack on Ukraine's capital after a Russian evening air strike which injured six people and damaged homes, a petrol station and transport equipment. In Russia, in the city of Lipetsk — home to a major steel plant some 400 km (250 miles) south of Moscow — a man was injured as drones hit apartment buildings and a medical facility, Governor Igor Artamonov said on the Telegram messaging app.
Pope Leo will not need further cancer treatment, doctors say
Pope Leo will not need any further therapy after undergoing lung cancer surgery last week, his doctors said on Wednesday, indicating that his tumor had not spread. The announcement came as it was still unclear whether the US-born pope would proceed with a planned trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, scheduled for November 6-17.
Driver at Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant killed in drone attacks, managers say
Management at the Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant in southeastern Ukraine said a driver at the station had been killed on Wednesday after two days of Ukrainian drone attacks. Russian forces seized the station, Europe's largest with six reactors, in the first weeks of the February 2022 invasion. Each side has since repeatedly accused the other of military activity liable to jeopardise nuclear safety.
US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes
The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and plans to withdraw family members from a number of other US missions in the region, US officials told Reuters. The order came as attacks in Saudi Arabia killed at least one person and injured eight others at a civilian airport in Dammam and two people were killed in a drone attack on an oil field.
Saudi civil aviation says one killed, eight injured in attack on King Fahd airport
An attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, on Wednesday evening killed one resident and injured eight others, the General Authority of Civil Aviation said. The statement said material damage was being assessed.
Lawmakers say US briefing showed Russia targeting Democrats with misinformation
The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's midterm elections. The comments by Senator Mark Warner and Representative Jim Himes come as Republican President Donald Trump has in recent weeks eased economic sanctions on Russia and increased pressure on Ukraine to end its fight against Russian forces.
Analysis-Israel's election may change its leader, but not Iran war policy
Israel's election next week may change its leader, but not its strategy: Iran will remain its chief adversary, military force will continue to be its preferred tool and Palestinian statehood a distant prospect, regional policymakers and analysts say. That is because the strategic assumptions underpinning Israeli policy were hardened by the October 7, 2023, attacks on southern Israeli communities by Palestinian militant group Hamas and by the wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
Britain's MI5 spied on NHS founder Bevan, secret documents show
British spies monitored Nye Bevan, the much lauded architect of the National Health Service, for three decades because of his links to the Communist Party and criticism of Britain's government in World War Two, newly released papers show. Declassified secret documents from MI5 made public by the National Archives on Thursday reveal that Bevan's activities in parliament, and his movements and meetings outside, were closely watched by MI5 from 1933 until his death in 1960.
Mexico levies rare treason charge against ex-official over US drug operation
Mexican federal prosecutors charged a former state prosecutor with treason on Wednesday after accusing him of allowing US personnel to take part in a drug operation in northern Mexico without the federal government's approval. Authorities dusted off one of the country's gravest and least-used criminal charges against former Chihuahua Attorney General Cesar Jauregui, in a case that could reshape how Mexican officials work with US security forces.
Websites taken offline over PHP risks
Several government, school and hospital websites in Europe were taken offline on Wednesday as organizations rushed to protect themselves from two critical security flaws in PHP, a programming language that powers a large share of the internet. Cybersecurity agencies across the world have warned that organizations unable to apply fixes in time should consider taking affected sites offline. PHP's developers said a set of new updates fixing two previously identified critical vulnerabilities was available.
Venezuela to attract investors after elections, Branson says
British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas. Venezuela's Interim President Delcy Rodriguez and US President Donald Trump have both said Venezuela will hold elections but have not provided a timeline.
Bolsonaro's lead over Lula narrows ahead Brazil runoff, Quaest poll shows
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's lead over President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has narrowed ahead of an October 25 runoff, a Quaest poll showed on Wednesday. The eldest son of former right-wing President Jair Bolsonaro would receive 45% of the vote, compared with 44% for the leftist incumbent, according to the poll.
Putin agrees to resume 3-way peace talks with Ukraine and US
Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed to resume US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine as soon as next month, the Kremlin said on Wednesday, after Putin met US envoy Steve Witkoff in Washington's latest push to stop Europe's bloodiest conflict since World War Two. The negotiations in a grand imperial palace in St Petersburg, the ninth time that Witkoff has met Putin in person, began with a goodwill gesture from Russia - the release of Stephen Hubbard, a retired US school teacher held in Russia whom US President Trump had asked the Kremlin chief to release.
As Russia penalises European firms over Ukraine, US rivals largely spared
Russia has deepened a crackdown on European companies in response to Europe's support for Ukraine, while largely sparing US firms as Moscow courts business ties with Washington, Russian officials and US business people said. Of 20 foreign-owned firms that Russian President Vladimir Putin has placed under temporary administration since Donald Trump's inauguration as US president in January 2025, only three were linked to the US, with the remainder controlled by European companies, a Reuters analysis of official data shows.
Russia frees retired US schoolteacher in goodwill gesture as Putin meets Witkoff
Russia freed Stephen Hubbard, a retired US schoolteacher in custody since 2022, from prison on Wednesday and took him to St Petersburg to fly back to the United States, after talks that Washington said were a step toward ending the war in Ukraine. Russian President Vladimir Putin made the announcement at a meeting in St Petersburg with US envoy Steve Witkoff, who later said the talks will continue toward planned technical-level discussions involving the US, Russia and Ukraine.
Brazil's Bolsonaro sets terms for records release after Lula's disclosure challenge
Brazilian presidential candidate Senator Flavio Bolsonaro imposed conditions on Wednesday to disclose his bank, tax and telephone records after a challenge from President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, his opponent in Sunday's election runoff. The challenge has become a new battlefront in what polls portray as a strongly contested election, with the candidates seeking to convince voters of their transparency and integrity, and their rival's lack of it, in the last days of the campaign.
North Korea's Kim Yo Jong warns South Korea, says border loudspeakers to be ready within days
North Korea will place anti-South Korea loudspeakers on standby along the entire border within days and has put new countermeasures on alert, Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korea's leader, said on Thursday, warning Seoul of "the most horrible and distressing situation" if it continues what Pyongyang calls interference. The threats to redeploy propaganda loudspeakers, announced in Kim’s second statement within hours, risk reversing South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s signature gains in easing inter-Korean tensions and pushing tensions along the heavily fortified frontier to their highest level since he took office.
Philippines exploring deeper cooperation with Taiwan to protect cables
The Philippines is exploring deeper cooperation with Taiwan on protecting undersea cables and addressing "gray-zone" activity, despite Manila's one-China policy, which recognizes Beijing and not Taipei, a Philippine diplomat said on Wednesday.
The Philippines and Taiwan have repeatedly complained about Chinese activities designed to pressure the countries without direct confrontation. China claims Taiwan as its own territory and has overlapping claims with both Taiwan and the Philippines in the South China Sea.
Exclusive-Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh enters race for UN chief
Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh entered the race to become the next United Nations secretary-general on Wednesday, injecting a prominent Middle Eastern candidate into a contest that has struggled to produce a consensus choice among the Security Council’s most powerful members. Nusseibeh, a former UAE ambassador to the UN for more than a decade, told Reuters she would seek to restore the world body’s role as a diplomatic problem-solver at a time of mounting global crises.
Analysis-US invokes rarely used torture law in revamped case against Maduro
Nicolas Maduro is one of just a handful of people to be charged in the US with violating a federal law criminalizing torture committed overseas, a Reuters review of court records found, as prosecutors seek to broaden their criminal case against the ousted Venezuelan president. Maduro, 63, and his wife Cilia Flores, 70, pleaded not guilty last week to an expanded indictment accusing them of conspiring to torture political opponents to remain in power, in addition to the drug trafficking charges they already faced. They are scheduled to go on trial in June 2027.
France's Macron vows order, calls foreign criticism of unrest 'stupid'
President Emmanuel Macron vowed on Wednesday to prevent a repeat of last weekend's violence at protests planned in the coming days, and dismissed as "stupid" and "unacceptable" comments from some foreign leaders about the unrest. France's main student union, UNEF, has called for further rallies on Saturday, while the Yellow Vest group, which emerged as a potent anti-establishment movement in 2018, has filed plans for a march through central Paris the same day.
Six injured in Russian missile attack on Ukrainian capital
Russian forces attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with ballistic missiles on Wednesday evening, damaging homes, a petrol station and transport equipment and injuring six people, officials said. Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram there were strikes in two districts on the east side of the Dnipro River bisecting the city.
El Salvador says Haiti gangs holding 4 force members hostage, announces new rescue mission
El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele on Wednesday said that Haitian gangs were holding four Salvadaron members of an international UN-backed security force hostage, and that he had launched a military operation to being them back unharmed. El Salvador's military and the Gang Suppression Force, mandated to help Haitian police fight powerful gangs, earlier this week announced efforts to recover the missing Salvadorans, but said intense fighting in the area had limited access.
Top Cuban diplomat accuses US of threatening countries that vote with Cuba at UN
Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez accused the United States on Wednesday of threatening member states of the United Nations with sanctions should they side with Cuba in next week's annual UN vote on a resolution calling for an end to a US embargo on the island. "The US State Department is exerting unprecedented pressure — at times in a personal and brazen manner by the secretary of state himself — to get UN member states to change their votes," Rodriguez said.
Austrian and Swiss women freed after 18 months in Niger reach Benghazi, sources say
An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday. The Austrian, identified by Austrian authorities as Eva G, who is in her 70s, was kidnapped in the desert town of Agadez in central Niger in January 2025. Little information has been released about which group was holding her or what demands they may have made. She had been living in Niger for years.
Ukraine's Zelenskiy hopes for new talks with Russia, US by early November
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Wednesday that Ukraine supported a US proposal for three-way talks with Russia and the United States at the level of negotiators to be held as soon as possible, preferably no later than early November. Zelenskiy, speaking to journalists on WhatsApp as he returned to Kyiv from Norway, said he had spoken to US officials after presidential envoy Steve Witkoff's talks in St Petersburg with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow Big Bend border wall construction
President Donald Trump's administration asked the US Supreme Court on Wednesday to let it proceed with a plan to build a US-Mexico border barrier in a remote region in West Texas that includes Big Bend National Park. The Justice Department filed an emergency request for the court to lift a federal judge's order halting wall construction in the region while a lawsuit against the project brought by an environmental group and other challengers plays out.

China, Djibouti say all countries should enjoy freedom of navigation in Red Sea
Reuters | Updated: 22-10-2026 05:20 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 05:20 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

All countries should enjoy freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, China and Djibouti said in a joint statement following a meeting of their foreign ministers in Beijing, expressing concern about the deteriorating security situation. Djibouti sits on the other side of the Bab ed-Mandeb Strait from Yemen, where Iran-backed Houthis have been battling Saudi-backed government forces and seeking to control the whole Yemeni Red Sea coast, disrupting some shipping.
In 2017, China formally opened its first overseas military base in Djibouti. The barren former French colony, which is about the size of Wales, is sandwiched between Ethiopia, Eritrea and Somalia and also hosts US, Japanese and French bases. The joint statement, released early on Thursday, said both China and Djibouti stressed the importance of maintaining freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the strait, and "emphasised that the right of merchant ships of all countries to exercise navigation rights in accordance with international law should be respected".
"Both sides believe that in governing and securing the Red Sea, the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and wishes of the Red Sea littoral states should be genuinely respected, avoiding any increase in the overall security risks of the region." China supports the littoral states of the Red Sea in "constructively maintaining" the safety and smooth flow of international shipping lanes, said the statement, carried by China's official Xinhua news agency.
Neither country wants regional tensions to spill further into the Red Sea, and "major powers outside the region" should respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of regional countries, and avoid resorting to force and unilateral sanctions, it added. The statement came as the US State Department ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia following the escalation of the fighting in Yemen, which has opened another front in the regional conflict triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran.

items.title: 情報ＢＯＸ：ＰＨＰの重大脆弱性、リスクと発見経緯
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Leo Marchandon

[２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Leo Marchandon

[２１日 ロイター] - 欧州各地で２１日、政府ウェブサイトの停止が相次いだ。ウェブで最も広く使われているプログラミング言語の一つ、ＰＨＰ（ハイパーテキスト・プリプロセッサ）で２件の重大な脆弱性が見つかったためだ。

以下に押さえておくべきポイントをまとめた。

＜ＰＨＰとは＞

ＰＨＰはウェブサイトを動かすプログラミング言語で、利用者から見えないところで働いている。利用者がページを読み込むと、ＰＨＰが稼働するサーバーがコンテンツを組み立て、完成したページをブラウザーに送る。

無料のオープンソースソフトウエアで、ボランティアが保守している。サイトの所有者が直接操作することはほとんどない。

ウェブ技術の調査サービス「Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓ」によると、使用するプログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトの７０％近くがＰＨＰで動いている。ＰＨＰは、全ウェブサイトの約４０％を支えるソフトウエア「ワードプレス」の基盤でもある。これらにはブログ、中小企業のページ、政府のポータルサイト、オンラインショップ、ニュースサイトなどが含まれる。

＜脆弱性のリスクは＞

２件の脆弱性は、業界標準の深刻度評価システム「ＣＶＳＳ」のバージョン４．０で、１０点満点中９．２点と評価されている。ＥＵのサイバーセキュリティー対応チーム「ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵ」によると、この評価は認証なしで遠隔からコードを実行できることを示す。つまり、攻撃者はパスワードやアカウントがなくても、インターネット経由で脆弱なサーバー上でコマンドを実行できる。

ＰＨＰに一つの欠陥があるだけで、数百万台のサーバーに一斉に同じ侵入口が開かれる。欠陥を悪用すれば、ウェブサイトを支配できる。ウェブホスティングサービスのゴーダディによると、データの盗難やページの改ざん、システム全体の乗っ取りにつながる恐れがある。クラウドフレアの最高技術責任者は、初期の攻撃が発生し始めていると述べた。

小規模なウェブサイトの大半は通常、セキュリティー担当者のいない所有者が運営している。共用ホスティングサービスを利用していることも多く、その場合、所有者はサーバーを管理しておらず、誰がＰＨＰを更新するのか把握していない可能性がある。ワードプレス向けのセキュリティープラグイン「ワードフェンス」は、通常の自動更新では今回の修正は適用されないと警告した。ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵは、影響を受けるサイトを危険にさらしたままにせず、公開を停止するよう勧告している。

＜どのように発見されたのか＞

セキュリティー企業カリフによると、オープンＡＩと協力する同社の研究者が、オープンＡＩのモデル「ＧＰＴ－５．６ Ｓｏｌ」を使って最初の欠陥を発見し、８月１１日にＰＨＰ側に報告した。アルファベット傘下グーグルが保有するセキュリティー企業ウィズも独自に欠陥を発見し、８月２４日に２件目を報告した。同社も人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを使用した。

ウィズは、今回の欠陥について「ＰＨＰで見つかった脆弱性の中でも最も深刻な部類に入り、ソフトウエアの歴史全体でもそう言えるだろう」と説明した。根本的な欠陥は数十年前から存在していたが、悪用できると実証するには「人間の研究者が現実的に達成できる限界に近い」一連の手順が必要だったという。

トランプ米政権は「状況を注視し、修正プログラムの公開を早めるため、連邦機関や主要なＳＩ研究機関と調整している」と表明した。ＳＩは、トランプ氏が人工知能を指して好んで使う「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス）」の略称。政権は今回の発見を、米国の「超知能」が国家安全保障を強化している証拠と位置付けた。

ウェブ技術の調査サービス「Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓ」によると、使用するプログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトの７０％近くがＰＨＰで動いている。ＰＨＰは、全ウェブサイトの約４０％を支えるソフトウエア「ワードプレス」の基盤でもある。これらにはブログ、中小企業のページ、政府のポータルサイト、オンラインショップ、ニュースサイトなどが含まれる。

＜脆弱性のリスクは＞

２件の脆弱性は、業界標準の深刻度評価システム「ＣＶＳＳ」のバージョン４．０で、１０点満点中９．２点と評価されている。ＥＵのサイバーセキュリティー対応チーム「ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵ」によると、この評価は認証なしで遠隔からコードを実行できることを示す。つまり、攻撃者はパスワードやアカウントがなくても、インターネット経由で脆弱なサーバー上でコマンドを実行できる。

ＰＨＰに一つの欠陥があるだけで、数百万台のサーバーに一斉に同じ侵入口が開かれる。欠陥を悪用すれば、ウェブサイトを支配できる。ウェブホスティングサービスのゴーダディによると、データの盗難やページの改ざん、システム全体の乗っ取りにつながる恐れがある。クラウドフレアの最高技術責任者は、初期の攻撃が発生し始めていると述べた。

小規模なウェブサイトの大半は通常、セキュリティー担当者のいない所有者が運営している。共用ホスティングサービスを利用していることも多く、その場合、所有者はサーバーを管理しておらず、誰がＰＨＰを更新するのか把握していない可能性がある。ワードプレス向けのセキュリティープラグイン「ワードフェンス」は、通常の自動更新では今回の修正は適用されないと警告した。ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵは、影響を受けるサイトを危険にさらしたままにせず、公開を停止するよう勧告している。

＜どのように発見されたのか＞

セキュリティー企業カリフによると、オープンＡＩと協力する同社の研究者が、オープンＡＩのモデル「ＧＰＴ－５．６ Ｓｏｌ」を使って最初の欠陥を発見し、８月１１日にＰＨＰ側に報告した。アルファベット傘下グーグルが保有するセキュリティー企業ウィズも独自に欠陥を発見し、８月２４日に２件目を報告した。同社も人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを使用した。

ウィズは、今回の欠陥について「ＰＨＰで見つかった脆弱性の中でも最も深刻な部類に入り、ソフトウエアの歴史全体でもそう言えるだろう」と説明した。根本的な欠陥は数十年前から存在していたが、悪用できると実証するには「人間の研究者が現実的に達成できる限界に近い」一連の手順が必要だったという。

トランプ米政権は「状況を注視し、修正プログラムの公開を早めるため、連邦機関や主要なＳＩ研究機関と調整している」と表明した。ＳＩは、トランプ氏が人工知能を指して好んで使う「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス）」の略称。政権は今回の発見を、米国の「超知能」が国家安全保障を強化している証拠と位置付けた。

items.title: PETA urges Crystal Palace to retire bald eagle mascot Phoenix
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire its American bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, saying football stadiums are unsuitable environments that can distress birds and potentially put them and spectators at risk.
items.body:
Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire its American bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, saying football stadiums are unsuitable environments that can distress birds and potentially put them and spectators at risk.
Palace, known as the Eagles since 1973, introduced a live eagle as a matchday mascot in 2010. Phoenix made her official debut in August 2024 at four months old, succeeding long-serving mascot Kayla, who died in 2020.
In a letter to Palace CEO Sharon Lacey, People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals cited incidents involving birds at sporting events, including one in which a Charlton Athletic fan was found guilty of attempting to punch Kayla at a 2015 League Cup match.
"A bright stadium filled with boisterous fans is no place for animals. Under such conditions, birds easily become frightened, disoriented, and panicked - placing themselves and others at risk...," PETA wrote.
"When eagles are used for displays and entertainment, they are denied the opportunity to engage in their natural behaviour, resulting in frustration and stress. Wildlife doesn't belong in a football stadium...
"Bald eagles are widely recognised as symbols of freedom. They deserve better than to be used as an entertainment 'prop' to amuse The Eagles' fans.
"PETA urges Crystal Palace FC to protect animals by retiring Phoenix and committing never to use a live animal mascot again."
Palace has not responded to a Reuters request for comment.
PETA said no other UK football club still uses a live animal mascot.
Some other European clubs have used live eagle mascots, including Portuguese side Benfica and Italian club Lazio.

items.title: El rendimiento de los bonos franceses alcanza el 5%, su nivel más alto desde 2002
items.author: Alice Atkins
items.summary: El aumento de los precios de la energía y las dudas sobre la capacidad del Gobierno para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde la deuda pública impulsan los rendimientos de los bonos franceses.
items.body: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de la deuda francesa de referencia alcanzó el 5% por primera vez desde 2002, a medida que el aumento de los precios de la energía exacerbó la preocupación por las perspectivas fiscales del país. Los bonos gubernamentales con vencimiento a 10 años retrocedieron el miércoles, lo que provocó un aumento de siete puntos básicos en su rendimiento. Esto contribuyó a ampliar la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos franceses y alemanes a 159,4 puntos básicos, la mayor en 15 años. Ver más: Francia admite fallos de inteligencia tras subestimar la magnitud de las protestas Considerado un indicador clave del riesgo crediticio en la zona euro, el diferencial ha aumentado drásticamente desde finales de septiembre, a medida que se cuestiona cada vez más la capacidad de Francia para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde su carga de deuda. La indignación pública por el coste de la vida degeneró en violentas protestas durante el fin de semana. “Es probable que los diferenciales sigan bajo presión a medida que la atención se centra de nuevo en las próximas votaciones presupuestarias”, declaró Pooja Kumra, estratega sénior de tipos de interés para el Reino Unido y Europa en el Toronto Dominion Bank. “Incluso si se aprueba el presupuesto, a los inversores les siguen preocupando los indicios generales de disfunción fiscal y fragmentación política”. El miércoles, el alza de los precios de la energía impulsó la evolución de los bonos europeos, con los futuros de referencia del gas natural europeo subiendo alrededor de un 4% y el petróleo crudo Brent cotizando cerca de los 110 dólares por barril. En declaraciones realizadas a primera hora del día, el consejero delegado de Deutsche Bank AG, Christian Sewing, destacó la inestabilidad fiscal y política en Francia como motivo de preocupación , y señaló que es probable que la volatilidad continúe hasta las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año. Ver más: Macron acusa a líderes extranjeros de aprovecharse de los disturbios en Francia “Unos mayores rendimientos de la deuda soberana global también perjudicarían a los bonos franceses, dada su mayor sensibilidad a las fluctuaciones de sus pares. Preveo que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense y de los bonos alemanes a largo plazo aumentarán debido al gasto deficitario y la inflación descontrolada, lo que deja a los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense especialmente vulnerables”. — Ven Ram, estratega de activos múltiples. Ver más: Los disturbios en Francia pierden fuerza tras el endurecimiento de las medidas de seguridad El euro tuvo un rendimiento inferior al de la mayoría de las monedas del Grupo de los 10 frente al dólar, llegando a caer hasta un 0,2%, situándose en 1,1214 dólares. El Parlamento francés está profundamente dividido, y alcanzar un compromiso sobre el presupuesto del próximo año que permita la aprobación de los proyectos de ley está resultando una tarea ardua. A tan solo seis meses de las elecciones presidenciales, es poco probable que el proceso se simplifique. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Grupo Falic destina US$200.000 a la atención de comunidades afectadas por el terremoto en Panamá
items.author: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
items.summary: Grupo Falic apoya a las comunidades afectadas por el terremoto del 9 de octubre en Panamá. Los recursos anunciados se destinarán a viviendas temporales y otras labores de asistencia en el país.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Grupo Falic, empresa familiar dedicada a la creación de marcas de lujo y con una cartera diversa de negocios a nivel internacional como Bloomberg Línea, Duty Free Americas, Global Wine & Spirits y Reebok LATAM anunció este miércoles una donación de US$200.000 para apoyar las labores de asistencia a las comunidades afectadas por el terremoto del 9 de octubre en Panamá. De la totalidad de los aportes, US$100.000 se destinarán a la iniciativa “Chantin pa’ la gente”, impulsada por el alcalde de Ciudad de Panamá, Mayer Mizrachi, junto con la Fundación Omar Alfanno, para construir y equipar viviendas temporales para las familias damnificadas. Ver más: Mulino recorre zonas afectadas por el terremoto en Panamá y ordena medidas preventivas Otros US$75.000 financiarán acciones de ayuda en distintas zonas del país, mientras que US$25.000 se dirigirán a la comunidad de Colón, donde Grupo Falic tiene centros de distribución. “Panamá es nuestro hogar, y nos enorgullece estar al lado de su gente en estos momentos difíciles. Durante 25 años, hemos construido nuestro negocio aquí, hemos criado a nuestras familias y hemos echado raíces profundas en el país”, dijo en un comunicado León Falic, presidente del Grupo Falic. El anuncio de la donación se realizó con la participación del alcalde Mizrachi y los ejecutivos del Grupo Falic, León, Miro y Dov Falic. “Sentimos una gran responsabilidad de apoyar a las comunidades que nos han acogido y nos han ayudado a crecer. Esperamos que esta contribución brinde una ayuda significativa a quienes se vieron afectados por el terremoto, ahora que Panamá comienza a recuperarse”, agregó Falic. Panamá alberga la sede global del Grupo Falic, que cuenta con más de 2.000 empleados en el país. El 9 de octubre, un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacudió el sureste de Panamá, con una profundidad de 10 kilómetros, según el Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS). El terremoto provocó una alerta de tsunami en el Pacífico durante algunas horas. El evento dejó el saldo de un fallecido, al menos 27 heridos, unos 300 evacuados y más de 400 edificaciones afectadas en el país centroamericano. El 10 de octubre, el Gobierno de Panamá declaró la emergencia nacional para canalizar hasta US$100 millones para responder a las afectaciones generadas por el terremoto. Las provincias de Herrera, Los Santos y Veraguas concentran la mayor cantidad de viviendas afectadas, aunque se reportaron daños en Panamá, Chiriquí y Bocas del Toro, y en las comarcas Ngäbe-Buglé y Emberá. Ver más: Panamá declara estado de emergencia nacional y habilita hasta US$100 millones tras el terremoto

items.title: UK regulator ends Home REIT investigation
items.author: Kirstin Ridley
items.creator: Kirstin Ridley
items.summary: Britain's financial regulator has closed its two-year investigation into London-listed Home REIT , a British social housing company, although the watchdog said on Wednesday that it supported an ongoing criminal investigation.
items.body:
Britain's financial regulator has closed its two-year investigation into London-listed Home REIT (HOMEH.L) , a British social housing company, although the watchdog said on Wednesday that it supported an ongoing criminal investigation.
The Financial Conduct Authority ended the probe without taking any action, helping send the company's beleaguered shares 3.7% higher at the market close, their biggest daily percentage gain since June.
"We have carefully considered the case and believe the best way forward is to support the Serious Fraud Office's ongoing investigation," an FCA spokesperson said. The watchdog is reserving its rights to review its decision if new information comes to light.
Home REIT's Chair Michael O'Donnell said the FCA investigation was closed following the company's "extensive cooperation".
The UK Serious Fraud Office, however, [USN:L8N3YF1AO TEXT:"arrested"] six people in January in an estimated £300 million ($401 million) bribery and fraud investigation. Seven sites were searched, including a home in the Italian city of Venice.
Home REIT, which listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2020, bought properties across Britain, raising more than £850 million in its first three years of trading.
The company told investors their funds would help to buy and restore properties that would be block-let to publicly funded charities and community interest companies to house rough sleepers, veterans and people struggling with addiction. Rent payments would generate returns for investors.
But a report by short-seller Viceroy Research in November 2022 raised concerns that included the valuation of the properties and the ability of the tenants to pay rent. The company [USN:L4N32Q1IW TEXT:"rejected"] the allegations, but its shares were temporarily suspended from trading in January 2023.
More than 800 investors are [USN:L8N45N122 TEXT:"suing"] Home REIT, alleging they were misled about the security of the company's rental income, its financial strength and its stated social impact.
($1 = 0.7474 pounds)

items.title: eBay despedirá a unos 1.000 empleados en su segunda ronda de recortes de 2026
items.author: Spencer Soper
items.summary: Los recortes afectarán a cerca del 9% de la plantilla de la compañía, según una fuente familiarizada con el asunto. En febrero, eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo.
items.body: Bloomberg — Según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, eBay Inc. ( EBAY ) eliminará el 9% de su plantilla, lo que supone la segunda ronda de recortes de empleo de la compañía este año. Según la fuente, que pidió permanecer en el anonimato porque los detalles no son públicos, los recortes afectarán a unos 1.000 empleados. Reuters informó previamente sobre los despidos, citando un memorando interno del director ejecutivo de la empresa. Ver más: eBay rechaza la oferta de GameStop por no ser “ni creíble ni atractiva” “Mientras trabajamos para aprovechar la importante oportunidad que tenemos por delante, tomamos esta medida para garantizar que sigamos operando desde una posición de fortaleza, alineando nuestros equipos y recursos con nuestras principales prioridades estratégicas”, dijo un portavoz de eBay en un comunicado enviado por correo electrónico. Las acciones de la compañía subieron aproximadamente un 1,2% a las 11:05 de la mañana en Nueva York. En mayo, eBay rechazó una oferta de adquisición de US$56.000 millones del CEO de Gamestop Corp., Ryan Cohen, calificando la oferta de “ni creíble ni atractiva”. Al presentar la oferta, Cohen se comprometió a encontrar ahorros de costes por valor de US$2.000 millones en los 12 meses posteriores al cierre del acuerdo y sugirió que el gasto en marketing del CEO e eBay, Jamie Iannone, había sido un despilfarro. Ver más: eBay sube 5% tras oferta de GameStop, pero dudas de Wall Street afectan opción de inversión Iannone, que asumió el cargo de director ejecutivo en 2020, se ha centrado en impulsar las ventas en categorías selectas, como artículos de lujo, productos reacondicionados y objetos de colección. Estas últimas reducciones se suman a una ronda de recortes de personal en febrero, cuando eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo, lo que representaba el 6% de su plantilla en aquel momento. La compañía también redujo su personal a principios de 2023 y principios de 2024. Ver más: La jugada del CEO de GameStop: qué busca con su oferta de US$56.000 millones por eBay A principios de este año, eBay adquirió Depop, una plataforma de venta de moda de segunda mano, una operación que se espera ayude a eBay a competir con la emergente empresa lituana Vinted, que se está expandiendo en Estados Unidos. En agosto, eBay anunció que la adquisición de Depop ascendía a US$200 millones más de lo anunciado inicialmente, lo que podría afectar a sus ganancias en el tercer trimestre. La empresa tiene previsto presentar sus resultados financieros el 28 de octubre. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Vers une reprise des discussions trilatérales entre USA, Russie et Ukraine
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale au niveau technique avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain, tandis que le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a dit soutenir cette démarche et vouloir que les discussions se tiennent au plus tôt.
items.body:
La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale au niveau technique avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain, tandis que le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a dit soutenir cette démarche et vouloir que les discussions se tiennent au plus tôt.
Ces commentaires ont été effectués à la suite d'une visite en Russie de Steve Witkoff, émissaire spécial du président américain Donald Trump, lors de laquelle il a rencontré le président russe Vladimir Poutine.
Ils s'inscrivent dans un contexte d'inquiétudes à Kyiv et parmi ses alliés à propos d'un possible virage entrepris par Washington au détriment de l'Ukraine, alors que les Etats-Unis ont un temps suspendu le partage de renseignements avec les autorités ukrainiennes à propos des bombardements de la Russie.
Donald Trump a également annoncé plus tôt ce mois-ci être convenu lors d'un entretien téléphonique avec Vladimir Poutine d'un accord sur des [USN:L8N45V1O6 TEXT:"livraisons de diesel"], ce qui a provoqué un tollé de la part de responsables ukrainiens et européens ainsi que d'élus démocrates et républicains au Congrès américain.
Le Kremlin a fait savoir mercredi que Vladimir Poutine a accepté de reprendre les efforts de paix chapeautés par les Etats-Unis pour mettre fin à la guerre, entrée en février dernier dans sa cinquième année.
Ces discussions trilatérales au niveau technique pourraient avoir lieu à Abou Dhabi, qui a déjà accueilli un précédent cycle de pourparlers, et se focaliseraient sur des garanties sécuritaires apportées à la Russie et à l'Ukraine une fois la guerre terminée, a ajouté la présidence russe. Elles pourraient se tenir autour du 10 novembre, a-t-elle indiqué.
Volodimir Zelensky a dit par la suite que Kyiv soutenait la proposition de Washington et souhaitait au plus vite une rencontre entre des négociateurs des trois pays.
"Le camp américain nous propose de tenir (cette réunion) dès que possible et nous y sommes favorables", a dit le président ukrainien à des journalistes au cours d'un échange via la messagerie WhatsApp, ajoutant avoir été informé par des représentants américains que la Russie "soutenait" l'idée.
Les Américains "vont tout faire pour garantir que la réunion se tienne au plus vite, en novembre, je pense au plus tard début novembre", a-t-il ajouté.
NEUVIÈME RENCONTRE WITKOFF-POUTINE EN RUSSIE Volodimir Zelensky, qui s'était entretenu mardi avec Steve Witkoff lors d'une réunion en Norvège à laquelle ont également pris part des responsables européens, a souligné que Kyiv soutenait "toute proposition de cessez-le-feu, pour mettre fin à la guerre, des trêves énergétiques". Il avait répété plus tôt être [USN:L6N4670YO TEXT:"disposé à dialoguer"].
Aucun cycle de pourparlers trilatéraux n'a été organisé depuis le début de la guerre entre les Etats-Unis et l'Iran, le 28 février dernier. Quelques jours plus tôt, à Abou Dhabi, les délégations ukrainienne et russe étaient convenues d'un [USN:L8N3Z113X TEXT:"échange de prisonniers"], sans avancer toutefois sur les principaux points de contentieux.
Revenu au pouvoir à la Maison blanche en janvier 2025, Donald Trump avait promis de mettre fin à la guerre en Ukraine en "seulement vingt-quatre heures".
Il a rétabli les contacts directs avec Moscou, rompus par son prédécesseur Joe Biden en raison du conflit, et pris part l'an dernier à un [USN:L8N3U8008 TEXT:"sommet bilatéral"] avec Vladimir Poutine n'ayant débouché sur aucune mesure de paix.
Les positions de l'Ukraine et de la Russie demeurent très éloignées sur les contours d'un potentiel accord.
Alors que Volodimir Zelensky écarte l'idée d'abandonner tout territoire ukrainien à Moscou, Vladimir Poutine exige le plein contrôle de la région de Donetsk dans l'Est ukrainien, la garantie que Kyiv n'intégrera pas l'Otan et des restrictions sur les capacités militaires ukrainiennes.
Donald Trump, qui s'en était vivement pris à Volodimir Zelensky lors d'une rencontre à la Maison blanche en février 2025, a déclaré cette semaine qu'il serait opportun que l'Ukraine se trouve un nouvel interlocuteur pour négocier et qu'il était temps de mettre fin à la guerre avant que "de mauvaises choses se passent".
Steve Witkoff a rencontré mercredi Vladimir Poutine pour la neuvième fois en tant qu'émissaire spécial. Leur réunion, au Grand palais impérial de Saint-Pétersbourg, a duré près de trois heures. Elle a donné lieu notamment à ce qui a été présenté comme un "geste de bonne volonté" de la part du président russe: la libération du ressortissant américain [USN:L6N4670TT TEXT:"Stephen Hubbard"], emprisonné en Russie depuis 2022.
Kirill Dmitriev, conseiller spécial du Kremlin qui a également pris part aux discussions, a déclaré que d'importants projets économiques communs ont été évoqués.
items.raw_description: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale au niveau technique avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain, tandis que le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a dit soutenir cette démarche et vouloir que les discussions se tiennent au plus tôt.

Oct 21 : Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web.
The developers of PHP said on Wednesday they would release patches for two critical vulnerabilities, and EU cybersecurity officials warned organisations unable to apply the fixes to take affected websites offline. Here is what you need to know:
WHAT IS PHP?
PHP is a programming language that runs websites. It works behind the scenes. When a user loads a page, the server running PHP assembles the content and sends the finished page to the browser.

It is free, open source and maintained by volunteers. Site owners rarely interact with it directly.
PHP runs nearly 70 per cent of all websites whose programming language can be identified, according to web technology tracker W3Techs. It is the engine behind WordPress, the software that powers about 40 per cent of all websites such as blogs, small business pages, government portals, online shops and news sites. 
WHAT ARE THE RISKS OF THE FLAWS?
The two vulnerabilities are rated 9.2 out of 10 on the CVSS v4.0 severity scale, a standard industry scoring system. CERT-EU, the European Union's cybersecurity response team, said that rating signals unauthenticated remote code execution, meaning an attacker can run commands on a vulnerable server, over the internet, with no password or account.
A single flaw in PHP opens the same door on millions of servers at once. Whoever exploits the flaw controls the website. GoDaddy, a web hosting provider, said that could mean stolen data, defaced pages or full-system compromise. Cloudflare's chief technology officer said early attacks were emerging. 
Most small websites are typically run by owners with no security staff, often on shared hosting where they do not manage the server and may not know who updates PHP. Wordfence, a security plugin for WordPress sites, warned that the usual automatic updates will not apply this fix. CERT-EU's guidance is to take affected sites offline rather than leave them exposed.
HOW WAS IT FOUND?
Researchers at security firm Calif, working with OpenAI, reported the first flaw to PHP on August 11 after finding it with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model, the company said. Wiz, a security firm owned by Alphabet's Google, found the flaws independently and reported a second one on August 24, also using AI models.
Wiz said the findings "rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history." The underlying flaws had been present for decades, the firm said, but proving they were exploitable required a chain of steps "at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve."
US President Donald Trump's administration said it was "tracking and coordinating with federal agencies and leading SI labs to expedite the release of the fix," referring to Trump's preferred name for artificial intelligence. It framed the discovery as evidence that American "Super Intelligence" strengthens national security.

LONDON/PARIS, Oct 21 : Financial regulators in Europe are questioning Google after a cloud computing outage on Tuesday left millions of bank customers without access to key financial services for hours.
The European Banking Authority said that it had been in contact with Google Cloud to obtain further information on the incident, understand its implications and assess its potential impact on financial entities in the EU, a spokesperson for the watchdog told Reuters.
Alphabet's Google said the disruption, which lasted several hours, was caused by a "power event" in a London-based network that serves customers across Europe. Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC were among the banks affected.
HSBC and Lloyds did not comment.

A Google spokesperson said: "We have resolved a disruption to Google Cloud services at a third-party facility in our europe-west2 cloud region due to a power event. Services have been restored. We will update our public status dashboard with an analysis."
At Revolut, which has around 13 million UK customers, a wide range of services including logging in, card payments and cash withdrawals were affected on Tuesday, according to the bank's website.
Revolut said in a statement that it was reviewing the incident to reduce the impact of any future third-party disruptions, and that customer funds and data had remained safe throughout.
The outage is the first major test of new rules across Europe designed to strengthen the resilience of technology providers, including cloud firms, on which the financial sector depends.
The European Union last year designated 19 technology firms as critical third-party providers to the financial sector, bringing them under joint direct oversight of three financial regulators — including the EBA — for the first time. Britain took similar steps for four cloud providers, citing the risk that an outage at a major supplier could affect multiple financial firms at the same time. Google Cloud falls under both regulatory frameworks.
"The designation of a provider as a Critical third-party provider establishes an EU-level oversight framework; it does not transfer responsibility for incident management from the provider or relieve financial entities of their own regulatory obligations," the EBA said in emailed comments.
In Britain, parliament's Treasury Committee has written to the Bank of England and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), seeking details of the regulators' response to the outage on Tuesday, the scale of the disruption and any financial harm caused.
The FCA said it was engaging with Google over the incident. Under Britain's critical third party regime, designated providers like Google Cloud must report serious outages to the FCA and the BoE.
A spokesperson for the Bank of England declined to comment.
Under EU and UK rules, banks are ultimately responsible for the services they provide to customers, including when they rely on third-party providers.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Nestle, Zydus, Abbott face India scrutiny over claims on children's products
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's food safety regulator issued notices to Nestle India , Zydus Wellness , Abbott Healthcare and others on Wednesday over promotional claims involving products for infants and children that it said breached rules.
items.body:
India's food safety regulator issued notices to Nestle India (NEST.NS) , Zydus Wellness (ZYDS.NS) , Abbott Healthcare and others on Wednesday over promotional claims involving products for infants and children that it said breached rules.
The action comes days after the regulator [USN:L6N46302P TEXT:"proposed"] banning the addition of sucrose and fructose to foods for infants up to six months old, as India steps up scrutiny of food safety and pushes for front-of-pack warning labels, rattling the country's more than $100 billion packaged food industry.
The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India said it issued notices over products including Complan, Lactogen Pro 1 Powder, NAN Excella Pro Stage 1 and infant milk substitutes.
The regulator asked Nestle India to provide evidence supporting claims about digestive and immune-system benefits for its Lactogen Pro 1 Powder and NAN Excella Pro Stage 1 infant formula products.
Nestle India said FSSAI's latest post reiterated issues raised on September 18 concerning product labels, and that it had already submitted a detailed response to the regulator.
Zydus Wellness was asked to provide scientific justification for claims promoting its Complan children's drink, including the tagline "grow taller, faster. clinically proven 2X growth."
The company did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside regular business hours.
FSSAI also issued notices to social media influencer Ira Fathima and companies including Abbott Healthcare and Nestle India over an Instagram reel promoting infant milk substitutes.
An Abbott spokesperson said the company was not involved in or aware of the social media content referenced by the FSSAI notice and became aware of the content only after receiving the regulator's notice.
"Abbott does not endorse the claims or representations contained in the content," the spokesperson said. The company added that it had shared this information with the regulator.

items.title: Activos en Brasil se mueven atentos a balotaje; peso mexicano cae con fuerza
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Los activos brasileños cotizaron con bajas el miércoles, atentos a sondeos de intención de voto de cara al esperado y reñido balotaje presidencial del domingo, mientras que el peso mexicano fue golpeado por el desmantelamiento de posiciones de "carry trade", según analistas.
items.body:
Los activos brasileños cotizaron con bajas el miércoles, atentos a sondeos de intención de voto de cara al esperado y reñido balotaje presidencial del domingo, mientras que el peso mexicano fue golpeado por el desmantelamiento de posiciones de "carry trade", según analistas.
* Los mercados bursátiles de la región también reaccionaron a los reportes corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* A nivel global, el dólar cayó ligeramente mientras los inversores ya comienzan a mirar de reojo la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de la próxima semana. Los mercados descuentan que el banco central mantendrá los costos del crédito, pero esperan un endurecimiento monetario en diciembre.
* Mientras, Wall Street avanzó en medio de resultados de firmas ligadas a la inteligencia artificial y el retorno de los bonos del Tesoro retrocedió. Los precios del petróleo cerraron con pocos cambios tras perder el impulso de más temprano cuando escalaron más de 2 dólares por barril.
* El real brasileño cedió un 0,18% a 5,0272 por dólar, luego de tres sesiones de avances; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) bajó preliminarmente un 0,92% a 206.379 puntos, al perder impulso tras superar las 209.000 unidades en la apertura después de conocerse un sondeo sobre el balotaje presidencial del domingo.
* El Bovespa escaló más de un 1% en la ronda previa, con datos mostrando el ingreso de flujos de inversores extranjeros al mercado.
* La ventaja del senador Flávio Bolsonaro sobre el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva se ha reducido de cara a la segunda vuelta, reveló el miércoles una encuesta de Quaest.
* El senador de derecha obtendría el 45% de los votos, frente al 44% del actual mandatario de izquierda. El sondeo anterior de Quaest, de hace una semana, mostró una ventaja de 46% a 44% en favor de Bolsonaro.
* Las encuestas muestran que el senador mantiene una ventaja sobre el presidente de cara al balotaje, aunque la distancia se ha reducido y se estima que la elección será muy reñida. Bolsonaro ganó la primera vuelta pese a que la mayoría de los sondeos daban como triunfador a Lula.
* El peso mexicano bajó un 1,4%, a 18,6714 unidades por dólar, un mínimo del año, afectado por la reducción del diferencial de tasas de interés con Estados Unidos.
* El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, trepó un 1,43%, a 70.249,54 puntos, en su quinta sesión de alzas consecutiva apuntalado por resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* "El peso mexicano es la divisa más depreciada en la sesión, debido a que continúa el desmantelamiento de posiciones de carry trade, ante la reducción del diferencial de tasas de interés entre México y Estados Unidos. Este diferencial se redujo a 250 puntos base desde el 16 de septiembre, cuando la Reserva Federal incrementó su tasa de interés en 25 puntos base", dijo Banco Base en un reporte.
* Los mercados anticipan una nueva alza del costo del crédito en diciembre por parte de la Fed, mientras que en México no se descarta una reducción del costo del crédito durante el próximo año.
* El peso colombiano cerró con caída de un 0,50% a 3.190 unidades por dólar, después de que el Gobierno anunció que fijará por decreto el presupuesto de gastos para 2027, luego de que el proyecto de ley aprobado por el Congreso se hundió por un vicio de trámite, generando incertidumbre sobre la distribución del gasto público en medio de persistentes presiones fiscales.
* En la bolsa, el índice accionario COLCAP (.COLCAP) se valorizó un 1,08% a 2.560,52 puntos.
* El peso chileno , cerró la jornada con una caída del 0,41%, en 978,20/978,50 unidades por dólar, en línea con sus pares de la región, mientras que el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzó un 0,55%, a 10.987,14 puntos.
* El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un leve 0,07% a 1.526 unidades por dólar, junto a contratos de futuros equilibrados e intervención del banco central (BCRA) para acumular reservas a favor de sus arcas. La entidad monetaria compró 46 millones de dólares del mercado cambiario.
* Mientras, el índice líder MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires escaló un 1,68%, luego de acumular tres jornadas en baja.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , finalizó con una caída de 0,23% a 3,4340/3,4350 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) retrocedió un 0,31% a 1.574,24 puntos.

イーベイ株は取引序盤に約１％上昇した。

items.title: 再送-〔アングル〕マスク氏、テスラとスペースＸ統合に「多くのメリット」　株主投票がハードル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(見出しの誤字を修正します)

Akash Sriram

[２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
(見出しの誤字を修正します)

Akash Sriram

[２１日　ロイター] - 電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラを率いるイーロン・マスク氏は、同社と宇宙開発企業スペースＸの統合に「多くのメリットがある」との見方を示した。ただ、決定権はマスク氏にはなく、同氏が参加できない２つの特別委員会と、自身が「高いハードル」と呼ぶテスラの株主投票がその障害となっている。

多くのアナリストが不可避と見るこの統合には、こうしたジレンマが影を落としている。自らを「利害相反の当事者」と称するマスク氏は、両委員会はまだ条件で合意しておらず、市場が来年末までの合意成立を予想しているにもかかわらず、統合は確実ではないとの認識を示している。

フォーチュナ・インベストメンツのジャスタス・パーマー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「テスラとスペースＸの合併は理にかなうと思う。両社とも人工知能（ＡＩ）と自律システムへ急速に移行しており、大規模なインフラ事業を抱えているため、極めて戦略的だ」と述べた。

アナリストらによると、ＡＩや宇宙関連インフラへの巨額の設備投資が膨らめば、スペースＸのフリーキャッシュフローは圧迫されるものの、合併企業であればテスラとサービスを共有し、共同で資金調達することで、その負担を緩和できるという。

テスラの株主で資産運用会社ディープウォーター・アセット・マネジメントのマネージングパートナー、ジーン・マンスター氏はＸへの投稿で、「（統合が）これほど理にかなう最大の理由は、テスラがしていることをスペースＸが必要とし、スペースＸがしていることをテスラが必要としていることだ」と述べた。

＜ハードルはテスラ株主投票＞

マスク氏が合併を望む背景には、支配権の問題もある。同氏は複数議決権株式を通じてスペースＸの議決権の約８５％を保有している一方、テスラではその割合は約２０％にとどまる。

ＲＥＸファイナンシャルのリサーチ責任者ビル・バーミンガム氏は、合併によりマスク氏の議決権比率は約５７％になると試算する。ダイアレクティックの創業者ライアン・ズラー氏は、バークレイズが例示した参考水準である、テスラ株１株に対しスペースＸ株０．７株の交換比率で計算すると、その割合は５８％になるとみている。

マスク氏によると、テスラ側では投票された株式ではなく発行済み全株式の過半数の賛成を必要とするため、未行使の議決権は全て反対票として扱われる。アナリストらは、投票率をリスクと指摘しており、昨年の株主総会で投じられなかった、証券会社経由で保有される株式の議決権が取引成立の可能性に影響する要因になり得るとの見方を示している。

ｅトロのアジア太平洋地域（ＡＰＡＣ）主席アナリスト、ジョシュ・ギルバート氏は「１人の人物が両方を統括するような取引は、ガバナンスを巡って厳しい疑問を招くだろう」との見方を示した。

２１日午前の取引でテスラの株価は約３％上昇、スペースＸの株価は約９％上昇した。テスラは同日の米市場引け後に第３・四半期決算を発表する。

10/21 23:17 配信

2026年2月3日、インド・ムンバイで撮影　REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas/File Photo

［２１日　ロイター］　 - 序盤の米国株式市場は、主要３指数がいずれも上昇した。米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ とスーパー・マイクロ・コンピューター の四半期決算を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への投資意欲が高まった。 

一方、動画配信大手ネットフリックスは約５％下落した。利益と広告事業の見通しが低調な内容となり、業界内の競争激化を背景に視聴者数と売上高の伸びが鈍化していることへの投資家の懸念が深まった。

同社株は年初来で２６％超下落しており、現状の下げ幅を維持すれば時価総額は約１３４億ドル目減りする計算となる。

items.title: プーチン氏、中国首相と会談　中ロ関係の発展強調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２１日、ロシアを訪問している中国の李強首相と会談し、両国の関係は順調かつ力強く発展しているとの認識を示した。ロシア国営タス通信が報じた。

ロシア通信（ＲＩＡ）によると、プーチン氏は中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議の期間中に、中国の習近平国家主席と会談する機会があるとの見方を示した。

 ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官はこれまで、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が来月のＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせて３者会談を行う可能性に言及。トランプ大統領も中ロ首脳との３者会談に前向きな姿勢を示している。

items.title: ロシア、米・ウクライナとの3者協議再開へ　11月アブダビ開催の公算
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ／サンクトペテルブルク／ワシントン　２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ／サンクトペテルブルク／ワシントン　２１日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２１日、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を早ければ来月にも再開することで合意した。米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談後にロシア大統領府が明らかにした。

ロシア大統領府によると、新たな協議はロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベルで行われる見通しで、戦争終結後のロシアとウクライナの安全保障の確保が主要議題になる。開催地としてアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビが検討されており、１１月１０日、もしくはそれ以降に実施される可能性があるという。

米政府当局者も、米国が提案した実務レベルの３者協議の開催をロシアが受け入れたと明らかにした。こうした協議は今年２月以降行われていない。

ウィットコフ氏は２０日にノルウェーの首都オスロでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、ノルウェーのストーレ首相、フィンランドのストゥブ大統領と会談した後、プーチン氏と２１日にロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクで会談。プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談は約３時間に及んだ。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官によると、ウィットコフ氏はゼレンスキー氏との協議の内容をプーチン氏に説明。欧州諸国とウクライナの姿勢について「新たなアプローチや新たな論点が示された」と報告したものの、「ウクライナを巡る危機の解決という観点では有益な内容は多く含まれていなかった」との認識を示したという。

プーチン氏はウィットコフ氏との会談で、米ロ首脳が今月９日に合意したロシア産ディーゼル（軽油）を巡る合意の履行についても協議。イラン情勢についても話し合い、ウシャコフ氏によると、プーチン大統領は外交による解決の余地は依然として十分に残されているとし、イランを巡る問題の政治的、外交的解決策を模索する取り組みを今後も支援する用意があることを改めて確認した。

このほか、来月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が会談を実施する可能性についても協議された。ロシア大統領府によると、中国は米ロ中の首脳会談が実現すれば史上初となるとして、すでに準備に着手している。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２１日 ロイター] - 経済産業省は２１日、電気自動車（ＥＶ）など電動車の購入を促す補助金を来年から減額すると発表した。購入後に購入者が受け取れる補助金額を、現行の６割─８割程度に抑える。当初の想定より需要が強く、補助額を引き下げて予算内で制度を継続できるよう見直した。

来年１月１日以降に新車登録する車両から適用する。ＥＶの補助金は最大で１２５万円だったが、来年からは最大７５万円に減る。軽自動車のＥＶでは５５万円が４４万円に、プラグインハイブリッド車（ＰＨＶ）は８０万円が４８万円に、燃料電池車は１４５万円が８７万円にそれぞれ引き下がる。

車両に対する補助金とは別に、環境負荷の低減に向けた鋼材の導入に関する自動車メーカーの取り組みに応じて決める加算額も、軽のＥＶが最大３万円から１万８０００円に、それ以外の電動車は最大５万円から３万円に減額する。

政府は２０２５年度補正予算に、約１１００億円を補助分として計上していた。

items.title: Rate cuts off table as RBI MPC flags inflation risks, two dissent on stance
items.author: Anjali Kumari
items.summary: RBI MPC minutes show members concerned about broadening inflation, with two dissenting on the shift to calibrated tightening despite unanimous support for a 25-basis-point rate hike ...
items.body: With headline inflation projected to touch the upper tolerance limit of 6 per cent in the third quarter of the current financial year, the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has signalled that rate cuts are off the table in the near term. Minutes of its October meeting, released on Wednesday, show members increasingly concerned about inflation spreading beyond food and fuel. While all six members voted for a 25-basis-point hike in the repo rate to 5.50 per cent, Nagesh Kumar and Ram Singh opposed the shift in the monetary policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening. The minutes of the October 5-7 meeting show that the change in stance was intended to signal a shift in the policy outlook. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said it conveyed that rate cuts were unlikely in the near term, leaving a rate hike or a pause as the possible next moves. The duration and extent of any tightening cycle would depend on underlying inflation, the spread of price pressures and the second-round effects of the supply shock, he said. “I feel it is appropriate to change the stance to calibrated tightening, essentially signalling that rate cuts are off the table in the near term,” said Malhotra.  The case for raising rates rested on a change in the inflation outlook. Headline consumer price index (CPI) inflation rose to 4.8 per cent in August from 4.5 per cent in July, while core inflation increased to 4.2 per cent. The MPC projected inflation at 5.2 per cent for 2026-27, with the third quarter expected to see it touch 6 per cent, the upper end of the RBI’s tolerance band. While members agreed on the need for a rate hike, they differed on the extent to which inflation had become broad-based and persistent. Saugata Bhattacharya said price pressures were getting entrenched, pointing to wholesale input prices rising close to 9 per cent and the pass-through of higher costs to consumers. He also questioned whether monetary conditions were too accommodative, arguing that current and projected real interest rates were not consistent with price stability. “Too rapid a policy rate adjustment risks constricting growth and hence growth-led capital flows,” said Bhattacharya. Indranil Bhattacharyya called for the MPC to move away from a cautiousness bias and act pre-emptively. He cited sharp increases in weighted median and trimmed-mean inflation, along with higher inflation expectations among urban and rural households. “Inflation outlook merits greater attention, given supply side pressures from crude and food prices are unlikely to relent quickly,” said Bhattacharyya. Singh also pointed to signs of inflation broadening, citing the RBI’s September household survey, which showed the median three-month-ahead inflation expectation rising to 9.9 per cent. He warned that the real repo rate could turn negative under the projected inflation trajectory. However, he favoured gradual and moderate rate increases rather than keeping rates high for an extended period. A tightening stance, he argued, could signal a prolonged rate-hike cycle and undermine the growth-supportive measures taken in recent months. “Expectations of significant rate increases can undermine demand not only in interest rate-sensitive sectors but also drag on recent momentum in private investment,” singh said. Kumar, however, maintained that inflation was largely driven by supply-side factors, with little evidence of overheating or a broad-based increase in prices. He argued that the neutral stance remained appropriate amid geopolitical and trade uncertainties. “While inflation is driven largely by supply-side factors and does not show any signs of overheating of the economy nor of generalisation, it is important to manage inflationary expectations,” Kumar said. Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta, who proposed the change in stance, said inflation was largely driven by external supply shocks and showed limited signs of becoming entrenched. However, she argued that the MPC could not wait for definitive evidence of second-round effects, given the lag with which monetary policy affects prices. Referring to the post-pandemic inflation-targeting period, Gupta said the MPC had acted whenever inflation reached the tolerance limits, helping preserve the credibility of the framework. She added that a further increase in the policy rate might be needed, depending on incoming data on inflation, its spread across the basket and second-round effects. “With projections indicating the likelihood of headline inflation hitting the upper tolerance limit of 6 per cent, one may not want to wait for more definitive evidence of generalisation, and instead be mindful of the fact that monetary policy works with a lag,” said Gupta. The minutes also reflect concerns about the risks of excessive tightening. Bhattacharya said domestic financial conditions had already tightened significantly, reducing the need for large policy actions. The pace of further rate increases would need to be calibrated carefully, he said, warning that rapid adjustments could constrain growth and weaken the growth-led capital flows that India relies on. He also flagged vulnerabilities in India’s balance of payments amid tight global financial conditions, noting the importance of maintaining an interest-rate differential with G7 economies to attract debt flows. Global uncertainties featured in the committee’s assessment, including renewed tensions in West Asia, volatile crude oil prices and the US Federal Reserve’s 25-basis-point rate hike in September, amid elevated global bond yields. The MPC’s next meeting is scheduled for December 2-4. By then, members will have two more inflation readings and a clearer assessment of how much of the supply shock is feeding through to domestic prices.

items.title: トルコ・カタールなど4カ国が防衛協定署名、軍事生産で連携＝国防省
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] - トルコ、カタール、パキスタン、インドネシアの４カ国は２１日、防衛協力の推進と防衛能力の強化を目的とする協定に署名した。トルコ国防省が明らかにした。

同省は声明で、４カ国はカタールの首都ドーハで「バドル覚書」に署名し、協力をさらに深化させ、パートナーシップを発展させる意思を示したと述べた。 

同省は「この協定は経済的にも極めて重要である」とした上で、軍事生産における協力促進、軍事能力の向上、技術的な軍事訓練や研究開発における連携支援を目指すものだと説明。

「各国独自の軍事生産能力を活用することで、協力と統合を促進し、防衛産業の能力を向上させ、同盟国や友好国のニーズに応えることが可能になる」と述べた。

北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）で２番目の規模の軍と、強固な防衛産業を有するトルコは、イラン戦争を背景に、自国の軍事基地を置くカタールをはじめとする湾岸諸国の防衛力強化を支援してきた。８月には、核保有国であるパキスタンおよびサウジアラビアと相互防衛協定を締結した。

Oct 21 : OpenAI said on Wednesday it was expanding advertising on ChatGPT to 26 more countries, bringing the total to 89, as the AI company beefs up its advertising business to boost revenue ahead of a potential initial public offering.
The company said in August its ads business had reached an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion.
• OpenAI began testing ads in ChatGPT in the US earlier this year, and more than 100,000 advertisers have since run campaigns on the platform, the company said
• The expansion adds 14 more Latin American countries, including Argentina, Chile, Colombia and Peru, following launches in Mexico and Brazil

items.title: Five AI quirks and conundrums to watch this earnings season
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: As US earnings season gets underway, AI bulls and bears are becoming more entrenched in their positions. Several market quirks, curiosities and anomalies have popped up that underscore these extremes.
items.body:
As [USN:L8N4611ZZ TEXT:"US earnings season"] gets underway, [USN:L6N45T17Q TEXT:"AI"] bulls and bears are becoming more entrenched in their positions. Several market quirks, curiosities and anomalies have popped up that underscore these extremes.
This shouldn't come as a surprise, because, when it comes to AI, investors and analysts are largely flying blind. The technology is in its infancy, is evolving at breakneck speed, and has potential powers that are almost unfathomable. And the cost of funding this revolution? It's almost unfathomable too.
The implications for the broader market are also enormous. According to JPMorgan Private Bank's Michael Cembalest, AI-related stocks, a group he narrows down to 41 names, have accounted for 75% of S&P 500 (.SPX) returns, 80% of earnings growth and 90% of capital spending growth since ChatGPT launched in November 2022.
The results and outlooks from hyperscalers, “neoclouds”, chipmakers, software providers and all the AI-adjacent firms will set the tone for Wall Street and global markets going into next year. Here's the backdrop:
Equity-bond gap
As the old saying goes, bond investors are paid to be bearish and equity investors are paid to be bullish. Perhaps that helps explain why many of the bonds issued to finance America's record-breaking AI investment are trading at such weak levels even as AI-related shares mostly continue to move higher. Amid the latest wave of market jitters, it's easy to forget that the S&P 500 and Nasdaq (.IXIC) were at record highs only two weeks ago.
Those jitters have been meaningful, of course. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (.SOX) is down 25% from its June peak, and earlier this year the S&P 500 software index (.SPLRCIS) was down 35% from its record high. But the third-quarter earnings season begins, the chip index is up 55% year to date and software stocks have climbed back into positive territory for the year.
While “neocloud” company CoreWeave (CRWV.O) shares are down 13% this year, its October 2031 bond has plunged more than 20% since its launch in April and is trading in distressed territory below 80 cents on the dollar.
Meanwhile, credit default swap spreads, which measure the cost of insuring against bond default, have recently soared to record highs for AI borrowers including CoreWeave and Oracle (ORCL.N) , and even for trillion-dollar giants Amazon (AMZN.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) and Meta (META.O) .
Someone might want to remind investors that debt is still senior to equity.
CoreWeave: stock and awe?
[USN:L4N461208 TEXT:"CoreWeave"] is at the center of the latest market maelstrom. The Nvidia-backed (NVDA.O) AI infrastructure firm is loss-making, heavily indebted and faces soaring borrowing costs. But Wall Street analysts have wildly different views about its prospects.
Analysts at HSBC this week published an extremely gloomy note, forecasting average returns through 2030 below CoreWeave’s cost of borrowing.
"The more the company invests with this return profile, the more the value destruction," they wrote. Investors should cut their holdings of the stock, HSBC advised, assigning it a target price of only $39, some 37% below Tuesday’s close around $62.
Seems pretty clear-cut, right? Maybe not. Looking at the same data, equity strategists at Goldman Sachs this week raised their recommendation on the stock to a “buy” from “neutral.”
They reckon annual recurring revenue per megawatt is likely to rise over the next 24 months, and argue that the recent surge in yields doesn't represent the firm's true cost of borrowing because most of its financing is asset-backed. Even though they cut their price target to $106 from $139, that still represents upside of around 70%.
Token gesture
Growth in token spending is slowing, yet token usage continues to soar. Tokens are units of data processed by AI models during training and inference, and they essentially reflect the strength of demand for "compute". Slowing growth or outright declines in prices would indicate companies are reluctant to pay for that compute unless they can turn it into "higher top-line growth, bigger profit margins or substantial cost savings," according to Apollo's Torsten Slok. These benefits have yet to materialize.
But token usage is still rising strongly and steadily. So demand is still there. It's just that spending appears to have topped out because token prices have fallen, which is a reminder to investors that revenue at the big AI model developers like OpenAI and [USN:L4N4661JI TEXT:"Anthropic"] may not continue to rise as spectacularly as hoped. AI stocks are highly sensitive to expectations about future AI use and, obviously, revenue. How long can investors ignore the gap between the two?
Cold storage
Vast sums are being spent to address the shortage of computing power, but apparently some of that power simply cannot be switched on. Quite literally. Energy supply-chain chokepoints, including insufficient electricity and inadequate grid connections, mean many AI chips are sitting and depreciating in warehouses.
Only this week, Microsoft (MSFT.O) [USN:L6N464023 TEXT:"pulled out of a deal"] to anchor a flagship data center in Britain with Nvidia-backed Nscale after electricity grid officials said they did not expect to supply power to the site until the 2030s. Morgan Stanley analysts now reckon US data center developers will face a 30% to 40% power shortfall through 2028, equivalent to 34% of total chip demand.
Demand for power is rising, but it can't come online quickly enough.
Revenue conundrum
Ultimately, the AI investment bet hinges on whether the extraordinary sums being borrowed and spent on the technology will pay off. Third-quarter earnings won't give a definitive answer, but every nod and steer will be seized upon. The sums are eye-watering.
McKinsey and S&P Global estimate that the top six US hyperscalers alone will spend more than $7 trillion on data centers and other AI-related capital expenditure between 2025 and 2030.
Columbia University's Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh reckons the cost of financing the AI buildout from last year to 2032 will be $10.3 trillion . This spending is highly concentrated — just 2% of firms account for over 50% of total spending, according to one study .
If these firms want a conservative 10% return on that outlay, Van Nieuwerburgh estimates that annual revenue will need to be around $3.55 trillion by 2032. Some analysts suggest annual revenue of over $4 trillion will be needed to make the investment pay off. That's over 10% of expected GDP in 2032. That’s a very, very high bar.
(The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters)

items.title: Russia says it will send first diesel cargo to U.S. on Thursday
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Russia will dispatch its first tanker with diesel for the United States on Thursday, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said, according to the Vedomosti news outlet, after a deal with U.S.
items.body: MOSCOW -- Russia will dispatch its first tanker with diesel for the United States on Thursday, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said, according to the Vedomosti news outlet, after a deal with U.S. President Donald Trump. Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on October 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with Trump to supply diesel to global markets. Novak said on Wednesday the vessel will carry 40,000 metric tons of the fuel, adding that the paperwork on the fuel supply is nearing its completion, according to media reports. He did not name the port from which the cargo will be delivered. “Additional shipments will follow, of course. There were agreements reached between the two leaders. We will meet the United States’ needs, to the extent of our capabilities,” RIA news agency quoted Novak as saying. Trump has said Russia would immediately export 300,000 metric tons, or 2.25 million barrels, followed by 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons “immediately thereafter.” The U.S. exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day. Russian President Vladimir Putin was hosting U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff on Wednesday, after the U.S.-Russia diesel export deal led to a sharp deterioration in ties between the United States and Ukraine. During the talks in St Petersburg, Witkoff thanked Putin for lifting the export restrictions. Putin also mentioned the deal, saying that global diesel prices dropped by five-six per cent after the agreement. “That’s an example of us working together, I want to thank you for that,” Witkoff said in televised comments. Putin also said that first Russian tankers with diesel will departs in two to three days. “We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now. They will go one after another. The financial component should be provided,” he said, adding that Russia also would be able to supply fertilizers in “large quantities” to the U.S. market. items.title: 米特使がプーチン氏と会談、和平協議再開促す　新提案も提示
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [サンクトペテルブルク（ロシア）　２１日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[サンクトペテルブルク（ロシア）　２１日　ロイター] - 米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は２１日、ロシアのプーチン大統領と会談し、米国が仲介するウクライナとの和平協議の再開と、戦争終結に向けた新たな提案の検討を促した。

サンクトペテルブルクの宮殿で行われた会談は、ロシア側が善意の意思表示として、拘束していた米国人の元学校教師スティーブン・ハバード氏を解放する形で始まった。ウィットコフ氏がプーチン氏と対面で会うのは９回目。

プーチン氏は、トランプ米大統領のイラン対応を支援する意向を示した。ロシアはイランと数十年にわたる関係を持っているとし、その関係を利用してイラン核開発計画に対する米国の懸念に対処する用意があると繰り返し申し出たと指摘。米国の農家支援へ肥料の大量供給も可能だとウィットコフ氏に伝えたほか、１１月に中国でトランプ氏と会談する可能性について協議したいとも述べた。ロシア大統領府は、この会談に中国の習近平国家主席も参加する可能性を示唆している。

ウィットコフ氏はプーチン氏に「きょう実現したいことの一つは、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国による３カ国協議を再開できるかどうかについて、有意義な話し合いをすることだ」と表明。「きょう解決に至らなくても、次の一歩として何ができるかを話し合い、検討するだけでも重要だと思う。世界はその結果を待っている」と語った。

米国が仲介する和平協議が最後に開かれたのは２月で、その後、米国とイスラエルがイランとの戦争を開始した。

和平合意の条件を巡るウクライナとロシアの隔たりは依然として大きいが、トランプ氏は最近、何らかの合意に達するようウクライナへの圧力を強めている。２０日には、ウクライナは戦争を終わらせる時だと述べ、さもなければ「非常に悪いこと」に直面するとした。

＜新たな提案＞

プーチン氏は、故郷サンクトペテルブルクにある帝政時代の壮麗なコンスタンチン宮殿でウィットコフ氏を迎えた。ウクライナ東部ドネツク州の完全掌握や、ウクライナの北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）非加盟といった戦争の主要目標について、妥協する姿勢はほとんど示していない。

会談には、ロシア政府系投資ファンドを率いるドミトリエフ大統領特別代表も同席した。双方は戦争終結後の米ロ経済協力の可能性を強調した。

ウィットコフ氏は２０日、オスロでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、フィンランドとノルウェーの首脳、欧州と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）代表者らと協議、その翌日にンクトペテルブルク入りした。オスロでの協議は生産的で「ある程度の弾み」がついたと評価し、その内容をプーチン氏に説明すると述べた。

和平合意に向けたさまざまな案を記した文書を持参し、プーチン氏に検討してもらうと説明。トランプ氏の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏もいくつかの案を伝えたいと考えており、間もなく電話で会談に参加すると述べた。

米当局者によると、ウクライナはオスロでの協議に新たな案や提案を持ち込み、ロシアへの働きかけで足並みをそろえる上で「有意義な進展」があった。ウクライナの安全保障、戦後の経済計画、広範な欧州の安全保障体制など、「包括的な和平の枠組みの主な要素」が協議されたとという。

ゼレンスキー氏は２１日のＦＯＸニュースのインタビューで、オスロでのウィットコフ氏との協議は生産的だったとし、ロシアでの協議で前向きな成果が得られることに期待を表明、ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの首脳による協議を支持すると述べた。 

＜悪化する米ウクライナ関係＞

米国とウクライナの関係は、トランプ氏が１０月初め、米国内の価格引き下げへロシアとの軽油輸出に関する合意を発表して以降、急激に悪化している。米国向けの最初のタンカーは２２日に出航する予定。

ウクライナは、一部の情報共有や軍事用衛星システム「スターシールド」の利用に支障が出ていると訴えている。ただ、ゼレンスキー氏は、２０日のオスロでの会合で、これらの問題を解決することで合意したと述べた。

AMSTERDAM, Oct 21 : Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang believes that Europe's engineering expertise gives it an edge in physical AI and robotics, he said on Wednesday as the US tech giant announced expanded partnerships with European manufacturers and startups.
"Every company in Europe will become an AI company," Huang said at Nvidia's GTC conference in Berlin, which caps a European tour that has already taken him through London, Paris, Stockholm and Dublin.
"No region has dedicated itself to making mechatronics, electronics and mechanical systems at the level of precision and craft as the European region."
In a demonstration of Europe's AI creativity, Huang shared the stage with tiny duck-shaped, AI-trained robots developed by French startup Pollen Robotics in collaboration with Hugging Face, asking them to perform somersaults.

Nvidia says it has committed nearly $10 billion to Europe's technology ecosystem. It has established an early lead in supplying the processors and software needed for robotic 'brains', giving it a commercial interest in Europe's industry succeeding.
Among partnerships announced on Wednesday, Germany's Agile Robots plans to produce 1,000 to 2,000 petite humanoids next year in collaboration with Nvidia, CEO Zhaopeng Chen told Reuters. Production is due to begin late this year.
Huang said that Europe — often left behind by the US and Asia in the AI race and with no real home-grown player at the scale of an Nvidia, Anthropic or OpenAI — needed to make sure it was playing a central role.
"To be part of this AI economy, you don't want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI. We could do all of that here in Europe," he said.
Separately on Wednesday, Nvidia showcased a so-called new DSX POD design for factory-built data centre modules using its Vera Rubin platform. It said the modules could be deployed in as little as two weeks, down from six months.
However, not all went to plan on stage.
The Microducks showed that even with the power of AI, getting robots to follow instructions is not foolproof. Three promptly keeled over when Huang ordered them to take a nap, but the fourth needed extra persuasion. 
One appeared distracted and faced the wrong way as Huang wrapped up his speech. "Pay attention, stay focused," he told it sternly.
